example.en: Oh, so you knew about this long ago.

example.en: There's a big stone in the yard, and the kids like to sit on it and play.

example.en: If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

example.en: He and I are the same age, but he looks several years older than me.

example.en: Nobody expected the exam to be so easy; everyone handed in their papers quickly.

example.en: He's good-natured and has always got along well with his neighbours.

example.en: This company's products are of good quality, and their prices are also fairly reasonable.

indonesian: lokasi kejadian; tempat acara; di tempat; langsung (siaran)

example.en: Tens of thousands of spectators came to the concert venue.

example.en: The meeting discussed issues such as education, healthcare and housing.

gloss: to have; to possess; to own

example.en: He owns a very popular coffee shop.

example.en: He hurt his leg during the match and had to leave the field early.

indonesian: mata; kata penggolong untuk sumur, lirikan
meanings: classifier for big hollow things (wells, stoves, pots etc)

example.zh: 她看了我一眼，什么也没说就走了。
example.en: She glanced at me and left without saying anything.

meanings: classifier for a ream of paper
type of short song or poem

example.en: At the coach's command, the players dashed out at once.

gloss: to grab; to catch; to arrest

example.zh: 过马路的时候，孩子紧紧地抓着妈妈的手。

indonesian: tenaga, kekuatan; akhiran untuk kemampuan atau daya

example.en: He pushed open the heavy door with force.

meanings: to count as; to regard as

example.en: Count them: how many people came altogether?

example.zh: 现在很多交易都可以在网上完成。
example.en: Nowadays many transactions can be completed online.

gloss: to follow, to go along with

indonesian: derajat; kata penggolong untuk kali, kejadian

example.en: Today's high is 35 degrees, so remember to bring water when you go out.

indonesian: tunggal, sendiri; daftar, tagihan (seperti menu, struk)

example.en: Waiter, could you bring me the menu, please?

example.en: Business hours are from 9 a.m. to 10 p.m.

example.en: This incident attracted wide public attention.

example.zh: 这次比赛一共有两百名选手参加。

meanings: to throw oneself (into the river etc)
to place oneself into the hands of

example.en: He threw the ball into the basket and the whole crowd cheered.

example.zh: 我们必须按时把货送到客户手里。

example.en: This TV series has forty episodes in total, and I finished it in two weeks.

gloss: to realize; to be aware of; consciousness; awareness

example.en: This research institution specializes in environmental issues.

indonesian: wakil; sekunder; kata penggolong untuk pasangan atau set (kacamata, sarung tangan)

example.zh: 我昨天新配了一副眼镜。
example.en: I got a new pair of glasses yesterday.

meanings: publicly funded institution, enterprise or foundation

example.zh: 她把全部精力都放在了事业上。
example.en: She put all her energy into her career.

gloss: strange, odd; to blame; quite, rather

meanings: to share (let others have some of sth good)

example.zh: 她经常在网上分享自己做的菜。
example.en: She often shares the dishes she cooks online.

gloss: shelf, frame, rack; measure word for planes, machines
indonesian: rak, rangka; kata penggolong untuk pesawat, mesin
meanings: classifier for planes, large vehicles, radios etc

example.zh: 一架飞机从我们头顶飞过，声音特别大。

indonesian: tingkat, kelas; kata penggolong untuk anak tangga

example.zh: 我弟弟今年上小学三年级，学习很认真。

meanings: to act on behalf of others

example.zh: 我更喜欢中式早餐，比如包子和豆浆。

example.zh: 买票的队伍排得特别长。
example.en: The line to buy tickets is extremely long.

meanings: to assign a name, title etc

example.zh: 是医生及时赶到，才救了他一命。

meanings: (coll.) to let things go to one's head

to place (sb) in a suitable position (job)
to install; to fix; to fit

civil administration unit in the baojia 甲 system (old)

to remove part of the whole
(of certain plants) to sprout or bud

example.zh: 成功的关键在于坚持。

meanings: as quickly as possible; as soon as possible

example.en: Please reply to me as soon as possible after you get the email.

example.zh: 这种外套不但保暖，还能防水。

gloss: to pay, to give, to devote (effort, a price)
meanings: to pay; to expend; to invest (energy or time)

example.zh: 为了这次比赛，他付出了很多努力。
example.en: He put a lot of effort into this competition.

example.zh: 哎，你的钥匙掉在地上了！
example.en: Hey, you dropped your keys on the floor!

example.en: Your interview is tomorrow. Good luck, and I hope it all goes well!

gloss: to treat, to cure; to govern, to manage

example.zh: 海洋里生活着各种各样的生物。

example.zh: 这种新药还在试验阶段。
example.en: This new medicine is still in the testing stage.

example.zh: 他已经连续工作了十个小时。
example.en: He has been working for ten hours straight.

example.zh: 我老公做的红烧肉特别好吃，孩子们都爱吃。
example.en: My husband's braised pork is delicious; the kids all love it.

gloss: behind, at the back; behind someone's back

example.zh: 我家背后有一座小山，周末我常去爬。
example.en: There's a small hill behind my house, and I often climb it at weekends.

example.zh: 在我们班的同学当中，他跑得最快。
example.en: Among the students in our class, he runs the fastest.

example.zh: 一名男子因酒后开车被警察拦了下来。
example.en: A man was stopped by the police for drink-driving.

gloss: to hide; to avoid, to dodge

example.zh: 下大雨了，我们赶紧到屋檐下躲一躲。
example.en: It's pouring; let's quickly take shelter under the eaves.

example.zh: 这篇文章的信息来源很可靠。
example.en: The sources of information in this article are very reliable.

example.zh: 水是人类生存必不可少的条件。
example.en: Water is an indispensable condition for human survival.

example.zh: 公司每年年底都要召开全体员工大会。
example.en: The company holds an all-staff general meeting at the end of every year.

example.zh: 周末我一般在家看书，或是出去跑步。
example.en: At the weekend I usually read at home or go out for a run.

example.zh: 这支球队的实力非常强。
example.en: This team is very strong.

gloss: to piece together; to go all out, to work desperately hard
meanings: at the risk of one's life

example.zh: 为了买房，他们夫妻俩拼了好几年。
example.en: The couple worked flat out for several years to buy a home.

example.zh: 夏天的傍晚，很多人喜欢在湖边散步。
example.en: On summer evenings, many people like to stroll by the lake.

example.zh: 这个小区的居民大多是退休老人。
example.en: Most of the residents in this neighbourhood are retired elderly people.

example.zh: 恭喜你顺利通过了这次考试！
example.en: Congratulations on passing the exam!

gloss: to go to, to head for, to leave for
meanings: to leave for; to proceed towards; to go to

example.zh: 总理将于下周前往欧洲访问。
example.en: The premier will travel to Europe for a visit next week.

gloss: to break up; to part ways

example.zh: 他们交往了三年，最后还是分手了。
example.en: They dated for three years but broke up in the end.

example.zh: 这首歌曲在年轻人中非常流行。
example.en: This song is very popular among young people.

example.zh: 这个项目能成功，靠的是整个团队的努力。
example.en: The project's success came down to the whole team's effort.

example.zh: 我们需要改变传统的教学模式。
example.en: We need to change the traditional teaching model.

gloss: to maintain; to keep; to preserve

example.zh: 上大学时，他靠打工维持生活。
example.en: At university, he supported himself by doing part-time work.

example.zh: 每次出差，他必带一本书在路上看。
example.en: Every time he goes on a business trip, he always brings a book to read on the way.

example.zh: 这座古城已经有一千多年的历史了。
example.en: This ancient city has a history of more than a thousand years.

example.zh: 这项工程预计明年年底完工。
example.en: This project is expected to be finished by the end of next year.

gloss: to implement; to carry out; to put into effect

example.zh: 新的规定将从下个月开始实施。
example.en: The new regulations will take effect starting next month.

example.zh: 外面下大雨，我的衣服全湿了。
example.en: It's pouring outside, and my clothes are soaked.

example.zh: 你平时喜欢看什么类型的电影？
example.en: What kind of movies do you usually like to watch?

gloss: to make, to build, to manufacture
meanings: party (in a lawsuit or legal agreement)

example.zh: 这家工厂专门造汽车零件，产品卖到很多国家。
example.en: This factory specializes in making car parts, which it sells to many countries.

gloss: to advance, to go forward, to make progress

example.zh: 虽然困难很多，但我们一定会继续前进。
example.en: Although there are many difficulties, we will certainly keep moving forward.

meanings: another person; sb else; other people

example.zh: 我们不应该随便干涉他人的生活。
example.en: We shouldn't casually interfere in other people's lives.

gloss: to guard, to watch over; to keep, to observe (rules, time)

example.zh: 他守着生病的妈妈，一夜没睡。
example.en: He watched over his sick mother all night without sleeping.

gloss: slippery; smooth; to slide; to slip
meanings: sly; slippery; not to be trusted

example.zh: 下雨后路很滑，走路小心点儿。
example.en: The road is slippery after the rain; walk carefully.

example.zh: 这台机器操作起来非常简单。
example.en: This machine is very easy to operate.

example.zh: 经过三个小时的讨论，双方终于达成了一致。
example.en: After three hours of discussion, the two sides finally reached agreement.

indonesian: yang bersangkutan; secara langsung; saya sendiri (formal)
meanings: oneself; yourself; himself; herself; the person concerned

example.zh: 办理护照必须本人到场。
example.en: To apply for a passport you must appear in person.

example.zh: 她从小就开始学习中国古典舞蹈。
example.en: She started learning Chinese classical dance as a child.

gloss: to release; to issue; to announce; to publish

example.zh: 这家公司明天将发布一款新手机。
example.en: This company will release a new phone tomorrow.

gloss: to endure, to bear, to put up with

example.zh: 打针的时候，他疼得忍不住哭了起来。
example.en: When he got the injection, it hurt so much he couldn't help crying.

gloss: to withdraw, to quit, to exit, to log out

example.zh: 因为受伤，他不得不退出这次比赛。
example.en: Because of an injury, he had to withdraw from the competition.

example.zh: 新到的货物都先放在仓库里，明天再发出去。
example.en: Newly arrived goods are kept in the warehouse first and shipped out tomorrow.

example.zh: 考试考得好，妈妈奖励了我一部新手机。
example.en: I did well in the exam, so Mum rewarded me with a new phone.

gloss: neat, even, uniform; all present, complete; together
meanings: (name of states and dynasties at several different periods)

example.zh: 人都到齐了，我们开始开会吧。
example.en: Everyone's here, so let's start the meeting.

example.zh: 新建的公园给市民提供了一个休闲的好去处。
example.en: The new park gives city residents a good place to relax.

gloss: to go along, to follow; smooth, favourable; in order

example.zh: 祝你一路顺风，到了以后记得给我打个电话！
example.en: Have a safe journey, and remember to give me a call when you arrive!

gloss: to climb, to ascend; to board; to publish, to register
meanings: to press down with the foot
to be gathered and taken to the threshing ground (old)

example.zh: 我们花了五个小时才登上山顶。
example.en: It took us five hours to reach the summit.

example.zh: 他在一次车祸中不幸去世了。
example.en: He sadly died in a car accident.

gloss: to lead; to be in front; to be ahead

example.zh: 上半场结束时，我们队以二比一领先。
example.en: At the end of the first half, our team led two to one.

gloss: to rise, to go up, to increase

example.zh: 最近几天气温不断上升，已经超过三十五度了。
example.en: Temperatures have kept rising over the last few days and are now above 35 degrees.

meanings: to wear by wrapping around (scarf, shawl)

example.zh: 下课以后，孩子们围着老师问这问那。
example.en: After class, the children gathered around the teacher, asking all sorts of questions.

example.zh: 我已经在地图上查好了去机场的路线。
example.en: I've already looked up the route to the airport on the map.

gloss: to touch; to bump into; to run into (sb)

example.zh: 我不小心碰了一下桌子，杯子掉到了地上。
example.en: I accidentally bumped the table, and the cup fell to the floor.

example.zh: 别人怎么说我不在乎，我只做我喜欢的事。
example.en: I don't care what others say; I just do what I like.

example.zh: 这架飞机的飞行速度非常快。
example.en: This plane flies very fast.

example.zh: 这里的冬天较冷，记得多带件衣服。
example.en: Winters here are relatively cold, so remember to bring extra clothes.

example.zh: 老人们常说，吃亏是福，不要太计较。
example.en: Old people often say that losing out is a blessing, so don't be too petty.

gloss: ethnic group, race; group of people (suffix)
meanings: by extension, social group (e.g. office workers 上班族)

example.zh: 中国是一个多民族国家，一共有五十六个民族。
example.en: China is a multi-ethnic country with fifty-six ethnic groups in total.

example.zh: 这辆车是全新的，才开了一百公里。
example.en: This car is brand new; it's only done a hundred kilometres.

indonesian: bawah tanah; ruang bawah tanah; rahasia

example.zh: 这栋楼有一个很大的地下停车场。
example.en: This building has a big underground car park.

example.zh: 酒后开车是违法的，被抓到会受到严厉的处罚。
example.en: Drink-driving is against the law, and if you're caught you'll be severely punished.

gloss: long-term; a long period of time

example.zh: 长期熬夜对身体很不好，你还是早点睡吧。
example.en: Staying up late over a long period is very bad for you; you'd better go to bed early.

gloss: suffix for goods or products (as in product, work of art); quality, character; to taste
indonesian: akhiran untuk barang atau produk (seperti produk, karya); mutu, watak; mencicipi
meanings: to criticize; to comment; to judge; to size up

example.zh: 这些都是我们公司今年推出的新产品。
example.en: These are all new products our company launched this year.

example.zh: 我从小就喜欢收集邮票，现在已经有好几千张了。
example.en: I've loved collecting stamps since I was little and now have several thousand.

gloss: to go deep into; deep, thorough, in-depth

example.zh: 记者深入农村，了解农民的真实生活。
example.en: The reporters went deep into the countryside to learn about farmers' real lives.

example.zh: 这首诗表达了作者对家乡深深的情感。
example.en: This poem expresses the author's deep feelings for his hometown.

gloss: to be called, to be known as
meanings: to be called; to be known as; to call it "..."

example.zh: 熊猫数量很少，被称为中国的国宝。
example.en: Pandas are very few in number and are known as China's national treasure.

example.zh: 节假日期间，高速公路上的车辆特别多。
example.en: During holidays, there are especially many vehicles on the expressways.

gloss: that year; in those days, back then
indonesian: tahun itu; dulu, pada masa itu

example.zh: 爷爷常常给我们讲他当年当兵的故事。
example.en: Grandpa often tells us stories about his days in the army.

gloss: to cause, to make, to result in

example.zh: 连续几天的大雨使得河水猛涨。
example.en: Several days of heavy rain caused the river to rise sharply.

example.zh: 他在人群中一眼就认出了自己的女儿。
example.en: He spotted his daughter in the crowd at a glance.

gloss: to rely on; to depend on; support
meanings: to rely on sth (for support etc)

example.zh: 他从小就学会了依靠自己。
example.en: He learned to rely on himself from a young age.

gloss: to produce, to yield; to give birth

example.zh: 这个地方盛产苹果，秋天到处都是果香。
example.en: This place is famous for its apples; in autumn the scent of fruit is everywhere.

gloss: to call the police; to report to the police; to raise an alarm
indonesian: melapor ke polisi; memanggil polisi; membunyikan alarm
meanings: to report sth to the police

example.zh: 发现钱包被偷后，他马上打电话报警。
example.en: After finding his wallet stolen, he immediately called the police.

gloss: to compete for, to fight over; to argue

example.zh: 两个孩子为了一个玩具争了起来。
example.en: The two children started fighting over a toy.

gloss: to row; to paddle; to scratch
meanings: to scratch (cut into the surface of sth)

example.zh: 周末我们去公园的湖上划船吧。
example.en: Let's go rowing on the lake in the park this weekend.

example.zh: 请帮我把这张桌子往左移一点。
example.en: Please help me move this table a little to the left.

gloss: to measure, to test; to predict

example.zh: 护士给我测了体温，三十七度五。
example.en: The nurse took my temperature: 37.5 degrees.

example.zh: 天气越来越热了，我想把头发剪短一点。
example.en: It's getting hotter and hotter, so I want to have my hair cut a bit shorter.

example.zh: 列车马上就要到站了，请保管好自己的随身物品。
example.en: The train is about to arrive at the station; please keep your personal belongings with you.

example.zh: 他的伤口一直流血，怎么也止不住。
example.en: His wound kept bleeding and nothing could stop it.

meanings: to ensure safety (for workers engaged in production)

example.zh: 小区门口的保安每天都检查进出的车辆。
example.en: The security guards at the entrance of the residential complex check vehicles coming in and out every day.

example.zh: 她每天在实验室里工作十几个小时。
example.en: She works more than ten hours a day in the lab.

example.zh: 全体员工都参加了这次活动。
example.en: All the staff took part in this event.

gloss: to squeeze, to push, to crowd; crowded
meanings: to find (time in one's busy schedule)

example.zh: 早上的地铁太挤了，我差点上不去。
example.en: The subway in the morning is so crowded I almost couldn't get on.

example.zh: 她大学学的是医学，现在是一名儿科医生。
example.en: She studied medicine at university and is now a paediatrician.

meanings: to make (a choice, decision, proposal, response, comment etc)
to issue (a permit, statement, explanation, apology, reassurance to the public etc)

example.zh: 经过认真考虑，他作出了辞职的决定。
example.en: After careful thought, he made the decision to resign.

example.zh: 我在网上搜索了一下这家餐厅的地址。
example.en: I searched online for this restaurant's address.

example.zh: 我最喜欢吃妈妈炸的鸡翅，又香又脆。
example.en: My favourite thing is the chicken wings my mum fries: fragrant and crispy.

example.zh: 专家预测，明年房价还会继续上涨。
example.en: Experts predict that house prices will keep rising next year.

gloss: to be located at; to lie

example.zh: 这家酒店位于市中心，交通很方便。
example.en: This hotel is located in the city center, with convenient transport.

gloss: quiet, still, calm; to calm down

example.zh: 夜深了，街上静得一点声音都没有。
example.en: It's late at night and the street is so quiet there isn't a sound.

example.zh: 这家公司根据顾客的需求设计产品。
example.en: This company designs products according to customer needs.

gloss: to show; to display; to unfold before one's eyes
indonesian: menampilkan; memperlihatkan; terbentang di depan mata
meanings: to unfold before one's eyes; to emerge; to reveal; to display

example.zh: 这次比赛展现了年轻选手的实力。
example.en: This competition showed the strength of the young players.

gloss: to talk, to have a conversation; conversation

example.zh: 经理找他谈话，问他最近工作怎么样。
example.en: The manager called him in for a talk and asked how his work had been going.

example.zh: 到了以后给我打个电话，报个平安。
example.en: Give me a call when you arrive to let me know you're safe.

meanings: (zoology) segment (of the body of a worm, centipede etc)
(fig.) a part of an integrated whole: aspect (of a project), element (of a policy), sector (of the economy), stage (of a process) etc

example.zh: 面试是招聘中最重要的环节。
example.en: The interview is the most important stage in recruitment.

gloss: to break, to smash; to break (a record, silence)

example.zh: 他在比赛中打破了世界纪录。
example.en: He broke the world record in the competition.

gloss: full strength, all-out effort; with all one's might

example.zh: 我们会尽全力完成这项任务。
example.en: We will do our utmost to complete this task.

gloss: to sign one's name; signature, autograph
meanings: to sign (one's name with a pen etc)

example.zh: 如果没有问题，请在合同的最后一页签名。
example.en: If everything is in order, please sign on the last page of the contract.

example.zh: 这家医院引进了很多先进的设备。
example.en: This hospital has brought in a lot of advanced equipment.

example.zh: 请你描述一下那个人长什么样。
example.en: Please describe what that person looks like.

example.zh: 本店今日休息，明日正常营业。
example.en: This shop is closed today and will open as usual tomorrow.

gloss: to recognize, to know; to admit

example.zh: 多年不见，我差点没认出他来。
example.en: I hadn't seen him for years and almost didn't recognize him.

gloss: to be present, to be on the scene

example.zh: 事故发生时，他正好在场，看到了整个过程。
example.en: He happened to be there when the accident occurred and saw the whole thing.

example.zh: 她的皮肤很敏感，不能用这种化妆品。
example.en: Her skin is very sensitive, so she can't use this kind of cosmetic.

gloss: to prevent; to guard against; to avoid

example.zh: 饭前洗手可以防止细菌进入身体。
example.en: Washing your hands before meals can prevent bacteria from entering the body.

gloss: to set up; to install; to set; settings

example.zh: 你可以在手机里设置一个提醒。
example.en: You can set up a reminder on your phone.

gloss: to contain; to hold in the mouth

example.zh: 这种饮料含大量的糖，最好少喝。
example.en: This drink contains a lot of sugar, so it's best to drink less of it.

gloss: to adopt, to use, to employ

example.zh: 这座大楼采用了最新的环保技术。
example.en: This building uses the latest green technology.

example.zh: 这对老夫妇每天傍晚都手拉手去散步。
example.en: This elderly couple goes for a walk hand in hand every evening.

gloss: to promote (in rank); to raise, to improve
meanings: (fig.) to elevate; to raise; to improve

example.zh: 他工作努力，很快就被提升为部门经理。
example.en: He worked hard and was soon promoted to department manager.

gloss: ground, floor; surface of the earth

example.zh: 下了一夜的雪，早上起来一看，地面全白了。
example.en: It snowed all night; when I got up in the morning, the ground was completely white.

example.zh: 他总是抱怨工作太累，工资太低。
example.en: He always complains that his job is too tiring and the pay is too low.

gloss: to have nothing to do with, to be unrelated
meanings: having nothing to do (with sth else)

example.zh: 这件事跟你无关，你就别管了。
example.en: This has nothing to do with you, so stay out of it.

gloss: to start work; to get to work; to touch; to hit someone
indonesian: mulai bekerja; turun tangan; menyentuh; memukul

example.zh: 时间不多了，我们赶快动手吧。
example.en: There isn't much time left, let's get to work.

gloss: to approach, to get close to; near

example.zh: 风停了，小船慢慢靠近了岸边。
example.en: The wind dropped, and the little boat slowly drew close to the shore.

gloss: live broadcast; livestream; to broadcast live
indonesian: siaran langsung; siaran live; menyiarkan langsung

example.zh: 今晚的足球比赛会在电视上直播。
example.en: Tonight's football match will be broadcast live on TV.

example.zh: 犯了错误不要紧，但应当勇敢地承认。
example.en: Making a mistake is fine, but you should have the courage to admit it.

gloss: to punish, to penalize; to fine

example.zh: 他因为闯红灯被罚了两百块钱。
example.en: He was fined two hundred yuan for running a red light.

gloss: to associate with; to socialize; to date

example.zh: 他性格开朗，很喜欢和人交往。
example.en: He's outgoing and really enjoys socializing with people.

gloss: in the air, in the sky; aerial

example.zh: 天气晴朗，鸟儿在空中自由地飞翔。
example.en: The weather is clear, and birds are flying freely in the sky.

gloss: to connect, to link, to join
meanings: to link; to join; to connect

example.zh: 这座大桥连接了两座城市，开车只要二十分钟。
example.en: This bridge connects two cities; the drive takes only twenty minutes.

example.zh: 这家药店的药品种类很多，价格也比较便宜。
example.en: This pharmacy stocks a wide range of medicines, and the prices are fairly low.

example.zh: 这部影片讲述了一个感人的故事。
example.en: This film tells a moving story.

gloss: at this moment, at this time, now

example.zh: 此时此刻，我的心情非常激动。
example.en: At this very moment, I feel extremely excited.

gloss: to treat as, to regard as, to use as

example.zh: 他把我当作亲弟弟一样照顾。
example.en: He looks after me as if I were his own little brother.

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，她激动得流下了眼泪。
example.en: Hearing the good news, she was so moved that she shed tears.

example.zh: 电影中的画面非常美，像一幅幅风景画。
example.en: The images in the film are beautiful, like a series of landscape paintings.

gloss: to separate, to partition; to be apart (by distance or time)
meanings: after or at an interval of

example.zh: 我们两家只隔着一条马路，经常互相串门。
example.en: Our two families live just across the road from each other and often drop by.

example.zh: 今天是我们结婚十周年纪念日。
example.en: Today is our tenth wedding anniversary.

gloss: statistics; to count; to add up

example.zh: 请把参加活动的人数统计一下。
example.en: Please count the number of people taking part in the event.

gloss: to create (art, literature); to compose; creative work

example.zh: 这首歌是他在旅行途中创作的。
example.en: He composed this song while travelling.

example.zh: 这家饭馆做的都是本地的特色菜。
example.en: This restaurant serves only local specialities.

example.zh: 适当的运动对大脑很有好处。
example.en: Moderate exercise is very good for the brain.

example.zh: 我们要从自身找原因，不要总怪别人。
example.en: We should look for the cause in ourselves and not always blame others.

meanings: major political event (war or change of regime)

example.zh: 结婚是人生中的一件大事，一定要慎重考虑。
example.en: Getting married is a major event in life, so think it over carefully.

gloss: speech; lecture; to give a speech

example.zh: 他在毕业典礼上做了一次精彩的演讲。
example.en: He gave a wonderful speech at the graduation ceremony.

example.zh: 长时间看屏幕，眼睛会很累。
example.en: Looking at a screen for a long time makes your eyes tired.

meanings: to bear (an expense, a responsibility etc)

example.zh: 房租已经成了年轻人很大的负担。
example.en: Rent has become a heavy burden for young people.

example.zh: 你们先走吧，我把东西收拾好随后就到。
example.en: You go ahead; I'll pack up my things and follow right after.

meanings: to go up by one grade; to be promoted

example.zh: 我的手机系统该升级了，运行越来越慢。
example.en: My phone's system needs upgrading; it's running slower and slower.

example.zh: 汽车开始加速，很快就超过了前面的卡车。
example.en: The car began to speed up and soon overtook the lorry in front.

example.zh: 水对人体非常重要，每天都要多喝水。
example.en: Water is very important to the human body, so drink plenty every day.

example.zh: 新员工上班前要参加两周的培训。
example.en: New employees have to attend two weeks of training before starting work.

example.zh: 她第一次独自出国旅行，心里有点紧张。
example.en: It was her first time travelling abroad alone, and she was a bit nervous.

gloss: to push forward, to advance, to promote

example.zh: 在大家的努力下，这个项目正在顺利推进。
example.en: Thanks to everyone's efforts, the project is moving forward smoothly.

example.zh: 我在网上搜了一下，找到了那家店的地址。
example.en: I did a quick search online and found that shop's address.

gloss: the masses, the public, the general public
meanings: the great bulk of the population

example.zh: 这种手机价格便宜，很受大众欢迎。
example.en: This phone is cheap and very popular with the public.

example.zh: 他在大学学的是计算机专业。
example.en: He majored in computer science at university.

example.zh: 这次地震中有很多房屋倒塌了，不少人无家可归。
example.en: Many houses collapsed in the earthquake, and many people were left homeless.

example.zh: 他在城里做服装买卖，生意还不错。
example.en: He runs a clothing business in town, and it's doing quite well.

gloss: to sell, to offer for sale

example.zh: 这套房子正在出售，有兴趣可以来看看。
example.en: This flat is for sale; come and take a look if you're interested.

example.zh: 这家公司的总部设在北京，在上海有分公司。
example.en: This company's headquarters is in Beijing, and it has a branch in Shanghai.

gloss: to separate, to part, to be apart

example.zh: 那场战争使很多家庭被迫分离，几十年都没见过面。
example.en: That war forced many families apart; they didn't see each other for decades.

gloss: to fan; fan; measure word for doors and windows
indonesian: mengipas; kipas; kata penggolong untuk pintu dan jendela
meanings: to slap sb on the face
sliding, hinged or detachable flat part of sth

example.zh: 天太热了，奶奶拿着扇子不停地扇风。
example.en: It was so hot that Grandma kept fanning herself with a fan.

gloss: to block, to clog, to stop up; blocked, congested; measure word for walls
indonesian: menyumbat, menghalangi; macet, tersumbat; kata penggolong untuk tembok
meanings: to block up (a road, pipe etc)
(fig.) (of a person) choked up with anxiety or stress

example.zh: 下班时间路上特别堵，开车要一个多小时。
example.en: The roads are really jammed at rush hour; driving takes over an hour.

example.zh: 这里的饮料可以随意取用。
example.en: You can help yourself to the drinks here as you please.

gloss: to estimate, to expect, to forecast

example.zh: 气象台预计，明天本市会有大到暴雨。
example.en: The weather bureau expects heavy to torrential rain in the city tomorrow.

example.zh: 他从不轻易放弃，遇到困难总是坚持到底。
example.en: He never gives up easily; when he meets difficulties he always sees them through.

gloss: to take as, to mistake for; to treat as
meanings: to consider as; to take to be

example.zh: 我说的都是为你好，别把我的话当成耳边风。
example.en: I'm only saying this for your own good, so don't let my words go in one ear and out the other.

example.zh: 工作之余，适当运动有益健康。
example.en: Doing a suitable amount of exercise outside work is good for your health.

example.zh: 这里的景色如同一幅美丽的画。
example.en: The scenery here is like a beautiful painting.

gloss: to mention, to bring up, to speak of
meanings: to raise (a topic, a heavy weight, one's fist, one's spirits etc)

example.zh: 一提起他的女儿，他就很骄傲。
example.en: Whenever his daughter is mentioned, he gets very proud.

example.zh: 这座大桥是十年前建造的，当时花了很多钱。
example.en: This bridge was built ten years ago and cost a lot of money at the time.

example.zh: 学习数学可以锻炼人的逻辑思维。
example.en: Studying maths trains logical thinking.

example.zh: 中秋节的时候，大家都要吃月饼。
example.en: At the Mid-Autumn Festival, everyone eats mooncakes.

example.zh: 她大学毕业后，在电视台当新闻主持人。
example.en: After graduating from university, she became a news presenter at a TV station.

meanings: (of a body part) to be painful; to be sore; to hurt
(of a person) to be in pain

example.zh: 他的腰部感到一阵剧烈的疼痛。
example.en: He felt a sharp pain in his lower back.

example.zh: 由于天气原因，飞机不得不返回机场。
example.en: Because of the weather, the plane had to return to the airport.

example.zh: 情人节那天，他送给女朋友一束红玫瑰。
example.en: On Valentine's Day, he gave his girlfriend a bouquet of red roses.

example.zh: 过度使用手机对眼睛不好。
example.en: Overusing mobile phones is bad for your eyes.

gloss: rich, wealthy; to be full of, to possess
meanings: to be rich in; to be replete with

example.zh: 他虽然很富有，但生活很简朴。
example.en: Although he's very wealthy, he lives very simply.

example.zh: 旅游业已经成为当地的支柱产业。
example.en: Tourism has become a pillar industry of the area.

gloss: to live; to reside; to dwell

example.zh: 他在这个城市已经居住了十年。
example.en: He has lived in this city for ten years.

meanings: "house on a cliff" radical in Chinese characters (Kangxi radical 53), occurring in 店, 序, 底 etc

example.zh: 这个人人脉很广，在哪儿都能找到朋友帮忙。
example.en: This person has a wide network and can find friends to help wherever he goes.

example.zh: 这条公交线路经过市中心，坐的人特别多。
example.en: This bus route goes through the city centre, so lots of people take it.

example.zh: 这个箱子太沉了，我一个人搬不动。
example.en: This box is too heavy; I can't move it on my own.

example.zh: 退休后，他搬到乡村去住了，每天种种菜、养养花。
example.en: After retiring, he moved to the countryside, where he grows vegetables and flowers every day.

gloss: measure word for groups or bands of people; group, partner
indonesian: kata penggolong untuk kelompok orang; kelompok, rekan

example.zh: 一伙小偷在火车站被警察抓住了。
example.en: A gang of thieves was caught by the police at the train station.

gloss: to renovate; to decorate (a home); renovation

example.zh: 我们的新房子还在装修，下个月才能搬进去。
example.en: Our new home is still being renovated; we can't move in until next month.

gloss: to fill, to fill in (a form)
meanings: (of a form etc) to fill in

example.zh: 报名的时候，请用黑色的笔填这张表。
example.en: When you register, please fill in this form with a black pen.

example.zh: 我和他住在同一个小区，经常一起坐车上班。
example.en: He and I live in the same residential complex and often commute together.

example.zh: 离出发只剩半个小时了，时间有限，大家抓紧。
example.en: There's only half an hour left before we set off; time is limited, so everyone hurry up.

example.zh: 你不要过于担心，问题不大。
example.en: Don't worry too much; it's not a big problem.

example.zh: 这种植物在温暖湿润的地方生长得很快。
example.en: This plant grows quickly in warm, humid places.

gloss: midnight, the middle of the night
meanings: in the middle of the night

example.zh: 半夜里，楼上突然传来一阵吵闹声。
example.en: In the middle of the night, a racket suddenly came from upstairs.

example.zh: 这家餐厅的菜很有地方特色。
example.en: The dishes at this restaurant have a strong local character.

example.zh: 这款手机的用户已经超过一亿。
example.en: This phone now has more than a hundred million users.

example.zh: 开往上海的列车马上就要出发了。
example.en: The train to Shanghai is about to depart.

example.zh: 这道菜是当地有名的美味，来这里一定要尝尝。
example.en: This dish is a famous local delicacy; you must try it when you come here.

example.zh: 天气不好，对我们的比赛很不利。
example.en: The bad weather is very unfavourable for our match.

example.zh: 这次考试的难度比上次大多了。
example.en: This exam was much harder than the last one.

example.zh: 这条铁路连接了南北两个大城市。
example.en: This railway connects two big cities in the north and south.

example.zh: 她的目光落在了那幅画上。
example.en: Her gaze fell on that painting.

example.zh: 他的发言简短而有力，赢得了大家的掌声。
example.en: His speech was short and forceful and won everyone's applause.

gloss: to agree on, to arrange; agreement, appointment

example.zh: 我们约定每年这个时候在这里见面。
example.en: We agreed to meet here at this time every year.

example.zh: 在这个时代，掌握一门技能很重要。
example.en: In this day and age, it's important to master a skill.

example.zh: 读书给我带来了很多乐趣。
example.en: Reading has brought me a lot of pleasure.

example.zh: 他是一位知名的作家，写过很多畅销书。
example.en: He's a well-known writer who has written many bestsellers.

example.zh: 裁判认为这个球是有效的。
example.en: The referee ruled that the goal counted.

example.zh: 他从不迟到，每天都是第一个到办公室。
example.en: He's never late; he's the first to arrive at the office every day.

example.zh: 天渐渐黑了，路上的行人也少了。
example.en: It gradually got dark, and there were fewer people on the street.

gloss: to strengthen, to enhance, to increase

example.zh: 经常锻炼可以增强体质，少生病。
example.en: Regular exercise can build up your health so you get ill less often.

gloss: to hold, to grasp, to grip
meanings: (bound form) to have in one's control

example.zh: 他紧紧握住我的手，说了声谢谢。
example.en: He gripped my hand tightly and said thank you.

example.zh: 婚礼上的新娘看起来特别幸福。
example.en: The bride at the wedding looked especially happy.

example.zh: 去年他在一场车祸中受了重伤，住了三个月医院。
example.en: Last year he was seriously injured in a car accident and spent three months in hospital.

example.zh: 电梯正在维修，请走楼梯。
example.en: The elevator is under repair; please take the stairs.

gloss: whole, full, fully (an entire amount of time, etc.)

example.zh: 你怎么现在才来？我整整等了你两个小时！
example.en: Why are you only getting here now? I waited for you for two whole hours!

example.zh: 他把手机放进了外套口袋里。
example.en: He put his phone in his coat pocket.

example.zh: 抽烟是一种不良习惯，对自己和家人都不好。
example.en: Smoking is a bad habit that's harmful to both you and your family.

example.zh: 年轻人有着无限的可能，不要轻易放弃梦想。
example.en: Young people have endless possibilities; don't give up your dreams lightly.

example.zh: 他待人真诚，大家都愿意和他交朋友。
example.en: He treats people sincerely, so everyone wants to be his friend.

gloss: to come, to come forward (to a place)

example.zh: 感谢各位前来参加今天的活动。
example.en: Thank you all for coming to today's event.

example.zh: 很多年轻人通过网络平台卖自己做的东西。
example.en: Many young people sell things they make through online platforms.

gloss: basis; foundation; according to; to go by

example.zh: 你这么说有什么依据吗？
example.en: What is your basis for saying that?

example.zh: 他每个月挣的钱只够付房租。
example.en: The money he earns each month is only enough to pay the rent.

example.zh: 有什么想法就大胆说出来，不要害怕说错。
example.en: If you have any ideas, speak up boldly; don't be afraid of saying something wrong.

example.zh: 宝宝张开嘴巴，等着妈妈喂饭。
example.en: The baby opened its mouth, waiting for Mum to feed it.

gloss: to leave a message; message, comment

example.zh: 他不在家，我就在微信上给他留言了。
example.en: He wasn't home, so I left him a message on WeChat.

example.zh: 这个城市有众多的名胜古迹。
example.en: This city has numerous scenic spots and historic sites.

gloss: mistake; slip; error; to make a mistake

example.zh: 他在比赛中的一个小失误导致了失败。
example.en: One small mistake of his in the match led to defeat.

example.zh: 这种食品的糖含量很高，糖尿病人不能吃。
example.en: This food has a high sugar content, so diabetics can't eat it.

example.zh: 每天早晚刷牙才能保护好牙齿。
example.en: Brushing morning and night is the way to keep your teeth healthy.

example.zh: 这盒月饼的包装非常精美。
example.en: The packaging of this box of mooncakes is very exquisite.

gloss: to open (a service or line), to activate
meanings: to open (a new road or railway line); to set up (a hotline); to launch (a service); to subscribe to (a members-only service)

example.zh: 这条地铁线路将于下个月正式开通。
example.en: This subway line will officially open next month.

gloss: to increase, to add, to grow
meanings: (bound form) to increase; to augment; to add to

example.zh: 今年来这里旅游的人数比去年增了一倍。
example.en: The number of tourists here this year has doubled compared to last year.

gloss: all around, everywhere, in all directions

example.zh: 他四处打听，终于找到了那家老店。
example.en: He asked around everywhere and finally found that old shop.

gloss: patient's condition, state of an illness

example.zh: 经过治疗，他的病情已经稳定了。
example.en: After treatment, his condition has stabilized.

example.zh: 图书馆是学习的好场所，环境很安静。
example.en: The library is a good place to study; it is very quiet.

gloss: to select, to choose, to pick out

example.zh: 她在商店里挑选了半天，最后买了一条红裙子。
example.en: She spent ages choosing in the shop and finally bought a red skirt.

example.zh: 原材料涨价，生产成本也提高了。
example.en: Raw materials went up in price, so production costs rose too.

example.zh: 春节是和亲人团聚的日子，大家都想回家过年。
example.en: The Spring Festival is a time to reunite with family, and everyone wants to go home for the New Year.

meanings: for a long time; long since

example.zh: 等我们到的时候，电影早已开始了。
example.en: By the time we arrived, the film had long since started.

example.zh: 充足的睡眠对健康很重要，成年人每天最好睡七八个小时。
example.en: Getting enough sleep is very important for health; adults should ideally sleep seven or eight hours a day.

example.zh: 晚上城市里灯光闪闪，非常漂亮。
example.en: At night the city's lights twinkle; it's beautiful.

example.zh: 这幅画色彩鲜艳，看起来很有活力。
example.en: This painting has bright colors and looks very lively.

gloss: to innovate; innovation; to bring forth new ideas
meanings: to bring forth new ideas; to blaze new trails

example.zh: 企业只有不断创新，才能在竞争中生存。
example.en: Only by constantly innovating can a company survive the competition.

example.zh: 这张优惠券已经过期了，现在使用无效。
example.en: This coupon has expired and is no longer valid.

gloss: oh my! ah! (expressing surprise, regret or complaint)
meanings: interjection of wonder, shock or admiration

example.zh: 哎呀，我出门的时候忘带钥匙了！
example.en: Oh no, I forgot my keys when I went out!

example.zh: 公司今年招了二十多个新人。
example.en: The company has hired more than twenty newcomers this year.

gloss: just right, exactly; as it happens, by chance

example.zh: 这双鞋我穿着刚好，不大也不小。
example.en: These shoes fit me just right, neither too big nor too small.

example.zh: 比赛结束时，比分是三比二，我们赢了。
example.en: When the game ended, the score was 3 to 2; we won.

gloss: up and down; from top to bottom; everyone (high and low)
indonesian: atas dan bawah; dari atas sampai bawah; semua (atasan dan bawahan)

example.zh: 他上下打量了我一番，问我找谁。
example.en: He looked me up and down and asked who I was looking for.

example.zh: 这家餐厅用机器人给客人送菜。
example.en: This restaurant uses robots to deliver dishes to customers.

example.zh: 这家学校专门为成人提供外语课程。
example.en: This school offers foreign language courses specifically for adults.

gloss: to be at a distance from; distance

example.zh: 我家距学校只有五百米，走路几分钟就到。
example.en: My home is only 500 metres from the school; it's a few minutes' walk.

gloss: along; to follow (a road, river); edge
meanings: to trim (a border with braid, tape etc)

example.zh: 吃完晚饭，我们沿着河边走了很久。
example.en: After dinner, we walked along the river for a long time.

gloss: complexion, colour of the face; facial expression

example.zh: 你脸色不太好，是不是生病了？
example.en: You don't look well. Are you ill?

example.zh: 超市里的生活用品种类很多。
example.en: The supermarket has a wide range of household items.

gloss: to be good at; to be skilled in
meanings: to be good at; to be expert in

example.zh: 她擅长用简单的语言解释复杂的问题。
example.en: She is good at explaining complicated problems in simple language.

example.zh: 这次只是一个小型聚会，来的都是老朋友。
example.en: This is just a small get-together; everyone coming is an old friend.

example.zh: 当前最重要的任务是提高产品质量。
example.en: The most important task at present is to improve product quality.

gloss: to take a turn for the better, to improve
meanings: to take a turn for the better

example.zh: 吃了几天药，他的病情有所好转。
example.en: After a few days of medicine, his condition improved somewhat.

meanings: early period; early phase; early stage

example.zh: 这种病如果在早期发现，是可以治好的。
example.en: If this disease is found at an early stage, it can be cured.

gloss: rare; hard to come by; seldom
indonesian: langka; jarang ada; sulit didapat; jarang-jarang

example.zh: 这是一次难得的机会，你一定要抓住。
example.en: This is a rare opportunity; you must seize it.

gloss: to tell, to narrate, to give an account of

example.zh: 这本书讲述了一个普通家庭的故事。
example.en: This book tells the story of an ordinary family.

meanings: (used in the names of grand buildings such as 百老汇大厦 Broadway Mansions (in Shanghai) or 帝国大厦 Empire State Building etc)

example.zh: 我们公司在市中心的一座大厦里。
example.en: Our company is in a large building in the city center.

gloss: to damage, to harm, to impair

example.zh: 长期熬夜会损害身体健康，一定要注意休息。
example.en: Staying up late for long periods damages your health, so make sure you get enough rest.

meanings: quality (of a product or service, or as in "quality of life", "air quality" etc)

example.zh: 诚实是一个人最重要的品质。
example.en: Honesty is the most important quality a person can have.

gloss: to set up; to establish; to found

example.zh: 学校设立了奖学金，鼓励学生努力学习。
example.en: The school set up a scholarship to encourage students to study hard.

example.zh: 这些老照片对我来说非常珍贵。
example.en: These old photos are very precious to me.

gloss: to compensate, to pay for (damage); to lose money

example.zh: 你把我的手机摔坏了，得赔我一个新的。
example.en: You broke my phone, so you have to replace it with a new one.

example.zh: 她从小就喜欢写作，现在是一名作家。
example.en: She has loved writing since she was little, and now she is an author.

example.zh: 他是一位成功的商人，在全国开了几十家店。
example.en: He's a successful businessman who has opened dozens of shops around the country.

example.zh: 糟了，我把护照忘在酒店了，飞机马上就要起飞了！
example.en: Oh no, I left my passport at the hotel, and the plane is about to take off!

example.zh: 他是一位研究中国历史的著名学者。
example.en: He's a famous scholar of Chinese history.

example.zh: 这个季度公司的销售额增长了百分之十。
example.en: The company's sales grew by ten percent this quarter.

gloss: all around, on all sides, surroundings

example.zh: 房子四周都是树，非常安静，很适合养老。
example.en: The house is surrounded by trees and is very quiet, perfect for retirement.

example.zh: 包括我在内，一共有十个人参加。
example.en: Including me, ten people took part in total.

gloss: to contain, to have (as an ingredient)

example.zh: 牛奶中含有丰富的钙，对骨骼很有好处。
example.en: Milk contains plenty of calcium, which is very good for your bones.

example.zh: 演讲结束后，台下响起了热烈的掌声。
example.en: After the speech, warm applause rang out from the audience.

gloss: to receive (signals, goods); to accept, to take in

example.zh: 这台收音机可以接收到很多国外的电台。
example.en: This radio can pick up many foreign stations.

example.zh: 春天，农民们把种子播进了田里。
example.en: In spring, the farmers sowed the seeds in the fields.

gloss: to update; to renew; to replace the old with the new
meanings: to replace the old with new

example.zh: 我的手机系统需要更新了。
example.en: My phone's system needs updating.

gloss: to push forward, to promote, to drive
meanings: to push (e.g. for acceptance of a plan); to promote; to give impetus to

example.zh: 科技的进步推动了社会的发展。
example.en: Advances in technology have driven social development.

example.zh: 这个方法不一定适用于每个人。
example.en: This method doesn't necessarily work for everyone.

gloss: key (on a keyboard or instrument), button
meanings: key (on a piano or computer keyboard)
button (on a mouse or other device)

example.zh: 输入密码后，按确认键就可以了。
example.en: After entering the password, just press the confirm button.

example.zh: 退休以后，他一点也闲不住，每天都找事做。
example.en: After retiring, he can't sit idle at all and finds something to do every day.

gloss: to initiate, to launch, to start
meanings: to launch (an attack, an initiative etc)
to propose sth (for the first time)

example.zh: 他发起了一个帮助山区孩子的活动。
example.en: He launched a campaign to help children in mountain areas.

example.zh: 装修这套房子花费了我们二十多万元。
example.en: Renovating this flat cost us more than two hundred thousand yuan.

gloss: drum; to bulge, to swell; to rouse, to encourage; bulging
indonesian: gendang, drum; menggembung; membangkitkan, mendorong; gembung

example.zh: 舞台上，几个年轻人正在敲鼓，声音非常响。
example.en: On stage, a few young people are beating drums very loudly.

example.zh: 来这里旅游的大多是年轻人。
example.en: Most of the tourists who come here are young people.

example.zh: 这首歌的歌词写得很美，像一首诗。
example.en: The lyrics of this song are beautifully written, like a poem.

example.zh: 他对自己的现状并不满意，想换个工作。
example.en: He isn't happy with his current situation and wants to change jobs.

example.zh: 最近流感很严重，出门最好戴口罩。
example.en: The flu is really bad at the moment, so it's best to wear a mask when you go out.

gloss: to travel, to drive, to run (of a vehicle)
meanings: to travel along a route (of vehicles etc)

example.zh: 车辆在雨天行驶时，一定要减慢速度。
example.en: Vehicles must slow down when driving in the rain.

example.zh: 这次旅行的花费超出了我们的预算。
example.en: The cost of this trip went over our budget.

example.zh: 医生说他应该注意饮食，少吃油腻的东西。
example.en: The doctor said he should watch his diet and eat less greasy food.

example.zh: 夜深了，门外忽然传来一阵脚步声。
example.en: Late at night, the sound of footsteps suddenly came from outside the door.

gloss: to accompany, to keep someone company; companionship

example.zh: 谢谢你这些年一直陪伴在我身边。
example.en: Thank you for always being by my side all these years.

example.zh: 很多大学生报名当了运动会的志愿者。
example.en: Many university students signed up as volunteers for the sports games.

example.zh: 她看完信，眼里含着泪，半天说不出话来。
example.en: After reading the letter, she had tears in her eyes and couldn't speak for a long while.

example.zh: 这批货物明天上午就能运到仓库。
example.en: This batch of goods will reach the warehouse tomorrow morning.

example.zh: 老年人是一个需要社会更多关心的群体。
example.en: The elderly are a group that needs more care from society.

example.zh: 请在本周五之前把论文提交给导师。
example.en: Please submit your thesis to your supervisor by this Friday.

indonesian: buatan; buatan manusia; tenaga manusia; kerja manual

example.zh: 这片湖是人工挖出来的，并不是天然的。
example.en: This lake was dug by people; it is not natural.

gloss: to share (use or enjoy in common)

example.zh: 这几个部门共享一台打印机，用的时候得排队。
example.en: These departments share one printer, so you have to wait your turn to use it.

example.zh: 做生意最重要的是讲信用，不能欺骗顾客。
example.en: The most important thing in business is to keep your word; you must never cheat customers.

example.zh: 他在城里工作了十年，最后还是决定回乡种地。
example.en: After ten years working in the city, he finally decided to go back to his village and farm.

example.zh: 今晚天上一片云都没有，星星看得特别清楚。
example.en: There isn't a single cloud in the sky tonight, so the stars are especially clear.

example.zh: 他这次去上海是为了商务谈判。
example.en: He went to Shanghai this time for business negotiations.

gloss: to recycle; to reclaim; to recover
indonesian: mendaur ulang; mengumpulkan kembali; menarik kembali

example.zh: 这些塑料瓶可以回收再利用。
example.en: These plastic bottles can be recycled and reused.

gloss: to deposit money; savings, bank deposit
meanings: to deposit money (in a bank etc)

example.zh: 他每个月都会去银行存款，准备以后买房。
example.en: He goes to the bank every month to deposit money, saving up to buy a home.

example.zh: 这只是一个短期项目，大概三个月就能完成。
example.en: This is just a short-term project; it should be done in about three months.

example.zh: 这条河最深的地方，深度超过十米。
example.en: At its deepest point, this river is more than ten metres deep.

gloss: to stay (for a while); to stop over

example.zh: 我们在上海只停留两天，然后就去杭州。
example.en: We're only staying in Shanghai for two days, then going on to Hangzhou.

example.zh: 文章太长了，编辑让我删掉一半内容。
example.en: The article is too long; the editor told me to cut half of it.

example.zh: 本次活动的具体安排如下，请大家仔细阅读。
example.en: The detailed arrangements for this event are as follows; please read them carefully.

example.zh: 我小时候是外婆带大的，所以跟她特别亲。
example.en: I was raised by my grandma when I was little, so I'm especially close to her.

example.zh: 他从小的梦想就是当一名飞行员，开飞机上天。
example.en: His childhood dream was to become a pilot and fly planes.

example.zh: 这里交通便利，买东西也很方便。
example.en: Transport here is convenient, and shopping is easy too.

indonesian: tenaga besar; dengan gencar, sekuat tenaga

example.zh: 政府正在大力发展新能源汽车。
example.en: The government is vigorously developing new-energy vehicles.

gloss: to carry out; to launch; to develop; to unfold

example.zh: 学校开展了丰富多彩的课外活动。
example.en: The school runs a wide variety of extracurricular activities.

indonesian: tahan lama; untuk waktu yang lama

example.zh: 靠骗人赚钱的生意是不会长久的。
example.en: A business that makes money by cheating people won't last long.

gloss: the Chinese nation; the Chinese people
meanings: the Chinese people (collective reference to all the ethnic groups in China)

example.zh: 春节是中华民族最重要的传统节日。
example.en: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival of the Chinese nation.

example.zh: 这两个国家在经济上的联系非常紧密。
example.en: The economic ties between these two countries are very close.

example.zh: 爬了一上午的山，大家的体力都快用完了。
example.en: After climbing the mountain all morning, everyone was nearly out of energy.

gloss: to regard as; to treat as

example.zh: 在中国，红色被视为吉祥的颜色。
example.en: In China, red is regarded as a lucky colour.

example.zh: 李白是中国历史上最有名的诗人之一。
example.en: Li Bai is one of the most famous poets in Chinese history.

gloss: to interrupt; to cut off (someone speaking)

example.zh: 别人说话的时候，随便打断是很不礼貌的。
example.en: It's very rude to interrupt when someone else is talking.

meanings: colloquial (rather than literary) pronunciation of a Chinese character

example.zh: 学汉语的时候，语音和声调一定要打好基础。
example.en: When learning Chinese, you must build a solid foundation in pronunciation and tones.

gloss: to pay attention to; to attach importance to; to emphasize

example.zh: 这所学校很注重培养学生的动手能力。
example.en: This school puts great emphasis on developing students' practical skills.

example.zh: 为了不影响居民休息，这里禁止夜间施工。
example.en: To avoid disturbing residents, construction is banned here at night.

gloss: to help; to be conducive to, to contribute to

example.zh: 每天坚持运动有助于提高睡眠质量。
example.en: Exercising every day helps improve the quality of your sleep.

gloss: to use one's strength; to exert oneself

example.zh: 瓶盖太紧了，我用力拧了半天才打开。
example.en: The bottle cap was really tight; I had to twist hard for ages to get it open.

gloss: to dial (a phone number); to call

example.zh: 如果遇到火灾，请立即拨打119报警。
example.en: If there's a fire, call 119 immediately.

gloss: to process; to machine; to polish (work); processing

example.zh: 这些水果经过加工，做成了果汁。
example.en: This fruit was processed and made into juice.

example.zh: 这次旅行的行程安排得太满了，大家都很累。
example.en: The itinerary for this trip was too packed, and everyone was exhausted.

gloss: to record; to put down in writing; record; account

example.zh: 这本书详细记载了当地的风俗习惯。
example.en: This book records the local customs in detail.

example.zh: 城市和农村之间的收入差距还很大。
example.en: The income gap between cities and the countryside is still large.

example.zh: 通过考试后，你会拿到一张证书。
example.en: After passing the exam, you will receive a certificate.

example.zh: 护士每隔两个小时就到病房查看一次。
example.en: The nurse comes to check on the ward every two hours.

example.zh: 这家公司每年都投入大量资金研发新产品。
example.en: This company invests heavily in developing new products every year.

example.zh: 参加面试的时候，他特意穿了一套西装。
example.en: He made a point of wearing a suit to the job interview.

example.zh: 英语一共有二十六个字母。
example.en: English has twenty-six letters in total.

example.zh: 忙碌了一整天，他终于可以休息了。
example.en: After a whole busy day, he could finally rest.

example.zh: 今天天空是灰色的，看样子快要下雨了。
example.en: The sky is grey today; it looks like it's about to rain.

gloss: to bind; to tie; to restrain; measure word for bunches or bundles
indonesian: mengikat; membatasi; kata satuan untuk ikat atau berkas
meanings: classifier for bunches, bundles, beams of light etc

example.zh: 毕业那天，我收到了一束鲜花。
example.en: On graduation day I received a bunch of flowers.

gloss: sales volume; number of units sold

example.zh: 这款手机上个月的销量突破了一百万台。
example.en: Sales of this phone passed one million units last month.

example.zh: 图书馆的书都是按照内容分类摆放的。
example.en: The library's books are shelved by subject.

example.zh: 这座大楼的外部正在重新装修。
example.en: The outside of this building is being renovated.

example.zh: 这个房间阳光充足，非常适合养花。
example.en: This room gets plenty of sunlight and is perfect for growing flowers.

gloss: name (of a thing or organization); designation

example.zh: 请在表格里填上公司的名称和地址。
example.en: Please fill in the company's name and address on the form.

gloss: upward; to go up; to strive upward

example.zh: 电梯正在向上运行，请稍等一下。
example.en: The lift is going up; please wait a moment.

gloss: to make an appointment; to book in advance

example.zh: 这家医院看病需要提前在网上预约。
example.en: To see a doctor at this hospital, you need to book online in advance.

gloss: to rescue; to save (a life); to give emergency treatment

example.zh: 经过医生的全力抢救，病人终于脱离了危险。
example.en: After the doctors' all-out efforts, the patient was finally out of danger.

gloss: to replace; to change (for a new one)

example.zh: 手机电池已经用了三年，该更换了。
example.en: The phone battery has been in use for three years; it's time to replace it.

example.zh: 他在地铁上丢失了钱包，赶紧去报了警。
example.en: He lost his wallet on the subway and quickly reported it to the police.

gloss: the near future; the recent period

example.zh: 近期天气变化大，大家要注意别感冒。
example.en: The weather has been changeable lately, so be careful not to catch a cold.

gloss: to judge; to evaluate; to comment on

example.zh: 老师让同学们互相评一评作文写得怎么样。
example.en: The teacher had the students assess each other's essays.

example.zh: 大雪天路很滑，车辆都在缓慢行驶。
example.en: The roads are slippery in the heavy snow, and cars are moving slowly.

gloss: to walk; to go on foot

example.zh: 手术以后，他已经可以慢慢下地行走了。
example.en: Since the operation, he's been able to get out of bed and walk slowly.

gloss: to come from; to originate from (a source)

example.zh: 这句名言出自《论语》，很多人都会背。
example.en: This famous saying comes from the Analects, and many people know it by heart.

example.zh: 他每天都是第一个到公司，由此可见他工作有多认真。
example.en: He's the first to arrive at the office every day, which shows how seriously he takes his work.

example.zh: 这套房子的租金是每个月三千块。
example.en: The rent for this flat is three thousand yuan a month.

example.zh: 现在人人都离不开智能手机。
example.en: Nowadays nobody can do without a smartphone.

indonesian: sikap mental; pola pikir; kondisi batin

example.zh: 考试的时候，保持良好的心态很重要。
example.en: During exams, keeping a positive state of mind is important.

example.zh: 这次考试虽然有几道题很难，但总体来说不算太难。
example.en: There were a few hard questions in this exam, but overall it wasn't too difficult.

gloss: to log in; to sign in; to register

example.zh: 请先登录你的账号，再提交作业。
example.en: Please log in to your account first, then submit your homework.

gloss: to deal with; to cope with; to respond to

example.zh: 面对突发情况，他总能冷静地应对。
example.en: When something unexpected happens, he always handles it calmly.

example.zh: 这个房间光线太暗，不适合看书。
example.en: The light in this room is too dim for reading.

example.zh: 最近的工作强度太大，他每天都加班到深夜。
example.en: His workload has been so intense lately that he works overtime until late every night.

example.zh: 为了保护环境，很多餐厅已经不提供一次性筷子了。
example.en: To protect the environment, many restaurants no longer provide disposable chopsticks.

gloss: to change; to fluctuate; change, alteration

example.zh: 由于天气原因，航班时间可能会有变动。
example.en: Due to the weather, flight times may change.

example.zh: 周末我们去河边烧烤吧，我负责带肉。
example.en: Let's have a barbecue by the river this weekend; I'll bring the meat.

example.zh: 这种新型材料又轻又结实，很适合造飞机。
example.en: This new type of material is light and strong, ideal for building aircraft.

example.zh: 这位老师上课时很注意和学生互动。
example.en: This teacher makes a point of interacting with students in class.

example.zh: 他在这家公司工作了将近十年。
example.en: He has worked at this company for nearly ten years.

example.zh: 比赛还没开始，赛场上已经坐满了观众。
example.en: The match hadn't started yet, but the arena was already full of spectators.

example.zh: 机器代替了人力，工厂的效率提高了很多。
example.en: Machines have replaced manual labour, and the factory's efficiency has risen a lot.

gloss: to lower one's head; to give in

example.zh: 她害羞地低头笑了笑，一句话也没说。
example.en: She lowered her head and smiled shyly without saying a word.

example.zh: 父母都希望子女将来能过上好日子。
example.en: All parents hope their children will have a good life in the future.

gloss: to face; to be aimed at, oriented toward

example.zh: 我家的阳台面向大海，风景特别好。
example.en: Our balcony faces the sea and has a wonderful view.

example.zh: 现在的消费者买东西时越来越重视质量。
example.en: Today's consumers care more and more about quality when they shop.

gloss: to plant; to grow; to cultivate
meanings: to plant; to grow (a crop); to cultivate

example.zh: 这里的农民主要种植水稻。
example.en: The farmers here mainly grow rice.

example.zh: 大城市的住房价格太高，年轻人很难买得起。
example.en: Housing in big cities is so expensive that young people can hardly afford it.

gloss: after this; afterwards; from then on

example.zh: 他们十年前见过一面，此后再也没有联系过。
example.en: They met once ten years ago and have never been in touch since.

gloss: to pack; to wrap up; to get a doggy bag
indonesian: mengemas; membungkus (makanan sisa untuk dibawa pulang)
meanings: to put leftovers in a doggy bag for take-out
(computing) to package (i.e. create an archive file)

example.zh: 菜没吃完，我们打包带回家吧。
example.en: We didn't finish the food, so let's pack it up and take it home.

gloss: regularly; at regular intervals; fixed-term; periodical
meanings: limited to a fixed period of time

example.zh: 你应该定期去医院检查身体。
example.en: You should go to the hospital for regular check-ups.

example.zh: 这个动人的故事让在场的人都流下了眼泪。
example.en: This moving story brought everyone present to tears.

example.zh: 这家超市水果种类很多，价格也不贵。
example.en: This supermarket has many kinds of fruit, and the prices aren't high.

example.zh: 适量喝茶对身体是有益的，但不要喝得太浓。
example.en: Drinking tea in moderation is good for you, but don't drink it too strong.

example.zh: 天气好的时候，孩子们应该多去户外活动。
example.en: When the weather is nice, children should spend more time playing outdoors.

example.zh: 地震发生后，灾区急需大量饮用水和药品。
example.en: After the earthquake, the disaster area urgently needs large amounts of drinking water and medicine.

gloss: to rely on; by virtue of; by means of

example.zh: 她凭借出色的表演获得了最佳女演员奖。
example.en: She won the Best Actress award for her outstanding performance.

gloss: to regard as; to look upon as

example.zh: 很多人把读书看作改变命运的唯一出路。
example.en: Many people see studying as the only way to change their fate.

example.zh: 冬天的橘子又甜又多汁，我一次能吃好几个。
example.en: Tangerines in winter are sweet and juicy; I can eat several at a time.

example.zh: 今晚剧场里有一场话剧演出，票早就卖完了。
example.en: There's a play on at the theatre tonight, and the tickets sold out long ago.

example.zh: 吸烟对身体有害，这是大家都知道的。
example.en: Everyone knows smoking is bad for your health.

gloss: to open for business; to start a business

example.zh: 我们小区门口那家超市装修好了，明天正式开业。
example.en: The supermarket at the entrance to our neighbourhood has finished its fit-out and officially opens tomorrow.

example.zh: 这家书店的图书种类很多，什么书都能找到。
example.en: This bookshop has a huge range of books; you can find anything there.

example.zh: 听到儿子考上大学的消息，妈妈的眼里充满了泪水。
example.en: When she heard her son had got into university, the mother's eyes filled with tears.

example.zh: 出门前要记得关掉家里的电器。
example.en: Remember to switch off the electrical appliances at home before you go out.

gloss: to walk; to go on foot

example.zh: 我家离学校很近，每天步行上学。
example.en: I live close to school, so I walk there every day.

example.zh: 政府采取了很多措施帮助大学生就业。
example.en: The government has taken many measures to help graduates find jobs.

example.zh: 我时常想起小时候在乡下的生活。
example.en: I often think of my childhood in the countryside.

example.zh: 孩子用彩色铅笔画了一幅春天的画。
example.en: The child drew a picture of spring with coloured pencils.

gloss: to rise; to go up (prices, water level)

example.zh: 最近菜价上涨得很厉害，买菜都得精打细算。
example.en: Vegetable prices have risen sharply lately, so you have to budget carefully when shopping.

example.zh: 遇到困难时，不要有消极的想法。
example.en: When you run into difficulties, don't think negatively.

gloss: to watch (a TV program or broadcast)

example.zh: 每年除夕，全国有几亿人收看春节联欢晚会。
example.en: Every New Year's Eve, hundreds of millions of people across the country watch the Spring Festival Gala.

example.zh: 这家公司的产品已经销往海外几十个国家。
example.en: This company's products are now sold in dozens of countries overseas.

example.zh: 他大学毕业后考上了公务员，在市政府工作。
example.en: After graduating he passed the civil service exam and now works for the city government.

meanings: to pay a visit to; to see (sb)

example.zh: 周末我要去医院看望生病的奶奶。
example.en: This weekend I'm going to the hospital to visit my sick grandma.

example.zh: 穿羽绒服可以减少身体热量的散失。
example.en: Wearing a down jacket reduces the loss of body heat.

gloss: morning and evening; sooner or later
indonesian: pagi dan malam; cepat atau lambat
meanings: (dialect) some time in the future; some day

example.zh: 这种药一天吃两次，早晚各一次。
example.en: Take this medicine twice a day, once in the morning and once in the evening.

gloss: to lose (money); to suffer a loss

example.zh: 这次投资他亏了十几万，心情很不好。
example.en: He lost over a hundred thousand yuan on this investment and is feeling terrible.

example.zh: 这条裤子的长度刚好合适，不用再改了。
example.en: These trousers are just the right length; they don't need altering.

meanings: to agree to and sign (a treaty etc)

example.zh: 双方经过多次谈判，终于签订了合作协议。
example.en: After many rounds of negotiation, the two sides finally signed a cooperation agreement.

gloss: to welcome; to greet; to go to meet
meanings: to forge ahead (esp. in the face of difficulties); to meet face to face

example.zh: 春节前，家家户户都贴春联迎新年。
example.en: Before the Spring Festival, every household puts up couplets to welcome the New Year.

example.zh: 公园的湖里有几只鸭子在游来游去。
example.en: A few ducks are swimming around on the lake in the park.

example.zh: 这辆车停在路中间，警察正在联系车主。
example.en: This car is parked in the middle of the road, and the police are trying to contact the owner.

example.zh: 中秋节晚上，一家人坐在院子里赏月。
example.en: On the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival, the family sat in the yard admiring the moon.

gloss: to introduce (from outside); to bring in, to import

example.zh: 这家工厂从国外引进了一套先进的生产设备。
example.en: This factory brought in a set of advanced production equipment from abroad.

gloss: to charge (a battery); to recharge oneself (by learning)
meanings: to update one's skills and knowledge

example.zh: 我的手机快没电了，得赶紧充电。
example.en: My phone's almost dead; I need to charge it right away.

example.zh: 超市正在搞促销，很多商品都买一送一。
example.en: The supermarket is running a promotion, with lots of items buy one, get one free.

example.zh: 饭菜有点凉了，放进微波炉加热一下吧。
example.en: The food has gone a bit cold; put it in the microwave to heat it up.

example.zh: 现在很多人骑电动自行车上班，又快又方便。
example.en: Lots of people now ride e-bikes to work; it's fast and convenient.

gloss: to give as a present; to present

example.zh: 商店向每位顾客赠送一份小礼品。
example.en: The shop gives every customer a small gift.

example.zh: 这篇文章的标题很吸引人。
example.en: The title of this article is very eye-catching.

example.zh: 番茄炒鸡蛋是一道很受欢迎的家常菜。
example.en: Tomato and scrambled egg is a very popular home-style dish.

gloss: metaphor; analogy; figure of speech; to compare

example.zh: 人们常把老师比喻成园丁。
example.en: People often compare teachers to gardeners.

example.zh: 新郎和新娘一起向客人敬酒。
example.en: The groom and bride toasted the guests together.

example.zh: 我的护照下个月就到期了，得赶快去办新的。
example.en: My passport expires next month; I need to get a new one quickly.

example.zh: 这座城市正在修建一条新的地铁线。
example.en: The city is building a new subway line.

example.zh: 他长得又高大又结实，一看就是运动员。
example.en: He's tall and sturdy; you can tell at a glance he's an athlete.

example.zh: 这部动画片讲的是一只小熊猫的故事。
example.en: This cartoon tells the story of a little panda.

gloss: to research and produce; to develop (equipment, medicine)
meanings: to research and manufacture; to research and to develop

example.zh: 科学家们经过多年努力，终于研制出了这种新药。
example.en: After years of work, the scientists finally developed this new drug.

gloss: to come of age; to become an adult; adult

example.zh: 在中国，年满十八岁就算成年了。
example.en: In China, you are considered an adult once you turn eighteen.

example.zh: 这家工厂规模很大，有两千多名职工。
example.en: This is a big factory with more than two thousand workers.

example.zh: 做决定不能只看眼前，要从长远考虑。
example.en: When making decisions, don't just look at the present; think about the long term.

example.zh: 这本书的印刷质量非常好。
example.en: The printing quality of this book is excellent.

example.zh: 这座建筑的外形像一只鸟，非常特别。
example.en: This building is shaped like a bird; it's really unusual.

gloss: to give as a present; to present
meanings: to bestow an honorary title after death (old)

example.zh: 凡在本店消费满一百元，即赠一瓶饮料。
example.en: Spend over one hundred yuan in our shop and get a free drink.

gloss: uncle (polite address for an older man); elderly man
meanings: term of respect for older man

example.zh: 大爷，请问去火车站应该怎么走？
example.en: Excuse me, sir, which way is it to the train station?

example.zh: 在这个城市里，他一个熟人都没有。
example.en: He doesn't know a single person in this city.

gloss: to report for duty; to check in; to register

example.zh: 新生必须在九月一日前到学校报到。
example.en: New students must register at the school before September 1st.

example.zh: 创业初期，公司只有三个员工。
example.en: In the early days of the business, the company had only three employees.

example.zh: 现在很多大学都开设了在线课程。
example.en: Many universities now offer online courses.

example.zh: 中国有很多河流，其中最长的是长江。
example.en: China has many rivers, the longest of which is the Yangtze.

gloss: to pass through; to go through (of traffic)

example.zh: 前方道路正在维修，车辆暂时无法通行。
example.en: The road ahead is under repair, and vehicles can't get through for now.

example.zh: 这份工作要求本科以上学历。
example.en: This job requires at least a bachelor's degree.

example.zh: 我们这一代人小时候没有手机，也玩得很开心。
example.en: Our generation had no mobile phones as kids, and we still had lots of fun.

example.zh: 今天是我们结婚十周年纪念日。
example.en: Today is our tenth wedding anniversary.

example.zh: 学校聘请了一位外国专家来教英语。
example.en: The school has hired a foreign expert to teach English.

example.zh: 这家医院的门诊每天早上八点开始挂号。
example.en: This hospital's outpatient department starts registering patients at eight every morning.

example.zh: 离开故乡二十年，他终于回来了。
example.en: After twenty years away from his hometown, he finally came back.

example.zh: 他从小就喜欢收集邮票，已经有上千张了。
example.en: He's loved collecting stamps since he was a kid and now has over a thousand.

gloss: to open (a ceremony, exhibition, or meeting); the curtain rises

example.zh: 国际电影节将于下周三在上海开幕。
example.en: The international film festival will open in Shanghai next Wednesday.

example.zh: 这里雨水充足，山上的树木长得非常茂盛。
example.en: There is plenty of rain here, and the trees on the mountain grow very thickly.

example.zh: 大熊猫是中国特有的珍稀动物。
example.en: The giant panda is a rare animal found only in China.

example.zh: 爸爸生日时，我送了他一条蓝色的领带。
example.en: For Dad's birthday I gave him a blue tie.

example.zh: 我每天早上闹钟一响就起床。
example.en: I get up every morning as soon as my alarm goes off.

gloss: to stay up late; to stay up all night
meanings: to stay up late or all night

example.zh: 你最近经常熬夜，对身体很不好。
example.en: You've been staying up late a lot recently, which is bad for your health.

example.zh: 如果一次买得多，老板一般都会给点折扣。
example.en: If you buy a lot at once, the owner will usually give you a bit of a discount.

gloss: order, sequence; one after another, successively

example.zh: 他先后去过十几个国家，见识非常广。
example.en: He has been to more than a dozen countries over the years and is very well-travelled.

example.zh: 孩子手里拿着一个红色的气球，高兴地跑来跑去。
example.en: The child ran around happily holding a red balloon.

gloss: to dare to; to have the courage to
meanings: to have the courage to do sth

example.zh: 年轻人要敢于尝试新事物，不要怕失败。
example.en: Young people should dare to try new things and not be afraid of failing.

example.zh: 爸爸每天晚上都在书房看书到很晚。
example.en: Dad reads in his study until late every night.

example.zh: 今年全校学生总数已经超过了五千人。
example.en: The school's total enrolment has passed five thousand this year.

example.zh: 这种蘑菇有毒，千万不能食用。
example.en: This mushroom is poisonous and must never be eaten.

gloss: to be greater than; to be more than
meanings: greater than; bigger than; more than

example.zh: 这次改革带来的好处远远大于坏处。
example.en: The benefits of this reform far outweigh the drawbacks.

example.zh: 这个项目已经进入中期，进展比较顺利。
example.en: This project has reached its middle phase and is going fairly smoothly.

example.zh: 这个盒子里头装的是什么？这么重。
example.en: What's inside this box? It's so heavy.

gloss: to store; to leave (in someone's care)

example.zh: 这些药品要存放在阴凉干燥的地方。
example.en: These medicines should be stored in a cool, dry place.

example.zh: 他大学毕业后留在学校从事科研工作。
example.en: After graduating, he stayed at the university to do scientific research.

example.zh: 工厂采用的这种新方法既高效又节能。
example.en: The new method the factory has adopted is both efficient and energy-saving.

example.zh: 这棵树的叶子被虫子吃掉了一大半。
example.en: Most of this tree's leaves have been eaten by insects.

example.zh: 这是他第一次出国，此前他连飞机都没坐过。
example.en: This is his first trip abroad; before this he had never even been on a plane.

meanings: list of words (e.g. for language teaching purposes)

example.zh: 多读书可以帮助你扩大词汇量。
example.en: Reading more can help you expand your vocabulary.

example.zh: 东北产的大米特别香，煮出来的饭很好吃。
example.en: Rice from the Northeast is especially fragrant and cooks up delicious.

gloss: to be jilted; to suffer a breakup
meanings: to break up (in a romantic relationship)

example.zh: 她刚失恋，这几天心情一直不太好。
example.en: She's just been through a breakup and has been feeling down these past few days.

example.zh: 这些瓷器的制作工艺非常复杂。
example.en: The craftsmanship involved in making this porcelain is very complex.

gloss: to receive; to collect, to draw (what is issued)
meanings: to receive; to draw; to get

example.zh: 考试结束后，请到办公室领取成绩单。
example.en: After the exam, please collect your transcript from the office.

example.zh: 我外公今年八十岁了，身体还很健康。
example.en: My grandfather on my mother's side is eighty this year and still very healthy.

gloss: to exhibit; to put on display

example.zh: 这批文物将在国家博物馆展出三个月。
example.en: These cultural relics will be on display at the National Museum for three months.

example.zh: 一个路人看到有人晕倒，马上打了急救电话。
example.en: A passerby saw someone faint and immediately called an ambulance.

example.zh: 这家店只卖优质水果，价格当然也贵一些。
example.en: This shop sells only top-quality fruit, so of course it's a bit pricier.

example.zh: 进门请换拖鞋，不要穿鞋进屋。
example.en: Please change into slippers when you come in; don't wear shoes in the house.

example.zh: 她大学毕业后去山区当了一名老师。
example.en: After graduating, she went to teach in a mountain area.

example.zh: 这部电影上映后获得了观众的一致好评。
example.en: After its release, the film was unanimously praised by audiences.

example.zh: 他上个月刚拿到驾照，还不太敢上高速。
example.en: He only got his driving licence last month and doesn't dare drive on the motorway yet.

example.zh: 西瓜的水分很多，夏天吃最解渴。
example.en: Watermelon is very juicy, so it's the best thing for quenching thirst in summer.

example.zh: 这家公司的产品太单一，很难满足市场需求。
example.en: This company's product range is too narrow to meet market demand.

example.zh: 刚工作的时候，他买了一辆二手车。
example.en: When he first started working, he bought a second-hand car.

example.zh: 这座城市近几年发展很快，变得越来越现代化了。
example.en: This city has developed fast in recent years and become more and more modern.

example.zh: 勤俭节约是中华民族的优良传统。
example.en: Hard work and thrift are a fine tradition of the Chinese nation.

meanings: a young man and a young woman (in love)

example.zh: 父母为了儿女，什么苦都愿意吃。
example.en: Parents will endure any hardship for their children.

example.zh: 请把你的银行账号发给我，我马上转钱给你。
example.en: Send me your bank account number and I'll transfer the money right away.

example.zh: 这次旅游的费用包括交通和住宿。
example.en: The cost of this trip covers transport and accommodation.

meanings: (Tw) (of an influential person) to publicly lend one's support (e.g. for an election candidate)

example.zh: 火车快进站了，请大家在站台上排好队。
example.en: The train is about to arrive; please queue up on the platform.

example.zh: 飞机在跑道上加速，很快就起飞了。
example.en: The plane sped down the runway and soon took off.

gloss: to start a business; to found an enterprise; to build up
indonesian: memulai usaha; merintis bisnis; membangun usaha

example.zh: 他大学毕业后就和朋友一起创业了。
example.en: After graduating from university, he started a business with friends.

example.zh: 一场暴雨过后，街上到处都是积水。
example.en: After the downpour, the streets were flooded everywhere.

example.zh: 新系统上线后，原有的数据都不会丢失。
example.en: When the new system goes live, none of the existing data will be lost.

example.zh: 她每周都会换一次床单。
example.en: She changes the bed sheets once a week.

gloss: to try out; to be on probation

example.zh: 这个软件可以免费试用三十天。
example.en: You can try this software free for thirty days.

meanings: Yushui or Rain Water, 2nd of the 24 solar terms 二十四节气 19th February-5th March

example.zh: 今年夏天雨水特别多，好几个地方都发了大水。
example.en: There's been a lot of rain this summer, and several places have flooded.

example.zh: 我们这次是跟旅行社去的，什么都不用操心。
example.en: We went with a travel agency this time, so we didn't have to worry about anything.

meanings: to give or receive urgent medical treatment
emergency treatment (at a hospital emergency department, or from a doctor on a house call)

example.zh: 他半夜发高烧，被送到医院看急诊。
example.en: He had a high fever in the middle of the night and was taken to the emergency room.

example.zh: 厨房的柜子里放满了碗和盘子。
example.en: The kitchen cupboards are full of bowls and plates.

example.zh: 孩子们在海边用沙子堆了一座城堡。
example.en: The children built a sandcastle on the beach.

example.zh: 数学是很多学科的基础，一定要学好。
example.en: Mathematics is the foundation of many disciplines, so you must learn it well.

example.zh: 今年的粮食产量比去年增加了百分之五。
example.en: This year's grain output is five percent higher than last year's.

gloss: to consult; to ask for advice

example.zh: 遇到不懂的问题，你可以向老师请教。
example.en: When you meet a problem you don't understand, you can ask the teacher.

example.zh: 蝴蝶和蜜蜂都是常见的昆虫。
example.en: Butterflies and bees are both common insects.

example.zh: 他在餐饮行业干了十多年，开了三家饭馆。
example.en: He has worked in the restaurant business for over ten years and opened three restaurants.

gloss: to be willing to part with; not to grudge
meanings: to be willing to part with sth

example.zh: 她平时很节约，但给孩子买书却很舍得花钱。
example.en: She's usually very thrifty, but she never begrudges spending money on books for her kids.

gloss: aunt (polite address for an older woman); middle-aged or elderly woman
indonesian: bibi; ibu (sapaan untuk wanita paruh baya)
meanings: aunt (affectionate term for an elderly woman)

example.zh: 每天晚上，小区里的大妈们都在广场上跳舞。
example.en: Every evening the older ladies in the neighbourhood dance in the square.

gloss: in passing; as one goes; without extra effort

example.zh: 出门的时候请随手关灯。
example.en: Please turn off the lights on your way out.

example.zh: 这部关于大熊猫的纪录片拍得非常好。
example.en: This documentary about giant pandas is extremely well made.

example.zh: 比赛结束时，他全身都被汗水湿透了。
example.en: By the end of the match he was drenched in sweat.

gloss: to resign; to leave one's job
meanings: to leave one's job temporarily (e.g. for study)
to leave one's job; to resign

example.zh: 他因为工资太低，上个月离职了。
example.en: He quit last month because the pay was too low.

gloss: to drive; to spur on; to bring along
meanings: to spur; to provide impetus; to drive

example.zh: 旅游业的发展带动了当地经济。
example.en: The growth of tourism has boosted the local economy.

example.zh: 这些年城区面积不断扩大，很多农田变成了小区。
example.en: The urban area has kept expanding in recent years, and lots of farmland has become housing estates.

example.zh: 每年春节前，都有大批在外打工的人回老家过年。
example.en: Every year before the Spring Festival, huge numbers of migrant workers go home for the holiday.

example.zh: 正如大家所说，这次比赛的结果出人意料。
example.en: Just as everyone said, the result of this competition was unexpected.

meanings: abbr. for 物业管理, property management

example.zh: 水管坏了，快给物业打个电话吧。
example.en: The water pipe is broken; quickly call property management.

gloss: to formulate; to work out, to draw up (a plan)

example.zh: 考试前，他为自己制订了一个详细的复习计划。
example.en: Before the exam, he drew up a detailed revision plan for himself.

example.zh: 这座老房子的外观没变，里面却全部重新装修了。
example.en: The outside of this old house hasn't changed, but the inside has been completely redone.

example.zh: 通过这次交流，两国人民加深了相互了解。
example.en: Through this exchange, the people of the two countries deepened their mutual understanding.

gloss: to investigate; to do research (survey, fact-finding)

example.zh: 市长亲自到农村调研，了解农民的实际困难。
example.en: The mayor went to the countryside himself to look into farmers' real difficulties.

example.zh: 她特别胆小，晚上一个人不敢出门。
example.en: She's really timid and doesn't dare go out alone at night.

example.zh: 他大学学的是影视表演，现在是一名演员。
example.en: He studied film and TV acting at university and is now an actor.

gloss: to speed; to exceed the speed limit

example.zh: 他开车超速被拍到了，罚了两百块钱。
example.en: He was caught on camera speeding and fined two hundred yuan.

example.zh: 国庆期间，各大景点都人山人海。
example.en: During the National Day holiday, all the major tourist spots are packed.

example.zh: 请大家花五分钟填一下这份问卷。
example.en: Please take five minutes to fill in this questionnaire.

gloss: to enhance; to promote, to further (friendship, understanding)

example.zh: 这次交流活动增进了两校学生之间的友谊。
example.en: This exchange strengthened the friendship between students of the two schools.

example.zh: 这次改革对中国经济产生了深远的影响。
example.en: This reform had a far-reaching impact on China's economy.

example.zh: 电视声音太大了，把音量调小一点吧。
example.en: The TV is too loud; turn the volume down a bit.

gloss: New Year's Eve dinner (family reunion dinner)
indonesian: makan malam Tahun Baru Imlek (malam reuni keluarga)

example.zh: 除夕晚上，全家人围在一起吃年夜饭。
example.en: On New Year's Eve, the whole family gathers round for the reunion dinner.

example.zh: 他们俩从小一起长大，感情非常深厚。
example.en: The two of them grew up together and are very close.

gloss: to go up in price; to raise prices

example.zh: 听说下个月地铁票要涨价了。
example.en: I hear subway fares are going up next month.

meanings: love, esp. within a married couple or between parents and children

example.zh: 无论走多远，亲情都是割不断的。
example.en: No matter how far you go, the bonds of family can never be broken.

example.zh: 请在这里写上你的姓名和住址。
example.en: Please write your name and address here.

gloss: if it were not for; but for

example.zh: 要不是你提醒我，我今天肯定忘了带钥匙。
example.en: If you hadn't reminded me, I'd definitely have forgotten my keys today.

gloss: recently; in the past few days

example.zh: 近日，本市多所中小学举办了科技节活动。
example.en: Several primary and secondary schools in the city recently held science festivals.

example.zh: 教室的墙上贴着孩子们画的图画。
example.en: The children's drawings are put up on the classroom wall.

example.zh: 冬天和朋友一起吃火锅，又热闹又暖和。
example.en: Eating hot pot with friends in winter is lively and warming.

example.zh: 爷爷每天早上都要练一个小时书法。
example.en: Grandpa practises calligraphy for an hour every morning.

gloss: to be less than; to be smaller than

example.zh: 这个房间的面积小于二十平方米，住两个人有点挤。
example.en: This room is under twenty square metres, a bit cramped for two people.

example.zh: 学校的课外活动丰富多彩，学生们都很喜欢。
example.en: The school's extracurricular activities are rich and varied, and the students love them.

example.zh: 他的长处是做事认真，从来不马虎。
example.en: His strength is that he's conscientious and never careless.

gloss: to heat up; to warm up; to intensify (fig.)

example.zh: 进入四月以后，各地开始快速升温。
example.en: Once April arrives, temperatures start to rise quickly everywhere.

example.zh: 我刚从美国回来，还在倒时差。
example.en: I just got back from the US and am still getting over jet lag.

example.zh: 这门课一共两个学分，每周上两节。
example.en: This course is worth two credits, with two classes a week.

example.zh: 近年来，越来越多的年轻人选择回家乡创业。
example.en: In recent years, more and more young people have chosen to return home to start businesses.

example.zh: 小心，杯子里是刚烧好的开水！
example.en: Careful, the cup has just-boiled water in it!

example.zh: 半夜里，楼上突然传来一阵很大的响声。
example.en: In the middle of the night, there was suddenly a loud noise from upstairs.

example.zh: 租这套房子要先交一个月的押金。
example.en: To rent this apartment, you first have to pay one month's deposit.

example.zh: 这几年物价涨得很快，工资却没怎么涨。
example.en: Prices have risen fast these past few years, but wages have barely moved.

example.zh: 他每天晚上开着台灯学习到很晚。
example.en: Every night he studies late with his desk lamp on.

gloss: have a safe trip; bon voyage

example.zh: 你明天就要坐火车回老家了，祝你一路顺风！
example.en: You're taking the train home tomorrow, so have a safe trip!

example.zh: 这张床的宽度是一米八，两个人睡也不挤。
example.en: This bed is 1.8 metres wide, so two people can sleep in it comfortably.

gloss: to popularize; to spread widely; widespread; universal

example.zh: 如今智能手机已经非常普及了。
example.en: Nowadays smartphones have become extremely widespread.

example.zh: 婚礼那天，亲朋好友都来祝贺他们。
example.en: On their wedding day, all their family and friends came to congratulate them.
