example.zh: 这本词典的厚度差不多有十厘米。
example.en: This dictionary is almost ten centimetres thick.

gloss: traditional Chinese medicine; doctor of Chinese medicine
meanings: a doctor trained in Chinese medicine

example.zh: 他的病西医治不好，后来找了一位老中医。
example.en: Western medicine couldn't cure his illness, so he went to an experienced doctor of Chinese medicine.

example.zh: 公司年初定下的目标，到年底已经全部完成了。
example.en: By the end of the year, the company had met all the targets it set at the start of the year.

meanings: attendant on an airplane, train, boat etc

example.zh: 飞机上的乘务员给乘客送来了饮料。
example.en: The flight attendants brought drinks to the passengers.

example.zh: 这款新手机的售价是五千九百九十九元。
example.en: This new phone retails at 5,999 yuan.

example.zh: 为了环保，很多奶茶店开始使用纸吸管。
example.en: To help the environment, many bubble tea shops have started using paper straws.

example.zh: 妈妈在客厅的窗台上摆了几盆花。
example.en: Mum has put a few pots of flowers on the living-room windowsill.

gloss: China and foreign countries; Chinese and foreign

example.zh: 这次展览吸引了大批中外游客。
example.en: This exhibition attracted large numbers of Chinese and foreign visitors.

example.zh: 新学年开始了，学生们都回到了学校。
example.en: The new school year has begun, and the students are all back at school.

example.zh: 学了两年，他的汉语已经达到中级水平了。
example.en: After two years of study, his Chinese has reached an intermediate level.

gloss: the first time; for the first time

example.zh: 这是中国队首次进入世界杯决赛。
example.en: This is the first time the Chinese team has reached the World Cup final.

example.zh: 很多中国人早餐喜欢喝豆浆、吃油条。
example.en: Many Chinese people like soy milk and fried dough sticks for breakfast.

example.zh: 每次出差回来，他都会给同事带一些当地特产。
example.en: Every time he comes back from a business trip, he brings his colleagues some local specialties.

meanings: to put together an order and deliver it (i.e. 配货 and 送货)

example.zh: 这家超市提供免费配送服务，一个小时就能送到。
example.en: This supermarket offers free delivery and gets your order to you within an hour.

example.zh: 书法是中华传统文化的重要组成部分。
example.en: Calligraphy is an important part of traditional Chinese culture.

example.zh: 中药虽然很苦，但对调理身体很有效。
example.en: Chinese herbal medicine tastes bitter, but it's very good for building up your health.

example.zh: 中午工作太忙，大家就在办公室吃盒饭。
example.en: Work was so busy at noon that everyone ate boxed lunches in the office.

example.zh: 爷爷退休后开始学画国画，最喜欢画山水。
example.en: Grandpa took up traditional Chinese painting after retiring; landscapes are his favourite.

example.zh: 买牛奶的时候，一定要看清保质期。
example.en: When you buy milk, always check the best-before date.

example.zh: 这个月打了很多长途，话费比平时高了不少。
example.en: I made a lot of long-distance calls this month, so my phone bill is much higher than usual.

example.zh: 姥爷今年八十岁了，身体还很硬朗。
example.en: Grandpa is eighty this year and still in great shape.

gloss: provincial capital; capital of a province
indonesian: ibu kota provinsi; pusat pemerintahan provinsi

example.zh: 广州是广东省的省会。
example.en: Guangzhou is the provincial capital of Guangdong.

example.zh: 这家公司专门生产高科技产品。
example.en: This company specialises in making high-tech products.

meanings: literary (rather than colloquial) pronunciation of a Chinese character

example.zh: 这个字有两个读音，意思也不一样。
example.en: This character has two pronunciations with different meanings.

example.zh: 春天到了，花园里开满了五颜六色的花。
example.en: Spring has come, and the garden is full of flowers of every colour.

example.zh: 到了台湾，一定要去逛逛夜市。
example.en: When you go to Taiwan, you must visit a night market.

example.zh: 这个词的用法比较复杂，老师讲了好几遍。
example.en: The usage of this word is quite complicated; the teacher explained it several times.

example.zh: 南方人的主食是米饭，北方人更爱吃面食。
example.en: Southerners' staple food is rice, while northerners prefer wheat-based foods.

gloss: high jump; to do the high jump

example.zh: 他在运动会上参加了跳高比赛，得了第一名。
example.en: He entered the high jump at the sports meet and came first.

example.zh: 新房装修好以后，他们买了全套家电。
example.en: Once the new flat was renovated, they bought a full set of home appliances.

gloss: New Year money (given to children); lucky money
indonesian: angpau Tahun Baru Imlek; uang hadiah Imlek untuk anak
meanings: money given to children as a gift on Chinese New Year's Eve

example.zh: 过年时，孩子们最盼望的就是压岁钱。
example.en: At New Year, what children most look forward to is their lucky money.

example.zh: 他第一次吃西餐，不太会用刀叉。
example.en: It was his first time eating Western food, and he wasn't very good with a knife and fork.

example.zh: 他从不在别人面前说朋友的短处。
example.en: He never talks about his friends' faults in front of others.

gloss: all the flavors of life; life's joys and sorrows
indonesian: suka duka kehidupan; pahit manis kehidupan
meanings: sour, sweet, bitter and spicy hot
fig. the joys and sorrows of life

example.zh: 人生总有酸甜苦辣，经历多了就看开了。
example.en: Life always has its ups and downs; once you've been through enough, you learn to take them in stride.

example.zh: 奥运会闭幕式上，运动员们依依不舍地告别。
example.en: At the Olympic closing ceremony, the athletes said their reluctant goodbyes.

example.zh: 爷爷每天早上都要用毛笔练一个小时的字。
example.en: Every morning Grandpa spends an hour practising calligraphy with a brush.

gloss: long jump; to do the long jump

example.zh: 她在学校运动会上跳远跳出了五米多的好成绩。
example.en: At the school sports meet she achieved a great result of over five metres in the long jump.

gloss: can't; there's no way (to do something)

example.zh: 雨下得这么大，我们今天没法儿出去了。
example.en: It's raining so hard there's no way we can go out today.

example.zh: 这本书有电子版，可以在手机上看。
example.en: This book has an e-version you can read on your phone.

example.zh: 楼下的便利店二十四小时营业，买东西很方便。
example.en: The convenience store downstairs is open 24 hours, so shopping is easy.

example.zh: 现在买东西扫一下二维码就能付钱。
example.en: These days you can pay for things just by scanning a QR code.

example.zh: 上车以后，请大家系好安全带。
example.en: Once you're in the car, everyone please fasten your seatbelts.

gloss: not in accordance with; not to match

example.zh: 网上的照片和实物完全不符，我要退货。
example.en: The item looks nothing like the photo online; I want to return it.

example.zh: 橙子富含维生素C，多吃对身体有好处。
example.en: Oranges are rich in vitamin C, and eating more of them is good for you.

example.zh: 公园的池子里养着很多金鱼。
example.en: There are lots of goldfish in the pond in the park.

gloss: to top up; to recharge (an account or card)

example.zh: 这张公交卡里没钱了，得去充值。
example.en: There's no money left on this bus card; I need to top it up.

gloss: to like (a post); to give a thumbs-up, to praise
meanings: to like, to give a thumbs-up

example.zh: 她刚发了一条朋友圈，很快就有几十个人点赞。
example.en: She'd only just posted on WeChat Moments when dozens of people liked it.

example.zh: 电商的发展让人们足不出户就能买到东西。
example.en: The growth of e-commerce lets people buy things without leaving home.

example.zh: 他的汉语发音非常标准，听起来像中国人。
example.en: His Chinese pronunciation is very standard; he sounds like a native speaker.

example.zh: 非洲有很多野生动物，比如狮子和大象。
example.en: Africa has lots of wild animals, such as lions and elephants.

example.zh: 今天太晚了，我们改天再聊吧。
example.en: It's too late today; let's talk another day.

gloss: all trades and professions; every walk of life

example.zh: 来自各行各业的人都参加了这次志愿活动。
example.en: People from all walks of life took part in this volunteer event.

gloss: (polite) your surname; may I ask your name

example.zh: 初次见面，请问您贵姓？我姓王。
example.en: Nice to meet you. May I ask your surname? Mine is Wang.

gloss: precipitation; to have rain or snow

example.zh: 这个地区全年降水很少，气候非常干燥。
example.en: This region gets very little precipitation all year, and the climate is very dry.

gloss: far back in time; ancient; remote

example.zh: 这座古城历史久远，留下了很多文物。
example.en: This ancient city has a long history and many surviving relics.

example.zh: 收到的商品有问题，我马上联系了客服。
example.en: The item I received was faulty, so I contacted customer service right away.

example.zh: 他的钱包被偷了，赶紧去派出所报了案。
example.en: His wallet was stolen, so he hurried to the police station to report it.

example.zh: 刚开始学中文时，我要靠拼音才能读汉字。
example.en: When I first started learning Chinese, I needed pinyin to read characters.

gloss: weight; importance, seriousness; sense of propriety

example.zh: 做事要分清轻重，先把最要紧的事办完。
example.en: You need to know what matters most and get the most urgent things done first.

example.zh: 良好的人际关系对工作很有帮助。
example.en: Good relationships with people are very helpful at work.

example.zh: 有些商家为了赚钱，不惜卖假货。
example.en: Some merchants will even sell fake goods to make money.

example.zh: 他把旅行的照片上传到了网上。
example.en: He uploaded his travel photos online.

example.zh: 我的生肖是龙，你呢？
example.en: My zodiac sign is the dragon. What about you?

example.zh: 他很喜欢旅游，已经去过中国的大部分省份。
example.en: He loves travelling and has already been to most of China's provinces.

example.zh: 吃完饭，服务员又送来了一份甜品。
example.en: After the meal, the waiter brought out a dessert.

example.zh: 如果对商品不满意，七天内可以退还全部货款。
example.en: If you're not satisfied with the product, you can get a full refund within seven days.

example.zh: 奶奶拿出一本旧相册，给我们看她年轻时的照片。
example.en: Grandma took out an old photo album and showed us pictures of herself when she was young.

example.zh: 天太热了，我们去买根雪糕吃吧。
example.en: It's so hot; let's go and buy an ice cream.

gloss: to send by mail; to post

example.zh: 我把生日礼物邮寄给了在国外的朋友。
example.en: I mailed the birthday present to my friend abroad.

example.zh: 油条刚出锅的时候最好吃，又香又脆。
example.en: Fried dough sticks are best fresh out of the wok, fragrant and crispy.

gloss: Chinese (as a school subject); language and literature
indonesian: pelajaran Bahasa Tionghoa; bahasa dan sastra

example.zh: 她的语文成绩一直很好，作文经常被老师表扬。
example.en: She's always done well in Chinese class, and the teacher often praises her essays.

example.zh: 这家网店满一百元就免运费，所以我一般会凑够了再下单。
example.en: This online shop offers free shipping on orders over 100 yuan, so I usually add items until I reach that before ordering.

example.zh: 刚进入职场的年轻人，最需要学会的是怎么与人沟通。
example.en: What young people who have just entered the working world most need to learn is how to communicate with others.

gloss: to hit (a target); to be hit by; to win (a prize)

example.zh: 他一箭射中了靶心，观众都鼓起掌来。
example.en: He hit the bullseye with one arrow, and the audience all began to applaud.

indonesian: tersebut; itu (formal, merujuk hal yang baru disebut)
meanings: to be sb's turn to do sth

example.zh: 警方表示，该男子已于昨晚被抓获。
example.en: Police said the man was caught last night.

gloss: measure word for schools, buildings; that which
indonesian: kata satuan untuk sekolah, gedung; yang
meanings: classifier for houses, small buildings, institutions etc
particle introducing a relative clause or passive

example.zh: 我们家附近新开了一所小学。
example.en: A new primary school has opened near our home.

gloss: one tenth; ten percent (in proportions, e.g. three tenths = 30%)

example.zh: 今年的粮食产量比去年增加了两成。
example.en: This year's grain output rose by 20% over last year.

gloss: sentence-final particle (le + a); particle expressing excitement or a change of situation
indonesian: partikel akhir kalimat (gabungan le + a); partikel seruan atau perubahan keadaan
meanings: sentence-final particle, contraction of 了啊, indicating exclamation
particle placed after each item in a list of examples

example.zh: 太好啦，我们终于考完试了！
example.en: Great, we've finally finished our exams!

meanings: (of time or place) in; at; on
(indicating any indirect relation) to; toward; vis-à-vis; with regard to; for

example.zh: 这座大桥始建于1990年，是当地最有名的建筑。
example.en: This bridge was first built in 1990 and is the most famous structure in the area.

example.zh: 这个地方风景很美，周末来玩的人特别多。
example.en: The scenery here is beautiful, and lots of people come on weekends.

gloss: to bear fruit; to produce fruit

example.zh: 院子里那棵苹果树种了三年，今年终于结果了。
example.en: The apple tree in the yard was planted three years ago, and this year it finally bore fruit.

gloss: to request; to beg; to seek

example.zh: 他求了我半天，我才答应帮他这个忙。
example.en: He begged me for ages before I agreed to do him this favor.

gloss: to turn; to revolve; to rotate
meanings: classifier for revolutions (per minute etc): revs, rpm

example.zh: 地球一边自转，一边绕着太阳转。
example.en: The Earth spins on its axis while revolving around the sun.

example.zh: 这种药可以杀死皮肤上的细菌。
example.en: This medicine can kill the bacteria on the skin.

gloss: particle stressing that something is obvious; particle softening a request or suggestion
indonesian: partikel penegas hal yang sudah jelas; partikel pelunak ajakan atau permintaan
meanings: modal particle indicating that sth is obvious
particle indicating a pause for emphasis

example.zh: 这个问题很简单嘛，你再想想。
example.en: This question is simple, think about it again.

gloss: thread; line, wire; measure word for routes and lines
indonesian: benang; garis, kabel; kata penggolong untuk jalur
meanings: (after a number) tier (unofficial ranking of a Chinese city)

example.zh: 妈妈拿出针和线，帮我把掉了的扣子缝上了。
example.en: Mom took out a needle and thread and sewed my lost button back on.

example.zh: 这场比赛因下大雨被迫推迟到下周。
example.en: The match was forced to be postponed until next week because of heavy rain.

example.zh: 这家店的面条特好吃，每天中午都要排队。
example.en: The noodles at this shop are especially good; there's a queue every lunchtime.

gloss: measure word for games or sets; bureau, office; situation
indonesian: kata penggolong untuk babak/set permainan; biro, kantor; situasi
meanings: classifier for games: match, set, round etc

example.zh: 我们下了三局棋，他赢了两局。
example.en: We played three games of chess, and he won two.

meanings: 8th earthly branch: 1-3 p.m., 6th solar month (7th July-6th August), year of the Sheep

example.zh: 这个问题至今未得到解决，居民们很着急。
example.en: This problem has not been solved to this day, and residents are very anxious.

meanings: replaces 啊 when following the vowel "u" or "ao"

example.zh: 哇，这里的风景真是太美了！
example.en: Wow, the scenery here is really beautiful!

example.zh: 古希腊人相信，天上的雷电是由神控制的。
example.en: The ancient Greeks believed that thunder and lightning were controlled by the gods.

gloss: measure word for pens, songs, teams; to support
indonesian: kata satuan untuk pena, lagu, tim; menopang
meanings: classifier for rods such as pens and guns, for army divisions and for songs or compositions

example.zh: 能把你那支笔借我用一下吗？
example.en: Could I borrow that pen of yours for a moment?

example.zh: 这种植物缺水太久就会死亡。
example.en: This plant will die if it goes without water for too long.

gloss: while, but (contrast); then; measure word for news
indonesian: sedangkan; maka; kata satuan untuk berita
meanings: (literary) (conjunction used to express contrast with a previous clause) but; then

example.zh: 哥哥喜欢运动，弟弟则喜欢安静地看书。
example.en: The older brother likes sports, whereas the younger one prefers reading quietly.

gloss: clear; to clear up, to settle (fully)
meanings: Qing (Wade-Giles: Ch'ing) dynasty of imperial China (1644-1911)

example.zh: 这条小河的水很清，能看见河底的石头。
example.en: The water in this stream is so clear you can see the stones on the bottom.

gloss: wheel; to take turns; measure word for rounds
indonesian: roda; bergiliran; kata penggolong untuk babak/putaran
meanings: classifier for big round objects: disk, or recurring events: round, turn

example.zh: 下一轮比赛将在明天下午举行。
example.en: The next round of the competition will be held tomorrow afternoon.

example.zh: 全班同学投票选出了新的班长。
example.en: The whole class voted to choose a new class monitor.

gloss: to force; to compel; to press

example.zh: 父母不应该逼孩子去学他们不喜欢的东西。
example.en: Parents shouldn't force children to learn things they don't like.

gloss: to stay; to remain (somewhere for a while)

example.zh: 放假的时候我哪儿也没去，一直在家里待着。
example.en: During the holiday I didn't go anywhere; I just stayed at home.

gloss: to use up, to exhaust; to the utmost, to do one's best
meanings: (when used before a noun of location) furthest or extreme
to be within the limits of

example.zh: 医生已经尽了最大的努力，可还是没能救回他。
example.en: The doctors did their very best, but still couldn't save him.

example.zh: 他把所有的钱都投资到了这家公司。
example.en: He invested all his money in this company.

example.zh: 这场战争给人们带来了巨大的痛苦。
example.en: This war brought great suffering to people.

gloss: to rush, dash; to rinse; to make (coffee) with water

example.zh: 下课铃一响，孩子们就冲出了教室。
example.en: As soon as the bell rang, the children rushed out of the classroom.

gloss: measure word for plates of food, games and coils; to coil, to wind
indonesian: kata penggolong untuk piring makanan, permainan, gulungan; melingkar

example.zh: 服务员端上来一盘红烧鱼，香味一下子飘满了屋子。
example.en: The waiter brought out a plate of braised fish, and the aroma instantly filled the room.

gloss: skin; leather; peel; naughty (of a child)
indonesian: kulit; kulit binatang, kulit buah; nakal (anak-anak)

example.zh: 苹果皮里含有很多营养，洗干净了可以直接吃。
example.en: Apple peel is full of nutrients; once washed, it can be eaten as it is.

meanings: thing with shape or function similar to a gun
to substitute for another person in a test

example.zh: 那个警察手里拿着一把枪。
example.en: That police officer is holding a gun.

gloss: to leave behind (by mistake); to forget to bring; to fall behind
meanings: to leave behind or forget to bring
colloquial reading for 落 in certain compounds

example.zh: 糟糕，我把手机落在出租车上了！
example.en: Oh no, I left my phone in the taxi!

gloss: dazed, stunned; dull, slow-witted; to stay

example.zh: 听到这个消息，他一下子呆住了。
example.en: When he heard the news, he was stunned.

gloss: net; network, the internet; to catch with a net

example.zh: 渔民们一大早就出海撒网捕鱼了。
example.en: The fishermen went out to sea early in the morning to cast their nets.

meanings: (bound form) (military) mine, as in 雷 land mine
(coll.) to shock; to stun; to astound

example.zh: 外面打雷了，看来要下大雨了。
example.en: It's thundering outside; it looks like it's going to pour.

example.zh: 对他来说，幽默是解决矛盾最好的武器。
example.en: For him, humour is the best weapon for resolving conflicts.

gloss: circle, ring; lap (measure word); to circle
meanings: classifier for loops, orbits, laps of race etc

example.zh: 她在日历上把考试那天画了一个圈。
example.en: She drew a circle around the exam day on the calendar.

gloss: to recruit; to attract; to beckon

example.zh: 我们公司今年打算招二十名新员工。
example.en: Our company plans to recruit twenty new employees this year.

gloss: branch of study; field, discipline; subject
indonesian: bidang studi; cabang ilmu; mata pelajaran

example.zh: 他上学时文科成绩一般，理科却特别好。
example.en: At school his humanities grades were average, but he was excellent at the sciences.

gloss: edition; version; page of a newspaper

example.zh: 这本词典去年出了新版，增加了不少流行词。
example.en: This dictionary came out in a new edition last year, adding quite a few popular words.

example.zh: 救人的那位司机被大家称为英雄。
example.en: The driver who saved people was hailed by everyone as a hero.

example.zh: 我们公司的网站昨天受到了黑客攻击。
example.en: Our company's website was attacked by hackers yesterday.

meanings: to cool or chill (food or drinks)

example.zh: 他出生在南方的一个小镇，那里到处都是小河和石桥。
example.en: He was born in a small town in the south, full of streams and stone bridges.

example.zh: 他每个周末都去网球俱乐部打球。
example.en: He goes to the tennis club to play every weekend.

gloss: measure word for hats; top, peak; to prop up
meanings: to be subjected to (an aerial bombing, hailstorm etc)
(slang) to "bump" a forum thread to raise its profile
classifier for headwear, hats, veils etc

example.zh: 她戴着一顶白色的帽子。
example.en: She is wearing a white hat.

example.zh: 面试一开始，经理请每个人先做个简单的自我介绍。
example.en: At the start of the interview, the manager asked each person to briefly introduce themselves.

gloss: to commit (a crime or mistake); to violate

example.zh: 谁都会犯错误，重要的是能从中吸取教训。
example.en: Everyone makes mistakes; what matters is learning from them.

gloss: to obey; to be convinced, to accept (someone's superiority); to serve
meanings: to serve (in the military, a prison sentence etc)

example.zh: 他这次输得心服口服，下了台还主动跟对手握手。
example.en: This time he lost fair and square and accepted it, even shaking his opponent's hand after leaving the stage.

example.zh: 这块布可以用来做一条裙子。

example.zh: 听到有人叫他的名字，他马上回头看了看。
example.en: Hearing someone call his name, he immediately turned around to look.

example.zh: 法官认真听取了双方的意见后才作出判决。
example.en: The judge listened carefully to both sides before handing down a verdict.

example.zh: 嘿，你的钥匙掉在地上了！
example.en: Hey, your keys fell on the floor!

example.zh: 他去年买的股票最近涨了不少。
example.en: The stocks he bought last year have risen quite a bit recently.

example.zh: 他摸了摸脑袋，不好意思地笑了。
example.en: He scratched his head and gave an embarrassed smile.

example.zh: 心脏的作用是把血液送到全身各处。
example.en: The heart's job is to pump blood to every part of the body.

gloss: person in charge; supervisor; to be in charge of

example.zh: 有问题请直接找我们部门的主管。
example.en: If you have a problem, please go directly to our department supervisor.

example.zh: 家人的支持是我前进的动力。
example.en: My family's support is what drives me forward.

gloss: blessing; good wishes; to wish sb well

example.zh: 新年到了，我向大家送上最好的祝福。
example.en: The New Year is here, and I send everyone my best wishes.

example.zh: 小女孩最喜欢听王子和公主的故事。
example.en: The little girl loves stories about princes and princesses most of all.

gloss: loose, slack; to loosen, to relax
meanings: floss (dry, fluffy food product made from shredded, seasoned meat or fish, used as a topping or filling)

example.zh: 我最近瘦了，以前的裤子都变松了。
example.en: I've lost weight recently, and my old trousers have all become loose.

example.zh: 小狗把骨头埋在了院子里的树下。
example.en: The puppy buried its bone under the tree in the yard.

gloss: rate; proportion (as a suffix, e.g. success rate)

example.zh: 这家医院的手术成功率达到了百分之九十八。
example.en: This hospital's surgical success rate has reached 98%.

example.zh: 早餐能给我们提供一上午的能量。
example.en: Breakfast can give us energy for the whole morning.

example.zh: 山上有很多野花，红的、黄的、白的都有。
example.en: There are lots of wildflowers on the mountain, red, yellow and white.

gloss: to clean up; to clear out; to sort out

example.zh: 周末我要把房间彻底清理一遍。
example.en: This weekend I'm going to clean out my room thoroughly.

example.zh: 她对工作一直充满激情。
example.en: She has always been full of passion for her work.

example.zh: 活了三十多年，我从未见过这么美的风景。
example.en: In over thirty years of life, I have never seen such beautiful scenery.

example.zh: 两家公司的谈判进行得很顺利。
example.en: The negotiations between the two companies went smoothly.

gloss: to close a deal; to strike a bargain; deal!

example.zh: 我们谈了一个下午，最后以两百块的价格成交了。
example.en: We negotiated all afternoon and finally closed the deal at two hundred yuan.

gloss: industry, trade (as a suffix, e.g. tourism industry); occupation

example.zh: 这个海边小城主要靠旅游业发展经济。
example.en: This small seaside city relies mainly on tourism for its economy.

example.zh: 这座建筑的造型非常独特。
example.en: The design of this building is very unique.

gloss: to make up for; to supplement; to mend, to patch

example.zh: 上周我病了没上课，这周得把落下的课补回来。
example.en: I was sick and missed class last week, so this week I have to make up the lessons I missed.

example.zh: 登山前要准备好所有的装备。
example.en: Before climbing a mountain you must prepare all your gear.

example.zh: 语言不再是我们交流的障碍了。
example.en: Language is no longer a barrier to our communication.

example.zh: 专家提醒，如果身边的人流露出自杀的念头，一定要及时寻求帮助。
example.en: Experts advise that if someone close to you shows suicidal thoughts, you must seek help promptly.

example.zh: 这家公司正面临严重的经济危机。
example.en: This company is facing a serious economic crisis.

example.zh: 每个公民都有受教育的权利。
example.en: Every citizen has the right to education.

gloss: at that time; originally; in the first place

example.zh: 早知道这样，当初就应该听你的。
example.en: If I'd known it would turn out like this, I should have listened to you in the first place.

example.zh: 我在这些资料里找到了解决问题的线索。
example.en: I found a clue to solving the problem in these materials.

gloss: to lead, to guide; to attract; to cause
meanings: to provide evidence or justification for
old unit of distance equal to 10 丈, one-thirtieth of a km or 33.33 meters

example.zh: 服务员把我们引到了靠窗的座位。
example.en: The waiter led us to a table by the window.

example.zh: 这种杯子是用金属做的，很结实。
example.en: This kind of cup is made of metal and is very sturdy.

gloss: to flash; to sparkle; to dodge
meanings: to duck out of the way
(Internet slang) (of a display of affection) "dazzlingly" saccharine

example.zh: 天上闪了一道光，紧接着就是一声响雷。
example.en: A flash of light lit up the sky, followed immediately by a clap of thunder.

example.zh: 这个国家的经济主要依靠石油出口。
example.en: This country's economy relies mainly on oil exports.

example.zh: 这个频道每天晚上七点播新闻。
example.en: This channel broadcasts the news at seven every evening.

gloss: to scatter; to disperse; to break up

example.zh: 电影散场以后，人们一下子涌到了街上。
example.en: When the movie let out, people poured into the street all at once.

example.zh: 医生警告他必须马上戒烟。
example.en: The doctor warned him that he must quit smoking immediately.

gloss: to ride; to take (transport); to take advantage of; to multiply

example.zh: 我们乘地铁去博物馆吧。
example.en: Let's take the subway to the museum.

example.zh: 孩子的长相和父母的基因有很大关系。
example.en: A child's looks have a lot to do with the parents' genes.

example.zh: 我坐了一天的车，现在头很晕，想躺一会儿。
example.en: I've been on the road all day; my head is spinning and I want to lie down for a bit.

example.zh: 就算明天下雨，比赛也会照常进行。
example.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, the match will go ahead as usual.

meanings: to withdraw the mandate of heaven (and transition to a new dynasty) (original meaning)
(separable verb sometimes used in the pattern 革noun的命)

example.zh: 智能手机给人们的生活带来了一场革命。
example.en: Smartphones brought a revolution to people's lives.

example.zh: 刚到国外的时候，他常常觉得很孤独。
example.en: When he first went abroad, he often felt very lonely.

example.zh: 奶奶眼睛不好，穿针的时候总要叫我帮忙。
example.en: Grandma's eyesight is poor, so she always asks me to help thread the needle.

example.zh: 这位官员因为收受贿赂被调查了。
example.en: This official is under investigation for taking bribes.

example.zh: 父母应该用沟通代替暴力来教育孩子。
example.en: Parents should educate children through communication instead of violence.

example.zh: 这种药的效果非常神奇。
example.en: The effect of this medicine is amazing.

example.zh: 我叫错了他的名字，场面非常尴尬。
example.en: I called him by the wrong name, and it was very awkward.

example.zh: 这孩子脑子很灵，什么东西一学就会。
example.en: This kid is really quick-witted and picks up anything right away.

example.zh: 为了成功，他付出了很大的代价。
example.en: He paid a high price for his success.

example.zh: 婴儿每天需要睡十几个小时。
example.en: Babies need to sleep more than ten hours a day.

example.zh: 你瞧，那边有人在放风筝。
example.en: Look, someone over there is flying a kite.

gloss: to unite; to rally; united; unity

example.zh: 只要大家团结起来，就没有克服不了的困难。
example.en: As long as we all unite, there is no difficulty we can't overcome.

gloss: to involve; to relate to; to touch upon

example.zh: 这个问题涉及很多方面，需要慢慢讨论。
example.en: This issue involves many aspects and needs to be discussed slowly.

example.zh: 对不起，我不小心踩了你的脚。
example.en: Sorry, I accidentally stepped on your foot.

gloss: to start (a machine); to launch; to mobilize

example.zh: 天太冷了，汽车半天发动不起来。
example.en: It was so cold that the car wouldn't start for ages.

example.zh: 做生意需要灵活的市场策略。
example.en: Doing business requires flexible market strategies.

gloss: to fall into; to sink into; to be caught up in
indonesian: terjerumus ke; tenggelam dalam; terjebak dalam

example.zh: 听完他的话，大家都陷入了沉默。
example.en: After hearing what he said, everyone fell silent.

gloss: to be willing to; to agree to

example.zh: 我劝了他半天，他就是不肯去医院。
example.en: I tried to persuade him for ages, but he simply wouldn't go to the hospital.

gloss: to repay; to reciprocate; return; reward

example.zh: 父母养育我们，从来不要求回报。
example.en: Our parents raised us without ever asking for anything in return.

example.zh: 听到这个不公平的决定，大家都非常愤怒。
example.en: Everyone was furious when they heard about this unfair decision.

example.zh: 专家正在评估这个项目的风险。
example.en: Experts are assessing the risks of this project.

example.zh: 我原本打算周末去爬山，结果下雨了。
example.en: I originally planned to go hiking at the weekend, but then it rained.

example.zh: 故宫是明清两代的皇宫，每年吸引大量游客。
example.en: The Forbidden City was the imperial palace of the Ming and Qing dynasties and attracts huge numbers of tourists every year.

gloss: to maintain; to safeguard; to defend; to uphold

example.zh: 大家都有责任维护公共场所的卫生。
example.en: Everyone has a responsibility to keep public places clean.

example.zh: 晚会的气氛非常热烈，大家都很开心。
example.en: The atmosphere at the party was lively, and everyone was very happy.

gloss: to follow; to track; to tail

example.zh: 这个软件可以跟踪你每天走的步数。
example.en: This app can track the number of steps you walk each day.

gloss: to gaze into the distance, to look at; to hope

example.zh: 站在山顶向远处望去，整个城市都在眼前。
example.en: Looking out into the distance from the mountaintop, the whole city lies before you.

example.zh: 年轻人给公司带来了新的活力。
example.en: Young people have brought new vitality to the company.

example.zh: 读一本好书可以让心灵得到安静。
example.en: Reading a good book can bring peace to the soul.

gloss: to entrust; to commission; to authorize

example.zh: 我委托朋友帮我取一下快递。
example.en: I asked a friend to pick up my parcel for me.

example.zh: 他毕业后进入一家航空公司工作。
example.en: After graduating he went to work for an airline.

meanings: Tongdao Dong autonomous county in Huaihua 怀化, Hunan

example.zh: 地铁站里有专门为残疾人设计的无障碍通道。
example.en: The metro station has barrier-free passageways specially designed for disabled people.

example.zh: 每年春天，农民们都要下田插秧。
example.en: Every spring, farmers go into the fields to transplant rice seedlings.

example.zh: 他在音乐方面很有才能，十岁就开始作曲了。
example.en: He is very talented in music and started composing at the age of ten.

example.zh: 在公共场所大声说话是不文明的行为。
example.en: Talking loudly in public places is uncivilized behavior.

example.zh: 这位歌手是很多年轻人的偶像。
example.en: This singer is an idol to many young people.

example.zh: 大雪导致机场的交通一片混乱。
example.en: The heavy snow threw traffic at the airport into chaos.

example.zh: 这个广告很有创意，看过的人都记住了。
example.en: This ad is very creative; everyone who saw it remembered it.

example.zh: 突然停电了，整个房间顿时陷入一片黑暗。
example.en: The power suddenly went out, and the whole room was instantly plunged into darkness.

example.zh: 这两个会议的时间冲突了，我只能参加一个。
example.en: The times of these two meetings clash, so I can only attend one.

example.zh: 听到这个消息，大家都很惊讶。
example.en: Everyone was very surprised to hear the news.

gloss: master; great expert (in an art or skill)

example.zh: 他是世界有名的建筑大师，设计过很多著名建筑。
example.en: He is a world-renowned master architect who has designed many famous buildings.

gloss: to learn of; to hear about; to find out

example.zh: 得知自己考上了大学，他高兴得一晚上没睡着。
example.en: On learning he had got into university, he was so happy that he didn't sleep all night.

gloss: to prompt; to point out; to hint; tip

example.zh: 系统提示我密码输入错误。
example.en: The system told me that the password I entered was wrong.

example.zh: 这是一个非常典型的例子。
example.en: This is a very typical example.

gloss: the reason why (used with 'because' in the next clause)
meanings: (after a noun N and before a predicate P) the reason why N P
Example: 我之所以讨厌他 "the reason why I dislike him (is ...)"

example.zh: 他之所以成功，是因为他从来不放弃。
example.en: The reason he succeeded is that he never gives up.

gloss: lesson (learned); to teach sb a lesson; to lecture

example.zh: 这次失败给了我一个深刻的教训。
example.en: This failure taught me a profound lesson.

example.zh: 除非你亲自去请他，否则他不会来。
example.en: He won't come unless you go and invite him in person.

gloss: clear-headed; sober; awake; to come to
indonesian: sadar; jernih pikirannya; tidak mabuk; siuman

example.zh: 喝杯咖啡能让我的头脑清醒一点儿。
example.en: A cup of coffee helps my mind become a bit clearer.

example.zh: 这本小说一共有三十章，我已经看完一半了。
example.en: This novel has thirty chapters in total, and I've already read half of them.

example.zh: 经过一段艰难的时期，公司终于好转了。
example.en: After a difficult period, the company finally improved.

example.zh: 这件毛衣是纯羊毛的，穿起来特别暖和。
example.en: This sweater is pure wool and very warm to wear.

example.zh: 她怀孕五个月了，不能太累。
example.en: She is five months pregnant and shouldn't get too tired.

gloss: to locate, to pinpoint; to position; positioning

example.zh: 打开手机地图，它就能自动定位你现在的位置。
example.en: Open the map on your phone and it will automatically locate where you are.

gloss: a burst of; a fit of; a spell, a while

example.zh: 他话还没说完，教室里就响起了一阵笑声。
example.en: Before he had finished speaking, a burst of laughter broke out in the classroom.

gloss: to prop up, to support; to hold up (an umbrella); to hold out
meanings: to push or move with a pole

example.zh: 外面下雨了，她撑着一把伞走了出去。
example.en: It was raining outside, and she went out holding an umbrella.

example.zh: 即便明天下雨，比赛也会照常进行。
example.en: Even if it rains tomorrow, the match will go ahead as usual.

gloss: to suffer; to meet with (something bad)

example.zh: 这个计划遭到了大多数人的反对。
example.en: This plan met with opposition from most people.

gloss: to spray; to spurt; to gush
meanings: (classifier for the ordinal number of a crop, in the context of multiple harvests)

example.zh: 消防员拿着水枪，对着大火不停地喷水。
example.en: The firefighters held their hoses and kept spraying water at the blaze.

example.zh: 保护市民的安全是警察的职责。
example.en: Protecting citizens' safety is the duty of the police.

gloss: to transform; to rebuild; to remodel

example.zh: 这片老房子经过改造，变成了一个热闹的文化街区。
example.en: After being renovated, these old houses became a lively cultural district.

example.zh: 吸烟会严重伤害人的肺。
example.en: Smoking seriously harms people's lungs.

example.zh: 班长是同学们民主选出来的。
example.en: The class monitor was democratically elected by the classmates.

indonesian: kata penggolong untuk bangunan; balok bubungan

example.zh: 这栋楼一共有三十层。
example.en: This building has thirty floors in total.

gloss: to supervise; to monitor; to oversee; supervisor

example.zh: 父母应该监督孩子按时完成作业。
example.en: Parents should make sure their children finish their homework on time.

gloss: to encounter (something bad); to meet with; bad experience
indonesian: mengalami (hal buruk); menghadapi; nasib; pengalaman buruk

example.zh: 他在旅途中遭遇了一场大雨。
example.en: He ran into heavy rain during his journey.

example.zh: 现在还不是告诉他的最好时机。
example.en: Now is not the best time to tell him.

gloss: to trigger; to cause; to set off

example.zh: 一个小小的烟头就可能引发一场森林大火。
example.en: A single cigarette butt can set off a forest fire.

example.zh: 很多人对在公众面前讲话感到恐惧。
example.en: Many people are afraid of speaking in public.

example.zh: 这条山路又窄又陡，开车走很险。
example.en: This mountain road is narrow and steep, and driving on it is dangerous.

gloss: to break; to fold; to convert into; discount (e.g. 20% off)
meanings: to break (a stick, a bone etc)
(bound form) to sustain a loss (in business)
to tip sth out (of a container)

example.zh: 这件衣服打八折，只要两百块。
example.en: This piece of clothing is 20% off, only two hundred yuan.

example.zh: 为了修路，他们砍了很多树。
example.en: They cut down a lot of trees to build the road.

gloss: to long for; to yearn for; to thirst for

example.zh: 这些孩子渴望得到更好的教育。
example.en: These children long for a better education.

gloss: to get rid of; to break away from; to free oneself from
indonesian: melepaskan diri dari; terbebas dari; menyingkirkan

example.zh: 他终于摆脱了熬夜的坏习惯。
example.en: He finally got rid of the bad habit of staying up late.

example.zh: 健康是人生最大的财富。
example.en: Health is the greatest wealth in life.

example.zh: 他花了一个月做了一个飞机模型。
example.en: He spent a month making a model plane.

gloss: to break out; to erupt; to explode; outbreak

example.zh: 这座火山上一次爆发是在一百年前。
example.en: This volcano last erupted a hundred years ago.

gloss: to seize, to snatch; to win (a title or prize)

example.zh: 一个小偷从她手里夺过包，转身就跑了。
example.en: A thief snatched the bag from her hand and ran off.

example.zh: 我们应该节约能源，保护环境。
example.en: We should save energy and protect the environment.

gloss: to play the role of; to act as

example.zh: 她在电影里扮演一位中学老师。
example.en: She plays a middle-school teacher in the film.

example.zh: 他是我们团队的核心人物。
example.en: He is the core member of our team.

gloss: to prick; to pierce; to plunge into; to tie (up); to pitch (a tent)
indonesian: menusuk; menancap; menyelam ke; mengikat; mendirikan (tenda)
meanings: to run or stick (a needle etc) into
mug or jug used for serving beer (loanword from "jar")
classifier for flowers, banknotes etc: bundle

example.zh: 我的手指被针扎了一下。
example.en: My finger got pricked by a needle.

gloss: to ensure; to guarantee; to safeguard; guarantee

example.zh: 这项政策保障了老人的基本生活。
example.en: This policy guarantees the elderly a basic standard of living.

example.zh: 这家公司的资产已经超过十亿元。
example.en: This company's assets now exceed one billion yuan.

gloss: to run; to operate; to be in motion; operation
meanings: to move along one's course (of celestial bodies etc)
(fig.) to function; to be in operation
(of a train service etc) to operate; to run

example.zh: 地铁新线路已经开始正式运行了。
example.en: The new metro line has officially started running.

example.zh: 新经理上任后，公司的局面很快好转了。
example.en: After the new manager took over, the company's situation quickly improved.

gloss: to hope; to expect; expectation; hope

example.zh: 父母对孩子的期望不应该太高。
example.en: Parents' expectations of their children shouldn't be too high.

example.zh: 因为天气原因，这几天市场上的蔬菜供应不足。
example.en: Because of the weather, vegetables have been in short supply at the market these past few days.

gloss: for a while, temporarily; for a moment, momentarily

example.zh: 他的名字我一时想不起来了。
example.en: I can't recall his name at the moment.

meanings: gentle and soft; tender; sweet (commonly used to describe a girl or woman)

example.zh: 她说话的声音很温柔。
example.en: She speaks in a very gentle voice.

gloss: to compensate; to make up for; compensation

example.zh: 航班取消了，航空公司给了乘客一些补偿。
example.en: The flight was cancelled, and the airline gave the passengers some compensation.

gloss: to throw, to toss; to abandon

example.zh: 新娘转过身，把手里的花抛向身后的客人。
example.en: The bride turned around and tossed her bouquet to the guests behind her.

gloss: obvious, noticeable; to show, to appear, to look

example.zh: 这件黑色的衣服穿在你身上显得很瘦。
example.en: This black outfit makes you look slim.

example.zh: 天气冷了，出门记得围上围巾，别冻着脖子。
example.en: It's getting cold; remember to wear a scarf when you go out so your neck doesn't get cold.

gloss: to defeat; to overcome; to triumph over

example.zh: 经过一年的治疗，他终于战胜了病魔。
example.en: After a year of treatment, he finally beat his illness.

example.zh: 她被评为公司的年度最佳员工。
example.en: She was named the company's employee of the year.

example.zh: 一个人在国外生活，有时候会觉得很寂寞。
example.en: Living abroad alone, you sometimes feel very lonely.

gloss: to inspect; to test; to examine; inspection

example.zh: 这批产品必须经过检验才能出厂。
example.en: This batch of products must pass inspection before leaving the factory.

gloss: to rule out; to eliminate; to remove

example.zh: 医生已经排除了这种病的可能性。
example.en: The doctor has already ruled out the possibility of this illness.

example.zh: 很久以前，有一位国王非常喜欢音乐。
example.en: Long ago, there was a king who loved music very much.

gloss: to issue; to publish; to release; to distribute

example.zh: 这位歌手下个月将发行新专辑。
example.en: This singer will release a new album next month.

example.zh: 这片树林很密，阳光几乎照不进来。
example.en: This forest is so dense that sunlight can hardly get through.

gloss: to broadcast; to air; to sow

example.zh: 这场比赛电视台将进行现场直播。
example.en: The TV station will broadcast this match live.

gloss: society, association, club; agency (e.g. travel agency)
indonesian: perkumpulan, klub; biro, kantor (misalnya biro perjalanan)

example.zh: 他大学时参加了学校的摄影社，拍了很多好照片。
example.en: In university he joined the photography club and took lots of great photos.

gloss: that very day; the same day
indonesian: hari itu juga; pada hari yang sama

example.zh: 在网上下单的话，当天就能收到货。
example.en: If you order online, you can receive your goods the same day.

meanings: Jing, one of the 28 constellations of Chinese astronomy

example.zh: 村子里的人以前都从这口井里打水。
example.en: The villagers used to draw water from this well.

example.zh: 故事里的王子最后和公主结婚了。
example.en: In the story, the prince married the princess in the end.

gloss: to stick; to glue; to paste

example.zh: 他用胶水把撕破的地图粘好了。
example.en: He glued the torn map back together.

gloss: to drill, to bore; to get into, to burrow into
meanings: to curry favor for personal gain

example.zh: 工人在墙上钻了几个小洞，准备挂画。
example.en: The worker drilled a few small holes in the wall to hang pictures.

example.zh: 节日的街上到处都是欢乐的人群。
example.en: The festive streets are full of joyful crowds.

gloss: to miss; to cherish the memory of; to reminisce

example.zh: 我常常怀念大学时代的生活。
example.en: I often fondly remember my life in my university days.

example.zh: 这个奖是我们全队的荣誉。
example.en: This award is an honour for our whole team.

meanings: refers to the Communists' victory over the Nationalists in 1949

example.zh: 洗碗机把我从家务中解放出来了。
example.en: The dishwasher freed me from housework.

meanings: to collect (works of art, dolls, antiques etc); to put away for safekeeping; (Internet) to bookmark

example.zh: 爷爷收藏了几百张老邮票。
example.en: Grandpa has collected several hundred old stamps.

example.zh: 他总是幻想着有一天能成为明星。
example.en: He always fantasizes about becoming a star one day.

example.zh: 买团体票可以便宜很多。
example.en: Buying group tickets can be a lot cheaper.

example.zh: 《罗密欧与朱丽叶》是莎士比亚最有名的悲剧之一。
example.en: Romeo and Juliet is one of Shakespeare's most famous tragedies.

example.zh: 学校每学期都会组织一次消防演习。
example.en: The school organizes a fire drill every term.

example.zh: 小时候我梦想有一天能去太空旅行。
example.en: As a child I dreamed of travelling to space one day.

example.zh: 对于大家的帮助，我非常感激。
example.en: I am very grateful for everyone's help.

gloss: to pick up (with chopsticks or tongs); to press from both sides; to squeeze
meanings: Taiwan pr. used in 夹生 and 夹竹桃

example.zh: 吃饭时，奶奶用筷子给我夹了一大块鱼。
example.en: At dinner, Grandma picked up a big piece of fish for me with her chopsticks.

example.zh: 请按照屏幕上的指示操作。
example.en: Please follow the instructions on the screen.

gloss: to expose; to reveal; to lay bare

example.zh: 皮肤长时间暴露在阳光下容易晒伤。
example.en: Skin exposed to the sun for a long time burns easily.

gloss: out of; due to; stemming from

example.zh: 他这么做完全是出于好心，你别误会。
example.en: He did it purely out of kindness; don't misunderstand him.

meanings: official (approved or issued by an authority)

example.zh: 这个消息还没有得到官方的证实。
example.en: This news has not yet been officially confirmed.

example.zh: 学习语言不能只是机械地背单词。
example.en: Learning a language can't just be mechanically memorizing words.

example.zh: 伤口还没长好，千万不要沾水。
example.en: The wound hasn't healed yet, so don't get it wet.

example.zh: 照片记录下了这个美好的瞬间。
example.en: The photo captured this wonderful moment.

example.zh: 暴风雪过后，部分地区的电力供应暂时中断。
example.en: After the blizzard, the power supply in some areas was temporarily cut off.

gloss: to be done, to be ready; (after a verb) can manage to; that's enough
indonesian: selesai, siap; (setelah kata kerja) sanggup, bisa; sudah cukup

example.zh: 饭马上就得了，你先洗手准备吃饭吧。
example.en: Dinner's almost ready; go wash your hands first.

gloss: to guide; to lead; to direct

example.zh: 老师应该引导学生独立思考。
example.en: Teachers should guide students to think independently.

example.zh: 请大家协助我们完成这项调查。
example.en: Please help us complete this survey.

example.zh: 听到奶奶去世的消息，他悲伤得说不出话来。
example.en: On hearing that his grandmother had died, he was too grief-stricken to speak.

gloss: to belong to; to be born in the year of (a zodiac animal)
meanings: be born in the year of (one of the 12 animals)

example.zh: 这片森林属国家所有，任何人不得随意砍伐。
example.en: This forest belongs to the state, and nobody may cut it down at will.

example.zh: 她在一家公司做财务工作。
example.en: She does finance work at a company.

gloss: to damage, to harm, to injure; damage, injury

example.zh: 长时间戴耳机听音乐，会损伤听力。
example.en: Listening to music through headphones for long periods can damage your hearing.

example.zh: 他是我们公司的法律顾问。
example.en: He is our company's legal adviser.

example.zh: 这部电影的主角是一个普通的出租车司机。
example.en: The protagonist of this film is an ordinary taxi driver.

gloss: to marry (a woman); to take a wife

example.zh: 他三十岁那年娶了一个北京姑娘。
example.en: The year he turned thirty, he married a girl from Beijing.

example.zh: 她现在是总经理的助理。
example.en: She is now the general manager's assistant.

example.zh: 这个年轻人很有发展潜力。
example.en: This young man has great potential.

example.zh: 她脸上总是带着甜甜的笑容。
example.en: She always has a sweet smile on her face.

gloss: to eliminate; to remove; to clear up

example.zh: 面对面交流有助于消除误会。
example.en: Talking face to face helps clear up misunderstandings.

example.zh: 遇到困难时，要学会向别人寻求帮助。
example.en: When you run into difficulties, learn to seek help from others.

example.zh: 现代通讯技术让交流变得很方便。
example.en: Modern communication technology has made exchanges very convenient.

example.zh: 她把内心的痛苦隐藏得很深，从来不让别人看出来。
example.en: She hides her inner pain deep inside and never lets others see it.

gloss: backward; to fall behind; to lag

example.zh: 这个地区的经济还比较落后。
example.en: The economy of this region is still rather backward.

gloss: forget it; never mind; let it go

example.zh: 算了，既然他不想去，我们就别勉强他了。
example.en: Forget it; since he doesn't want to go, let's not force him.

gloss: ruthless, fierce; to harden one's heart; severely, firmly
indonesian: kejam, ganas; mengeraskan hati; dengan keras

example.zh: 他狠狠地批评了自己的儿子一顿。
example.en: He gave his son a severe scolding.

gloss: to plan; to plot; to engineer; planner

example.zh: 这次活动是由我们部门策划的。
example.en: This event was planned by our department.

example.zh: 他蹲在地上找掉了的钥匙。
example.en: He crouched on the ground looking for the keys he had dropped.

example.zh: 天气这么差，现在去爬山太冒险了。
example.en: The weather is so bad; going hiking now is too risky.

gloss: to lead along; to pull; to hold (hands); to involve
meanings: to pull (an animal on a tether)

example.zh: 他牵着狗在公园里散步。
example.en: He walked his dog on a lead in the park.

example.zh: 生气的时候，千万不要冲动地做决定。
example.en: When you're angry, never make decisions on impulse.

gloss: to test; to put to the test; trial

example.zh: 这次困难是对我们友谊的考验。
example.en: This difficulty is a test of our friendship.

example.zh: 写作也需要掌握一定的技巧。
example.en: Writing also requires mastering certain techniques.

gloss: the world; all under heaven; the whole country

example.zh: 天下没有免费的午餐，这么便宜的东西你可要小心。
example.en: There's no such thing as a free lunch; be careful with something this cheap.

example.zh: 裁判的判罚很公正，大家都没有意见。
example.en: The referee's decisions were fair, and nobody objected.

example.zh: 他们一家人生活得很和谐。
example.en: Their family lives together very harmoniously.

example.zh: 别看他年纪小，下棋可是个高手。
example.en: He may be young, but he's an expert at chess.

gloss: to appear; to present; to emerge; to show

example.zh: 春天到了，公园里呈现出一片生机。
example.en: Spring has arrived, and the park is full of life.

example.zh: 喝了一碗热汤，身上一下子就暖了。
example.en: After a bowl of hot soup, I warmed up right away.

meanings: to draw up a plan; to map out a program

example.zh: 大学生应该早一点做好职业规划。
example.en: University students should do their career planning early.

example.zh: 妈妈说，作业写完以前不许看电视。
example.en: Mom says no TV until homework is done.

gloss: more than; not limited to; incessantly

example.zh: 这个问题我已经解释了不止一次了。
example.en: I've explained this question more than once already.

gloss: video recording; to record on video

example.zh: 婚礼那天，他用手机录像，把整个过程都录了下来。
example.en: On the wedding day, he filmed the whole thing on his phone.

gloss: to exempt, to excuse from; to avoid
meanings: to remove or dismiss from office

example.zh: 七十岁以上的老人乘坐公交车免票。
example.en: Seniors over seventy ride the bus for free.

gloss: to turn around; to turn one's body

example.zh: 他转身向门口走去，再也没有回头。
example.en: He turned and walked toward the door, never looking back.

example.zh: 如果货物在运输中损坏，公司会负责赔偿。
example.en: If the goods are damaged in transit, the company will pay compensation.

example.zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋混合在一起。
example.en: Mix the flour and the eggs together.

meanings: to meet with (sb who is paying a visit)

example.zh: 国家主席昨天在北京会见了来访的外国总统。
example.en: The President yesterday met the visiting foreign president in Beijing.

gloss: to act on behalf of; acting (temporarily); agent
meanings: to act on behalf of sb in a responsible position
to act as an agent or proxy

example.zh: 经理出差期间，由他代理经理的工作。
example.en: While the manager is away on business, he is acting as manager.

example.zh: 你明明知道答案，为什么不说出来？
example.en: You obviously know the answer, so why don't you say it?

gloss: the masses; the public; the people

example.zh: 围观的群众越来越多，交通都堵住了。
example.en: More and more onlookers gathered, and the traffic came to a standstill.

gloss: to complain (to an authority); to lodge a complaint; complaint
meanings: to register a complaint (esp. as a customer)

example.zh: 顾客向经理投诉了服务员的态度。
example.en: The customer complained to the manager about the waiter's attitude.

example.zh: 这次比赛的胜利，无疑给了全队很大的信心。
example.en: This victory undoubtedly gave the whole team a big confidence boost.

example.zh: 工作累了，他喜欢去按摩放松一下。
example.en: When he's tired from work, he likes to get a massage to relax.

gloss: tendency; inclination; to be inclined to

example.zh: 我更倾向于选择第二个方案。
example.en: I'm more inclined to choose the second plan.

example.zh: 说实话，我不太喜欢这部电影。
example.en: To tell the truth, I don't really like this film.

gloss: to save a life; Help! (cry for help)

example.zh: 他掉进了河里，一边挣扎一边拼命地喊：“救命啊！”
example.en: He fell into the river and, struggling, shouted desperately: Help!

gloss: to not care; to not matter

example.zh: 去哪儿吃饭我无所谓，你决定吧。
example.en: I don't mind where we eat; you decide.

example.zh: 厨房里好像有老鼠，我们得想办法抓住它。
example.en: There seems to be a mouse in the kitchen; we need to find a way to catch it.

example.zh: 他们全家十年前移民到了加拿大。
example.en: His whole family emigrated to Canada ten years ago.

example.zh: 联合国总部设在美国纽约，每年都有很多游客去参观。
example.en: The United Nations headquarters is in New York, and many tourists visit it every year.

example.zh: 我从来没有遇到过这种情形。
example.en: I've never come across this kind of situation before.

gloss: to hold; to possess; to own

example.zh: 根据规定，乘客必须持有有效证件才能登机。
example.en: Under the rules, passengers must hold valid ID to board.

gloss: while (the chance lasts); to take advantage of

example.zh: 趁着天气好，我们出去散散步吧。
example.en: Let's go out for a walk while the weather is nice.

gloss: to merge; to combine; to annex

example.zh: 这两个部门下个月将合并成一个。
example.en: These two departments will be merged into one next month.

example.zh: 导游带领我们参观了这座古城。
example.en: The tour guide led us on a visit of this ancient city.

example.zh: 人类一直在探索宇宙的奥秘。
example.en: Humanity has always been exploring the mysteries of the universe.

gloss: to resist; to oppose; to confront; confrontation

example.zh: 两支球队的对抗非常激烈。
example.en: The contest between the two teams was very intense.

gloss: to go out (of a light or fire); to extinguish; to destroy
meanings: to go out (of a fire etc)

example.zh: 风太大了，蜡烛一下子就被吹灭了。
example.en: The wind was so strong that the candle was blown out instantly.

example.zh: 请大家排好队上车，保持良好的秩序。
example.en: Please line up to board and keep things orderly.

example.zh: 血管就像一条条管道，把血送到身体的每一个地方。
example.en: Blood vessels are like pipes that carry blood to every part of the body.

example.zh: 如果对产品有任何问题，可以拨打我们的服务热线。
example.en: If you have any questions about the product, you can call our service hotline.

example.zh: 女儿最喜欢的礼物是一个布娃娃。
example.en: My daughter's favourite present is a rag doll.

example.zh: 今年的游客比以往多了很多。
example.en: There are many more tourists this year than in the past.

gloss: to be related; to be connected; connection
meanings: to be related; to be connected

example.zh: 这两件事表面上看没有关联，其实关系很大。
example.en: On the surface these two things seem unrelated, but they're actually closely connected.

example.zh: 在他看来，金钱永远比不上家人的健康。
example.en: In his view, money can never compare with his family's health.

gloss: to eliminate; to wipe out; to exterminate

example.zh: 这种药可以消灭体内的细菌。
example.en: This medicine can wipe out bacteria in the body.

gloss: to deceive; to cheat; to dupe

example.zh: 广告不应该欺骗消费者。
example.en: Advertisements should not deceive consumers.

example.zh: 节日期间，街头到处都挂着红灯笼。
example.en: During the festival, red lanterns hang everywhere in the streets.

example.zh: 这个小女孩的记忆力很惊人，看一遍就能背下来。
example.en: This little girl has an amazing memory; she can recite something after reading it once.

gloss: to question; to doubt; to call into question

example.zh: 很多专家对这项研究的结果提出了质疑。
example.en: Many experts have questioned the results of this study.

example.zh: 他每天骑摩托车去上班。
example.en: He rides a motorcycle to work every day.

example.zh: 他大学学的是金融专业。
example.en: He majored in finance at university.

example.zh: 两国之间的贸易关系越来越密切。
example.en: Trade relations between the two countries are getting closer and closer.

example.zh: 桌子上还留着咖啡杯的痕迹。
example.en: There are still marks from a coffee cup on the table.

gloss: to dye; to catch (a disease); to be tainted by
meanings: to add color washes to a painting

example.zh: 她把头发染成了浅棕色。
example.en: She dyed her hair light brown.

example.zh: 这台电视的画面非常清晰。
example.en: This TV has a very clear picture.

example.zh: 我们在码头等了半个小时，船才到。
example.en: We waited at the pier for half an hour before the boat arrived.

gloss: to circulate; to cycle; cycle; loop

example.zh: 多运动能促进血液循环。
example.en: Exercising more improves blood circulation.

gloss: to report; to give an account of; report
meanings: to collect information and report back

example.zh: 明天上午我要向经理汇报工作。
example.en: Tomorrow morning I have to report on my work to the manager.

example.zh: 他三十岁就当上了公司的总裁。
example.en: He became the company's CEO at just thirty.

gloss: to appraise; to identify; to authenticate; appraisal

example.zh: 专家鉴定后认为这幅画是真的。
example.en: After appraising it, the experts concluded the painting was genuine.

example.zh: 这件衣服的颜色搭配得很协调。
example.en: The colours of this outfit go together very harmoniously.

gloss: to surpass; to exceed; to transcend

example.zh: 他的成绩已经超越了自己的老师。
example.en: His achievements have already surpassed those of his teacher.

gloss: to spread; to lay; to pave; shop

example.zh: 妈妈在桌子上铺了一块新桌布。
example.en: Mum spread a new tablecloth on the table.

example.zh: 下了一夜的雨，村里的土路上全是泥。
example.en: After a whole night of rain, the village's dirt road is nothing but mud.

example.zh: 这部电影告诉我们，正义终将战胜邪恶。
example.en: This film tells us that justice will eventually triumph over evil.

gloss: the public; the populace; the people
meanings: the populace; the masses; the common people

example.zh: 政府应该多听听民众的声音。
example.en: The government should listen more to the voice of the people.

example.zh: 电影里那个雨中分别的场景让很多观众流下了眼泪。
example.en: The farewell scene in the rain brought many viewers to tears.

example.zh: 青春是人生中最美好的时光。
example.en: Youth is the most beautiful time of life.

gloss: to rescue; to come to the aid of; rescue, relief

example.zh: 地震发生后，救援人员第一时间赶到了现场。
example.en: After the earthquake, rescue workers arrived on the scene right away.

example.zh: 购物的欲望常常让人花很多钱。
example.en: The urge to shop often makes people spend a lot of money.

gloss: to be defeated, to lose; to fail; to defeat

example.zh: 这支球队在决赛中以一比二败给了对手。
example.en: The team lost two to one to their opponents in the final.

example.zh: 在这个问题上，我们的立场是一致的。
example.en: On this issue, our positions are the same.

meanings: serious fire (in a city or a forest etc)

example.zh: 昨晚那场火灾造成了很大的经济损失。
example.en: Last night's fire caused heavy economic losses.

gloss: to firmly believe; to determine; to establish

example.zh: 他认定自己的选择是对的。
example.en: He was firmly convinced that his choice was right.

gloss: to fall; to tumble; to drop (of prices)

example.zh: 最近蔬菜的价格跌了不少。
example.en: Vegetable prices have fallen quite a lot recently.

example.zh: 她大学学的是会计，现在在银行工作。
example.en: She studied accounting at university and now works at a bank.

example.zh: 这个主意太妙了，我怎么就没想到呢？
example.en: What a brilliant idea; why didn't I think of it?

meanings: Shihtzu township in Pingtung County 屏东县, Taiwan

example.zh: 动物园里的狮子正躺在树下睡觉。
example.en: The lion at the zoo is lying under a tree, asleep.

example.zh: 他很有经济头脑，二十岁就开了自己的公司。
example.en: He has a real head for business and started his own company at twenty.

gloss: actually, contrary to expectation; though, but
meanings: contrary to what one might expect

example.zh: 这家饭馆不大，菜的味道倒是不错。
example.en: This restaurant isn't big, but the food is actually quite good.

example.zh: 此刻，他的心情激动得无法用语言形容。
example.en: At this moment, his excitement is beyond words.

gloss: to be enough to; sufficient to

example.zh: 这些证据足以说明他说的是真话。
example.en: This evidence is enough to show that he's telling the truth.

gloss: chi (Chinese unit of length, about a third of a metre); ruler
indonesian: chi (satuan panjang Tiongkok, kira-kira sepertiga meter); penggaris
meanings: one of the characters used to represent a musical note in gongche notation, 工尺谱
one of the three acupoints for measuring pulse in Chinese medicine

example.zh: 这条鱼足有三尺长，是我见过最大的。
example.en: This fish is a full three chi long, the biggest I've ever seen.

gloss: to communicate (by letter, phone, etc.); to correspond; communications
indonesian: berkomunikasi (lewat surat, telepon, dll.); berkorespondensi; telekomunikasi

example.zh: 大学毕业后，我们一直保持通信，至今已有二十年。
example.en: We've kept in touch by letter since graduating from university, for twenty years now.

example.zh: 婚礼的场面非常热闹，大家都很开心。
example.en: The wedding was a very lively scene and everyone was happy.

example.zh: 在国外留学的时候，她非常想念祖国。
example.en: While studying abroad she missed her homeland very much.

example.zh: 老师没有惩罚他，而是耐心地跟他谈话。
example.en: The teacher didn't punish him but talked with him patiently.

example.zh: 她负责处理公司的日常事务。
example.en: She is in charge of handling the company's daily affairs.

gloss: to care about; to mind; to take to heart

example.zh: 别太在意别人怎么看你。
example.en: Don't care too much about what others think of you.

gloss: cun (Chinese unit of length, about 3.3 cm); inch
indonesian: cun (satuan panjang Tiongkok, kira-kira 3,3 cm); inci

example.zh: 他买了一台五十五寸的电视，放在客厅正合适。
example.en: He bought a 55-inch TV, which fits the living room perfectly.

gloss: to resist; to stand up to; resistance

example.zh: 多运动可以增强身体抵抗疾病的能力。
example.en: Exercising more can strengthen the body's ability to resist disease.

example.zh: 我们应该了解孩子学习的动机。
example.en: We should understand children's motivation for learning.

example.zh: 这部电视剧的情节很吸引人。
example.en: The plot of this TV drama is very gripping.

example.zh: 这家超市虽小，但是日常用品一样都不缺。
example.en: This supermarket may be small, but it has every everyday item you need.

example.zh: 这次活动的效果超出了我们的预期。
example.en: The results of this event exceeded our expectations.

example.en: The two of them quarreled over a trivial matter yesterday.

example.zh: 一辆大货车停在路边，工人们正在往下搬东西。
example.en: A big truck was parked by the road, and workers were unloading it.

gloss: to appear (on stage or in a game); to come on
meanings: (of a performer) to come onto the stage to perform
(of an athlete) to enter the arena to compete
(fig.) to enter the scene (e.g. a new product)
(of an examinee etc) to leave the venue

example.zh: 演唱会快开始了，大家都在等歌手出场。
example.en: The concert is about to begin, and everyone is waiting for the singer to come on.

example.zh: 大家都说他是一个数学天才。
example.en: Everyone says he is a maths genius.

gloss: always (up to now); all along; consistently
meanings: a period of time in the recent past

example.zh: 他一向很守时，今天怎么还没来？
example.en: He's always punctual; why hasn't he come yet today?

gloss: to despair; to give up hope; desperate; despair

example.zh: 即使遇到再大的困难，也不要绝望。
example.en: No matter how great the difficulties, don't despair.

example.zh: 秋天的西湖特别迷人。
example.en: West Lake in autumn is especially charming.

example.zh: 她申请了一个经理的职位。
example.en: She applied for a manager's position.

example.zh: 她每天出门前都要化妆半个小时。
example.en: She spends half an hour putting on makeup every day before going out.

example.zh: 大城市的生活节奏很快。
example.en: The pace of life in big cities is very fast.

example.zh: 那个自称是银行工作人员的人其实是个骗子。
example.en: The man who claimed to be a bank employee was actually a con man.

example.zh: 他是这家医院外科最有名的医生。
example.en: He is the best-known doctor in this hospital's surgical department.

example.zh: 他一个人坐在教室的角落里看书。
example.en: He sat alone in the corner of the classroom reading.

meanings: script for play, opera, movie etc

example.zh: 演员们拿到剧本后马上开始排练。
example.en: The actors started rehearsing as soon as they got the script.

example.zh: 他们俩从小一起长大，关系非常亲密。
example.en: The two of them grew up together and are very close.

example.zh: 请先把软件更新到最新的版本。
example.en: Please update the software to the latest version first.

indonesian: sekalian saja; langsung saja; terus terang

example.zh: 既然这么麻烦，我们干脆别去了。
example.en: Since it's such a hassle, let's just not go.

gloss: to disturb; to interfere with; interference

example.zh: 请把手机调成静音，不要干扰别人。
example.en: Please put your phone on silent and don't disturb others.

example.zh: 他被蚊子咬了一口，第二天整只手都肿了。
example.en: He got bitten by a mosquito, and the next day his whole hand was swollen.

example.zh: 阅读是获取知识的重要途径。
example.en: Reading is an important way to acquire knowledge.

example.zh: 考试结果还没出来，他心里很不安。
example.en: The exam results aren't out yet, and he feels very uneasy.

example.zh: 这所大学有完善的教学体系。
example.en: This university has a well-developed teaching system.

gloss: to suffer; to be subjected to; to sustain (a loss)

example.zh: 这个地区去年遭受了严重的洪水。
example.en: This region suffered severe flooding last year.

gloss: to recover; to be restored to health; rehabilitation

example.zh: 经过半年的治疗，他已经完全康复了。
example.en: After six months of treatment, he has made a full recovery.

gloss: to go through; to pass through; to cross

example.zh: 我们穿过一条小巷，来到了一家老茶馆。
example.en: We went through a little alley and came to an old teahouse.

indonesian: rel; orbit; lintasan; jalur yang semestinya
meanings: (fig.) a person's established path in life
desired trajectory (of a business or other endeavor)

example.zh: 卫星已经顺利进入预定轨道。
example.en: The satellite has successfully entered its planned orbit.

example.zh: 越来越多的农村人口搬到城镇生活。
example.en: More and more rural people are moving to live in towns.

gloss: to bear; to endure; to tolerate

example.zh: 我实在忍受不了邻居家的噪音了。
example.en: I really can't stand the noise from the neighbours anymore.

example.zh: 生病的时候，人的心理也会变得很脆弱。
example.en: When people are ill, they also become emotionally fragile.

example.zh: 我小时候特别喜欢看日本漫画。
example.en: When I was little I especially loved reading Japanese manga.

example.zh: 他轻轻地拍了拍我的肩膀。
example.en: He gently patted me on the shoulder.

gloss: to inherit; to carry on; to succeed

example.zh: 他继承了父亲留下的小饭馆。
example.en: He inherited the small restaurant his father left.

gloss: to make up for; to remedy; to offset
meanings: to make up for a deficiency

example.zh: 他想用实际行动来弥补自己的过错。
example.en: He wants to make up for his mistake through concrete actions.

gloss: to pounce on; to throw oneself on; to rush at; to flap

example.zh: 孩子一见到妈妈，就扑到了她的怀里。
example.en: As soon as the child saw his mum, he threw himself into her arms.

example.zh: 航班将于晚上八点抵达北京。
example.en: The flight will arrive in Beijing at eight in the evening.

meanings: (slang) to put in long hours, typically late into the night, playing (a video game)
(of a video game) involving a lot of repetition in order to progress; grindy

example.zh: 医生提醒他，经常喝酒对肝的伤害很大。
example.en: The doctor warned him that drinking regularly does a lot of damage to the liver.

gloss: it's just as well, that's fine; whether... or... (in pairs)

example.zh: 坐火车也好，坐飞机也好，只要能按时到就行。
example.en: Whether by train or by plane, it's fine as long as we get there on time.

example.zh: 上课的时候，他偷偷地在下面玩手机。
example.en: During class, he secretly played on his phone under the desk.

gloss: to neglect; to overlook; to ignore
meanings: to neglect; to overlook; to ignore

example.zh: 工作再忙，也不能忽略自己的健康。
example.en: No matter how busy you are at work, you can't neglect your health.

gloss: sauce; paste; jam; to pickle in soy sauce
indonesian: saus; pasta; selai; mengasinkan dengan kecap

example.zh: 早上我喜欢在面包上抹一点儿草莓酱。
example.en: In the morning I like to spread a little strawberry jam on my bread.

gloss: to support; to prop up; to sustain; support

example.zh: 这座老房子靠几根木头支撑着。
example.en: This old house is held up by a few wooden beams.

example.zh: 多年过去了，这里的风景依旧美丽。
example.en: Many years have passed, but the scenery here is as beautiful as ever.

gloss: to come; to arrive; to approach

example.zh: 冬天来临之前，农民们要把粮食都收进仓库。
example.en: Before winter comes, farmers have to get all their grain into the barns.

example.zh: 这件衣服加入了很多中国传统元素。
example.en: This garment incorporates many traditional Chinese elements.

example.zh: 父母不应该强迫孩子学自己不喜欢的东西。
example.en: Parents shouldn't force their children to learn things they don't like.

gloss: to float; to drift; to surface

example.zh: 几片树叶浮在水面上，慢慢地往下游漂去。
example.en: A few leaves floated on the water, drifting slowly downstream.

example.zh: 这次比赛的奖品是一台新电脑。
example.en: The prize in this competition is a new computer.

example.zh: 这些货物都存放在仓库里。
example.en: These goods are all stored in the warehouse.

gloss: to look back on; to review; review

example.zh: 回顾过去的一年，我学到了很多东西。
example.en: Looking back on the past year, I've learned a lot.

example.zh: 无论在什么岗位，他都认真负责。
example.en: Whatever position he's in, he's conscientious and responsible.

gloss: to imitate; to copy; to mimic

example.zh: 孩子很喜欢模仿大人说话。
example.en: Children love to imitate the way adults talk.

example.zh: 健康是做好一切工作的前提。
example.en: Health is the precondition for doing any job well.

example.zh: 由于经营不好，这家公司去年破产了。
example.en: Because it was poorly run, this company went bankrupt last year.

example.zh: 保持厨房的清洁非常重要。
example.en: Keeping the kitchen clean is very important.

example.zh: 这家商场三楼专门卖内衣和睡衣。
example.en: The third floor of this mall sells underwear and pajamas.

gloss: scalding hot; to scald; to iron or perm
indonesian: sangat panas; melepuh; menyetrika atau mengeriting
meanings: to heat (sth) up in hot water

example.zh: 水太烫了，小心别烫着手。
example.en: The water is too hot; be careful not to scald your hand.

example.zh: 这位明星一出现，就成了大家关注的焦点。
example.en: As soon as the star appeared, she became the focus of everyone's attention.

example.zh: 父母为儿子取得的成绩感到自豪。
example.en: The parents are proud of what their son has achieved.

example.zh: 这家公司的员工福利很好。
example.en: This company's employee benefits are very good.

example.zh: 电梯出了故障，我们只好走楼梯。
example.en: The elevator broke down, so we had to take the stairs.

example.zh: 这位画家用了很独特的艺术手法。
example.en: This painter used a very distinctive artistic technique.

gloss: to criticize; to censure; to blame

example.zh: 出了问题不要互相指责，先想办法解决。
example.en: When problems arise, don't blame each other; first find a way to solve them.

gloss: to rush; to break through; to venture out

example.zh: 他没敲门就直接闯进了经理的办公室。
example.en: He barged straight into the manager's office without knocking.

example.zh: 经常锻炼可以提高身体的免疫力。
example.en: Regular exercise can boost the body's immunity.

example.zh: 结婚的时候，他给她戴上了戒指。
example.en: At their wedding, he put the ring on her finger.

example.zh: 她是个很单纯的女孩，很容易相信别人。
example.en: She's a very innocent girl who trusts people easily.

gloss: to cut; to mow; to sever

example.zh: 爷爷正在院子里割草。
example.en: Grandpa is cutting the grass in the yard.

example.zh: 我们已经有了一个初步的计划。
example.en: We already have a preliminary plan.

example.zh: 假设你是老板，你会怎么处理这个问题？
example.en: Suppose you were the boss; how would you handle this problem?

gloss: to trouble; to bother; to plague

example.zh: 失眠问题已经困扰他好几年了。
example.en: Insomnia has troubled him for several years.

gloss: to arrange; to decorate; to assign (homework)

example.zh: 同学们正在布置教室，准备晚会。
example.en: The students are decorating the classroom to get ready for the party.

example.zh: 老人和孕妇可以优先上车。
example.en: The elderly and pregnant women may board first.

gloss: to hang; to suspend; to lift (with a crane)

example.zh: 天花板上吊着一盏漂亮的灯。
example.en: A beautiful lamp hangs from the ceiling.

example.en: He fell while playing ball and hurt his arm.

gloss: to carry; to take along; to bring

example.zh: 乘客不得携带易燃物品上飞机。
example.en: Passengers may not bring flammable items onto the plane.

gloss: to gather; to assemble; to cluster

example.zh: 广场上聚集了很多人，都在等着看烟花。
example.en: Lots of people gathered in the square, all waiting to watch the fireworks.

gloss: to appoint; to designate; to assign
meanings: to indicate clearly and with certainty

example.zh: 请把车停在指定的位置。
example.en: Please park in the designated spot.

meanings: part (esp. of the body, but also of a vegetable (e.g. the root), or a garment (e.g. the sleeve) etc)

example.zh: 请告诉医生你身体哪个部位疼。
example.en: Please tell the doctor which part of your body hurts.

gloss: to integrate into; to blend into; to fit in

example.zh: 刚到国外的时候，我花了很长时间才融入当地的生活。
example.en: When I first went abroad, it took me a long time to fit into local life.

gloss: to encourage; to motivate; to inspire; incentive

example.zh: 老师的话激励着我不断努力。
example.en: The teacher's words keep motivating me to work hard.

example.zh: 她坚定地相信自己一定能成功。
example.en: She firmly believes she will definitely succeed.

gloss: grain; granule; measure word for small round things
indonesian: butir; biji; kata satuan untuk benda kecil bulat
meanings: classifier for small round things (peas, bullets, peanuts, pills, grains etc)

example.zh: 这种药每天饭后吃一粒就可以了。
example.en: Just take one pill of this medicine after meals every day.

gloss: senior level, top management; high-ranking; high-rise
indonesian: pimpinan tingkat atas; tingkat tinggi; gedung bertingkat tinggi

example.zh: 公司高层正在开会讨论明年的发展计划。
example.en: Senior management is meeting to discuss next year's development plan.

gloss: to permit; to allow; permission; licence

example.zh: 没有许可，不能进入这个实验室。
example.en: You can't enter this laboratory without permission.

example.zh: 那场大地震给当地带来了巨大的灾难。
example.en: That big earthquake brought a huge disaster to the area.

gloss: so that; in order to; so as to

example.zh: 请留下电话号码，以便我们和你联系。
example.en: Please leave your phone number so that we can contact you.

example.zh: 作为一名军人，保卫国家是他的责任。
example.en: As a soldier, defending the country is his duty.

example.zh: 请你给“成功”下一个定义。
example.en: Please give a definition of "success".

example.zh: 这台相机拍出来的图像非常清晰。
example.en: The images this camera takes are very sharp.

meanings: brief pause at the end of a phrase (variant of 读)

example.zh: 他很会讲笑话，常常把大家逗得哈哈大笑。
example.en: He's great at telling jokes and often has everyone roaring with laughter.

gloss: to float (in the air); to flutter

example.zh: 天上飘着几朵白云。
example.en: A few white clouds are floating in the sky.

example.zh: 这幅古画已经被专家修复好了。
example.en: This ancient painting has been restored by experts.

example.zh: 按照常规，新员工要先培训一个月才能上岗。
example.en: As a rule, new employees train for a month before starting work.

gloss: to depend on; to rely on; dependence

example.zh: 孩子长大了，不能总是依赖父母。
example.en: Once children grow up they can't always rely on their parents.

gloss: to scatter; to disperse; to distract; scattered

example.zh: 玩手机会分散学生的注意力。
example.en: Playing with phones distracts students' attention.

gloss: to miss (because of delay); to mistake; by mistake

example.zh: 路上堵车太厉害，我差点儿误了飞机。
example.en: The traffic was so bad I nearly missed my flight.

example.zh: 家里新添了一台洗衣机，妈妈轻松多了。
example.en: We've added a new washing machine at home, which makes things much easier for Mom.

gloss: to fulfil; to perform; to carry out (a duty or promise)

example.zh: 签了合同，双方就要履行各自的义务。
example.en: Once the contract is signed, both parties must fulfil their obligations.

example.zh: 他参加了全国数学竞赛并获得了二等奖。
example.en: He entered the national maths competition and won second prize.

gloss: to be forced; to be compelled

example.zh: 因为天气原因，飞机被迫降落在附近的机场。
example.en: Because of the weather, the plane was forced to land at a nearby airport.

gloss: to fight over; to compete for; to vie for

example.zh: 两支球队正在争夺冠军。
example.en: The two teams are competing for the championship.

example.zh: 请用手机扫描这个二维码，就可以付款了。
example.en: Scan this QR code with your phone and you can pay.

example.zh: 这家公司始终坚持“顾客第一”的经营理念。
example.en: This company has always held to the business philosophy of putting customers first.

gloss: to rank; to be ranked; ranking

example.zh: 在这次比赛中，他排名第三，拿到了铜牌。
example.en: He ranked third in this competition and won the bronze medal.

example.zh: 你使用这个软件的频率高吗？
example.en: Do you use this app often?

gloss: to flee; to run away; to escape

example.zh: 小偷看见警察来了，转身就逃跑了。
example.en: When the thief saw the police coming, he turned and ran.

example.zh: 法律面前人人平等。
example.en: Everyone is equal before the law.

gloss: can; jar; pot; measure word for cans and jars
indonesian: kaleng; stoples; guci; kata penggolong untuk kaleng atau stoples

example.zh: 我在超市买了两罐可乐。
example.en: I bought two cans of cola at the supermarket.

gloss: everyone; the crowd; all the people present

example.zh: 他的发言赢得了众人的掌声。
example.en: His speech won applause from everyone.

gloss: voluntary; of one's own free will

example.zh: 参加这个活动完全是自愿的。
example.en: Taking part in this activity is entirely voluntary.

example.zh: 他在这次比赛中获得了一枚铜牌。
example.en: He won a bronze medal in this competition.

gloss: to hint; to suggest; hint; suggestion

example.zh: 她看了看手表，暗示我们该走了。
example.en: She glanced at her watch, hinting that we should leave.

gloss: sharp, pointed; tip, point; (of a voice) shrill
meanings: (of one's hearing, sight etc) sharp; acute; keen
the best of sth; the cream of the crop

example.zh: 这把刀很尖，用的时候要小心。
example.en: This knife is very sharp-pointed, so be careful when using it.

example.zh: 古代的士兵打仗时常用弓和箭。
example.en: Soldiers in ancient times often fought with bows and arrows.

example.zh: 请把原始数据保存好，不要随便修改。
example.en: Please keep the original data safe and don't change it casually.

gloss: finally; at long last; on the whole

example.zh: 等了一个多小时，公共汽车总算来了。
example.en: After waiting over an hour, the bus finally came.

example.zh: 最近大家都在谈论这部新上映的电影。
example.en: Everyone has been talking about this newly released film lately.

gloss: to twist; to turn (one's head or body); to sprain

example.zh: 听到有人喊她，她扭过头来笑了笑。
example.en: Hearing someone call her, she turned her head and smiled.

gloss: to convert; to transform; to switch

example.zh: 这个软件可以把文字转换成语音。
example.en: This software can convert text into speech.

gloss: to match; to pair up; to combine; collocation
meanings: to add sth into a group

example.zh: 这件衬衫和你的裤子搭配得很好。
example.en: This shirt goes very well with your trousers.

example.zh: 他是班里最活跃的学生，经常参加各种活动。
example.en: He is the most active student in the class and often joins all kinds of activities.

example.zh: 碗洗净以后，要放在架子上晾干。
example.en: Once the bowls are washed clean, put them on the rack to dry.

gloss: to be born; to come into being; to emerge

example.zh: 这个伟大的发明诞生于一个小实验室。
example.en: This great invention was born in a small laboratory.

example.zh: 在正式场合，最好穿得正式一点儿。
example.en: On formal occasions, it's best to dress a bit more formally.

gloss: to purchase; to acquire (a company); to buy up

example.zh: 这家公司去年以五亿元收购了一家小型软件企业。
example.en: Last year this company acquired a small software firm for 500 million yuan.

example.zh: 这座大桥在洪水中被冲毁，政府决定尽快重建。
example.en: The bridge was washed away in the flood, and the government has decided to rebuild it as soon as possible.

gloss: to string together; to mix up; measure word for strings or bunches
indonesian: merangkai; tertukar; kata satuan untuk untaian atau rangkaian
meanings: classifier for things that are strung together, or in a bunch, or in a row: string of, bunch of, series of
to make a swift or abrupt linear movement (like a bead on an abacus)

example.zh: 他手里拿着一串钥匙。
example.en: He's holding a bunch of keys in his hand.

example.zh: 一棵大树横在路中间，车过不去。
example.en: A big tree was lying across the road, so cars couldn't get through.

gloss: to be optimistic about; to have high hopes for; to fancy
meanings: to regard as having good prospects

example.zh: 很多专家都看好这家公司的发展前景。
example.en: Many experts are optimistic about this company's prospects.

gloss: vision; insight; eye; way of looking at things

example.zh: 你挑衣服的眼光真不错。
example.en: You've got a really good eye for choosing clothes.

gloss: to occupy; to hold; to take up

example.zh: 手机占据了我们太多的时间。
example.en: Phones take up too much of our time.

example.zh: 你说得太夸张了，事情没那么严重。
example.en: You're exaggerating; things aren't that serious.

example.zh: 这家酒店的服务是一流的。
example.en: The service at this hotel is first-class.

example.zh: 楼里的管道坏了，水一直往外流。
example.en: A pipe in the building broke, and water kept pouring out.

example.zh: 名人效应让这款产品一下子成了热门。
example.en: The celebrity effect turned this product into a hit overnight.

gloss: to shoot; to fire (a gun); shooting

example.zh: 他从小就开始练习射击。
example.en: He started practicing shooting when he was a child.

gloss: to take out (from a pocket); to fish out; to dig

example.zh: 他从口袋里掏出手机看了一眼。
example.en: He took his phone out of his pocket and glanced at it.

gloss: to approve; to accept; to recognise; approval

example.zh: 他的能力得到了大家的认可。
example.en: His ability has been recognised by everyone.

example.zh: 他吃了不新鲜的海鲜，食物中毒住进了医院。
example.en: He ate seafood that wasn't fresh and ended up in hospital with food poisoning.

example.zh: 医院只允许病人家属进入病房。
example.en: The hospital only allows patients' family members into the ward.

example.zh: 我坚决反对这个计划。
example.en: I firmly oppose this plan.

example.zh: 我们不能只看一个人的外表。
example.en: We can't judge a person only by appearance.

example.zh: 他对这次考试信心十足。
example.en: He is fully confident about this exam.

gloss: service window, counter; window (on a computer screen)
meanings: opening providing restricted access (e.g. customer service window)

example.zh: 请到三号窗口办理退票手续。
example.en: Please go to window number three to get a refund on your ticket.

example.zh: 他是个老实人，从来不说假话。
example.en: He's an honest man and never tells lies.

example.zh: 这家公司在本地市场上势力很大。
example.en: This company has great influence in the local market.

gloss: to suppress; to inhibit; to restrain

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，她抑制不住内心的激动，哭了出来。
example.en: Hearing the good news, she couldn't hold back her emotion and burst into tears.

example.zh: 这是我为你精心准备的生日礼物。
example.en: This is a birthday present I carefully prepared for you.

example.zh: 你的想法太极端了，应该冷静想一想。
example.en: Your thinking is too extreme; you should calm down and think again.

example.zh: 买东西要理性，不要一看到打折就乱买。
example.en: Be rational when shopping; don't buy things on impulse just because they're on sale.

example.zh: 这种药每天服用三次，每次两片。
example.en: Take this medicine three times a day, two tablets each time.

example.zh: 这座古城已被列入世界文化遗产。
example.en: This ancient city has been listed as a World Cultural Heritage site.

example.zh: 这位企业家向灾区捐赠了一百万元。
example.en: This entrepreneur donated one million yuan to the disaster area.

example.zh: 故宫曾经是中国皇帝住的地方。
example.en: The Forbidden City was once where China's emperors lived.

gloss: to chat; to converse; to talk with

example.zh: 两个人用英语交谈了半个多小时。
example.en: The two of them talked in English for over half an hour.

gloss: to replace; to take the place of; to supersede

example.zh: 有人担心将来机器人会取代人类的很多工作。
example.en: Some people worry that robots will take over many human jobs in the future.

example.zh: 飞行员在正式开飞机之前，要在模拟器上练习很长时间。
example.en: Before flying for real, pilots practice for a long time on a simulator.

example.zh: 这一带都是新建的住宅区。
example.en: This whole area is a newly built residential district.

example.zh: 一次失败不能让你丧失信心。
example.en: One failure shouldn't make you lose confidence.

example.zh: 他们为这个问题争论了一个下午。
example.en: They argued about this question for a whole afternoon.

gloss: to rotate; to spin; to revolve

example.zh: 地球一直在围绕太阳旋转。
example.en: The earth keeps revolving around the sun.

example.zh: 这药片太大了，我怎么也吞不下去。
example.en: This pill is too big; I just can't swallow it.

example.zh: 这些茶叶按质量分成三个等级。
example.en: These teas are divided into three grades by quality.

example.zh: 这张照片只能看到他的背影，看不到正面。
example.en: In this photo you can only see him from behind, not his front.

gloss: not at all; not in the least

example.zh: 他毫不犹豫地跳进河里，救起了那个孩子。
example.en: Without the slightest hesitation he jumped into the river and saved the child.

example.zh: 我家隔壁住着一对老夫妻。
example.en: An elderly couple lives next door to us.

example.zh: 墙上那张画挂歪了，我们重新挂一下吧。
