example.en: That picture on the wall is hanging crooked; let's rehang it.

gloss: to kneel; to go down on one's knees

example.zh: 他跪在地上找掉下去的耳环。
example.en: He knelt on the floor looking for the earring that had dropped.

example.zh: 他的这个举动让大家都很感动。
example.en: What he did moved everyone.

example.zh: 生的食物里可能有很多细菌。
example.en: Raw food may contain a lot of bacteria.

meanings: generic term for cotton or kapok

example.zh: 这件衬衫是纯棉的，穿起来很舒服。
example.en: This shirt is pure cotton and very comfortable to wear.

example.zh: 两国正式建立了外交关系。
example.en: The two countries formally established diplomatic relations.

example.zh: 这项投资给公司带来了不少收益。
example.en: This investment brought the company considerable returns.

gloss: to attend to, to take care of; to look after; to consider

example.zh: 他工作太忙，根本顾不上家里的事。
example.en: He's so busy at work that he has no time at all to attend to things at home.

example.zh: 每个家庭都有自己的规矩。
example.en: Every family has its own rules.

example.zh: 新任中国驻美国大使今天抵达华盛顿。
example.en: The new Chinese ambassador to the United States arrived in Washington today.

gloss: to worship; to adore; to idolize

example.zh: 很多孩子都崇拜运动明星。
example.en: Many children idolize sports stars.

example.zh: 无论遇到什么困难，他都没有放弃自己的信念。
example.en: Whatever difficulties he met, he never gave up his beliefs.

example.zh: 几年不见，他的模样一点儿也没变。
example.en: I haven't seen him for years, but he looks exactly the same.

gloss: on the spot; there and then

example.zh: 他当场就答应了我的请求。
example.en: He agreed to my request on the spot.

example.zh: 这种花只在特定的季节开放。
example.en: This flower only blooms in a particular season.

gloss: to look upon; to regard; to treat

example.zh: 你怎么看待这个问题？
example.en: How do you view this issue?

gloss: to fight; to scuffle; to come to blows

example.zh: 这两个孩子为了一个玩具打架了。
example.en: These two kids got into a fight over a toy.

gloss: to create; to build; to forge

example.zh: 这座城市正在努力打造国际旅游中心。
example.en: The city is working hard to build itself into an international tourism center.

example.zh: 手机已经成了我们生活中的好助手。
example.en: The mobile phone has become a good helper in our lives.

gloss: to be able to; so that (something) can; to get to

example.zh: 在大家的帮助下，这个问题终于得以解决。
example.en: With everyone's help, the problem was finally resolved.

gloss: to go public (on the stock market); to come on the market
indonesian: melantai di bursa; mulai dijual di pasaran
meanings: to hit the market (of a new product)
to float (a company on the stock market)

example.zh: 这家公司计划明年在香港上市。
example.en: This company plans to list in Hong Kong next year.

gloss: to guess; to speculate; guess, speculation

example.zh: 大家都在猜测他为什么突然辞职。
example.en: Everyone is speculating about why he suddenly quit.

example.zh: 毕业典礼将在下周六上午举行。
example.en: The graduation ceremony will be held next Saturday morning.

example.zh: 由于下雨，比赛场地临时改到了室内体育馆。
example.en: Because of the rain, the venue was moved to the indoor gym at short notice.

gloss: fat (in the body or food); grease
meanings: fat (in the body, in a plant, or in food)

example.zh: 这种食物脂肪含量太高，不宜多吃。
example.en: This food is too high in fat to eat much of.

example.zh: 这座城市有一个很大的港口，每天都有很多船进出。
example.en: This city has a large port with many ships coming and going every day.

example.zh: 这位教授出版了很多学术著作。
example.en: This professor has published many academic works.

gloss: to enlarge; to magnify; to amplify

example.zh: 你可以把照片放大一点，看得更清楚。
example.en: You can enlarge the photo a bit to see it more clearly.

example.zh: 山顶被厚厚的白雪覆盖着。
example.en: The mountaintop is covered with thick white snow.

example.zh: 我们可以通过多种渠道了解市场信息。
example.en: We can learn about the market through many channels.

example.zh: 她虽然穿得很简单，但气质非常好。
example.en: Although she dresses simply, she carries herself very elegantly.

gloss: casualties; to be injured or killed

example.zh: 这次交通事故造成了三人伤亡。
example.en: This traffic accident left three people killed or injured.

example.zh: 这批产品存在质量缺陷，需要召回。
example.en: This batch of products has quality defects and needs to be recalled.

example.zh: 酒精可以用来给伤口消毒。
example.en: Alcohol can be used to disinfect wounds.

example.zh: 总理明天将访问欧洲三个国家。
example.en: The premier will visit three European countries tomorrow.

example.zh: 这家超市的特价鸡蛋每人限买两盒。
example.en: The supermarket's discounted eggs are limited to two boxes per person.

example.zh: 他踢球时腿受伤了，幸好骨头没事。
example.en: He hurt his leg playing football; luckily the bone was fine.

example.zh: 这件事要先向上级报告。
example.en: This matter must first be reported to the higher-ups.

example.zh: 他累得连眼睛都睁不开了。
example.en: He was so tired he couldn't even keep his eyes open.

example.zh: 她在这届奥运会上一共拿了三枚金牌。
example.en: She won three gold medals at these Olympics.

example.zh: 大家都要遵守规定，谁也不能例外。
example.en: Everyone must follow the rules; no one is an exception.

example.zh: 他背着沉重的行李走了很久。
example.en: He walked for a long time carrying heavy luggage.

example.zh: 实验室里的仪器都很贵重，请小心使用。
example.en: The instruments in the lab are all valuable, so please use them carefully.

gloss: to name; to give a name to; naming

example.zh: 这颗小行星以一位科学家的名字命名。
example.en: This asteroid is named after a scientist.

gloss: to give; to entrust; to endow; to confer

example.zh: 这次任务是公司赋予我们的重要责任。
example.en: This assignment is an important responsibility the company has entrusted to us.

gloss: to demonstrate; to set an example; demonstration
meanings: to show how to do sth

example.zh: 老师先示范了一遍，然后让学生自己练习。
example.en: The teacher demonstrated once first, then let the students practise on their own.

example.zh: 他的父亲对他要求非常严厉。
example.en: His father is very strict with him.

gloss: to seal; to close; to close off; closed

example.zh: 这条路正在维修，暂时封闭。
example.en: This road is under repair and temporarily closed.

example.zh: 酒后开车的司机将受到严厉处罚。
example.en: Drivers caught drink-driving will be severely punished.

example.zh: 医生建议他每天量一次血压。
example.en: The doctor advised him to take his blood pressure once a day.

example.zh: 他的高个子是从父亲那里遗传来的。
example.en: He inherited his height from his father.

gloss: to identify; to distinguish; to recognise
meanings: to distinguish; to discern; to identify; to recognize

example.zh: 这个软件可以识别图片中的文字。
example.en: This software can recognise text in images.

example.zh: 老师耐心地纠正了我的发音。
example.en: The teacher patiently corrected my pronunciation.

example.zh: 申请的期限是本月三十号。
example.en: The deadline for applications is the 30th of this month.

gloss: to open; to start; to usher in

example.zh: 大学毕业后，他开启了人生的新阶段。
example.en: After graduating from university, he began a new chapter in his life.

example.zh: 这孩子学习很用心，成绩一直在班里前几名。
example.en: This child studies very diligently and is always among the top in the class.

meanings: to go from place to place

example.zh: 屋里太闷了，打开窗户让空气流动一下吧。
example.en: It's too stuffy in here; open the window and let some air circulate.

gloss: to block; to stop; to flag down (a taxi)

example.zh: 下雨了，我在路边拦了一辆出租车。
example.en: It started raining, so I flagged down a taxi by the road.

example.zh: 这个小村庄很少和外界联系。
example.en: This small village has little contact with the outside world.

gloss: to dedicate; to devote; to offer; contribution

example.zh: 她把一生都奉献给了教育事业。
example.en: She devoted her whole life to education.

example.zh: 经过漫长的等待，他终于收到了录取通知书。
example.en: After a long wait, he finally received his letter of admission.

gloss: measure word for actions or deeds; time; kind; foreign
indonesian: kali; macam; kata satuan untuk tindakan; asing
meanings: classifier for occurrences (of an event, action or speech utterance)
classifier for iterations: times, -fold (as in twofold etc)

example.zh: 经过一番努力，他终于通过了考试。
example.en: After some hard work, he finally passed the exam.

example.zh: 他最喜欢看喜剧，每次都笑得停不下来。
example.en: He loves watching comedies and can never stop laughing.

example.zh: 这部电影的画面非常漂亮，给观众带来了强烈的视觉冲击。
example.en: The film's imagery is gorgeous and makes a strong visual impact on audiences.

example.zh: 她身上的香水味很淡，闻起来很舒服。
example.en: Her perfume is very light and pleasant to smell.

example.zh: 这句话是多余的，可以去掉。
example.en: This sentence is unnecessary; it can be taken out.

gloss: to help (people in need); to rescue; aid

example.zh: 这个组织专门救助街头的流浪动物。
example.en: This organization specializes in rescuing stray animals off the streets.

example.zh: 工人们正在测量房间的面积。
example.en: The workers are measuring the area of the room.

example.zh: 请不要在走廊里大声说话。
example.en: Please don't talk loudly in the corridor.

gloss: to remit (money); to converge, to flow together

example.zh: 他每个月都会给家里汇一些钱。
example.en: Every month he sends some money home.

example.zh: 下周的会议，请你和王经理一同参加。
example.en: Please attend next week's meeting together with Manager Wang.

example.zh: 这家珠宝店里的钻石项链价格都非常高。
example.en: The diamond necklaces in this jewelry store are all very expensive.

gloss: to rely on, to depend on; to hang on, to refuse to leave; bad (in 'not bad')
indonesian: bergantung; bermalas-malasan, enggan beranjak; jelek (dalam ungkapan "tidak jelek")
meanings: to hang on in a place

example.zh: 你做的菜真不赖，比饭馆的还好吃。
example.en: Your cooking is really not bad; it's even better than the restaurant's.

gloss: to impact; to pound; impact; shock

example.zh: 网上购物对传统商店造成了很大的冲击。
example.en: Online shopping has had a big impact on traditional shops.

example.zh: 工人们正在用水泥修补地面。
example.en: The workers are patching the ground with cement.

example.zh: 他在公司担任经理职务。
example.en: He holds the position of manager at the company.

gloss: to worry; to be anxious; sorrow

example.zh: 找不到工作，他愁得好几天都睡不着觉。
example.en: Unable to find a job, he was so worried that he couldn't sleep for days.

example.zh: 生活在大都市里的人，工作压力普遍比较大。
example.en: People living in big cities generally face a lot of work pressure.

gloss: for a special purpose; dedicated; exclusive

example.zh: 这条车道是公交车专用的，其他车辆不能进入。
example.en: This lane is reserved for buses; other vehicles may not enter.

example.zh: 你想得太天真了，事情没有那么简单。
example.en: You're being too naive; things aren't that simple.

example.zh: 目前，汽油仍然是大多数汽车使用的燃料。
example.en: At present, gasoline is still the fuel most cars run on.

meanings: outer surface; the outside of sth

example.zh: 他很爱面子，不愿意承认自己错了。
example.en: He's very concerned about face and won't admit he was wrong.

gloss: to drape over one's shoulders; to throw on (a coat)

example.zh: 晚上有点儿凉，她在身上披了一件外套。
example.en: It was a bit cool in the evening, so she draped a jacket over her shoulders.

gloss: to identify with; to approve of; to accept
indonesian: setuju; mengakui; merasa menjadi bagian dari

example.zh: 我很认同你的看法，学习确实比分数重要。
example.en: I really agree with you; learning is indeed more important than grades.

gloss: train of thought; line of thinking; approach
meanings: line of thought; way of thinking

example.zh: 他写文章思路很清楚，读起来一点儿也不累。
example.en: His writing is very clearly thought out and easy to read.

example.zh: 他爸爸对他要求很严，每天都要检查他的作业。
example.en: His father is very strict with him and checks his homework every day.

example.zh: 这双鞋的尺寸有点儿小，能给我换一双大一点儿的吗？
example.en: These shoes are a bit small; could I exchange them for a bigger pair?

example.zh: 太阳快下山时，人的影子变得很长。
example.en: When the sun is about to set, people's shadows become very long.

example.zh: 我们沿着海岸开车，一路上风景美极了。
example.en: We drove along the coast, and the scenery was gorgeous the whole way.

example.zh: 他在北京住了十年，汉语说得很地道。
example.en: He has lived in Beijing for ten years and speaks very authentic Chinese.

gloss: to talk on the phone; phone call

example.zh: 我刚才和妈妈通话的时候，她说家里一切都好。
example.en: When I spoke to Mom on the phone just now, she said all is well at home.

example.zh: 他迈着轻快的步子走进了教室。
example.en: He strode briskly into the classroom.

gloss: to worry; to be anxious; concern

example.zh: 父母对孩子的未来感到担忧。
example.en: The parents are worried about their child's future.

gloss: to dislike; to mind; to complain of; suspicion

example.zh: 他嫌这件衣服太贵，没有买。
example.en: He thought the clothes were too expensive and didn't buy them.

gloss: to agree with; to approve of; to endorse

example.zh: 大多数人都赞同这个方案，只有两个人反对。
example.en: Most people approve of this plan; only two are against it.

gloss: to blend; to merge; to fuse

example.zh: 这家餐厅的菜融合了中西方的特点。
example.en: This restaurant's dishes blend Chinese and Western styles.

example.zh: 考试前几天，他变得很焦虑，晚上总是睡不好。
example.en: In the days before the exam, he became very anxious and slept badly every night.

example.zh: 这个钉子钉得很牢，怎么拔也拔不出来。
example.en: This nail is in so firmly that no matter how you pull, it won't come out.

gloss: to continue; to go on; to last

example.zh: 这个传统已经延续了几百年。
example.en: This tradition has continued for several hundred years.

example.zh: 离开房间前，请关掉所有电源。
example.en: Please switch off all power before leaving the room.

example.zh: 她在国外获得了硕士学位。
example.en: She obtained a master's degree abroad.

gloss: to inspect; to investigate on the spot; to examine; field study

example.zh: 专家们到山区考察当地的教育情况。
example.en: Experts went to the mountain area to look into local education.

gloss: years; time; the passing of time

example.zh: 岁月在他的脸上留下了痕迹。
example.en: The years have left their mark on his face.

gloss: to accompany; to go along with; to follow

example.zh: 美妙的音乐伴随着我们度过了这个夜晚。
example.en: Beautiful music accompanied us through the evening.

example.zh: 这部电影上映后引起了很大的争议。
example.en: The film caused a lot of controversy after its release.

gloss: to avoid; to shelter from; to keep away from

example.zh: 突然下起了大雨，我们赶紧跑到屋檐下避雨。
example.en: It suddenly started pouring, and we rushed under the eaves to shelter from the rain.

example.zh: 多吃蔬菜和水果，有利于肠道健康。
example.en: Eating plenty of vegetables and fruit is good for gut health.

gloss: to make a policy decision; decision; policy decision

example.zh: 这个决策关系到公司的未来。
example.en: This decision concerns the future of the company.

example.zh: 学习是一个人终身的事情。
example.en: Learning is a lifelong undertaking.

gloss: to schedule, to fix in advance; to book, to reserve

example.zh: 我们已经预定了周六晚上的餐厅。
example.en: We've already booked the restaurant for Saturday evening.

gloss: to call; to address as; form of address

example.zh: 第一次见面，我不知道该怎么称呼他。
example.en: Meeting him for the first time, I didn't know how to address him.

example.zh: 机遇只留给有准备的人。
example.en: Opportunity only comes to those who are prepared.

gloss: to laugh at; to mock; to ridicule

example.zh: 别嘲笑别人的口音，学外语本来就不容易。
example.en: Don't laugh at other people's accents; learning a foreign language isn't easy.

example.zh: 这些奖学金专门用来帮助贫困学生。
example.en: These scholarships are specifically for helping poor students.

example.zh: 地球是我们共同的家园，每个人都应该保护它。
example.en: The Earth is our shared home, and everyone should protect it.

example.zh: 这句话的含义很深，需要慢慢体会。
example.en: This sentence has a deep meaning that takes time to appreciate.

gloss: to wash; to clean; to rinse

example.zh: 新买的水果最好先清洗干净再吃。
example.en: It's best to wash newly bought fruit thoroughly before eating it.

example.zh: 对他来说，出国留学的梦想已经不再遥远。
example.en: For him, the dream of studying abroad is no longer far away.

gloss: to go up on stage; to come to power
meanings: to go on stage (in the theater)

example.zh: 轮到他上台演讲时，他紧张得手都在抖。
example.en: When it was his turn to go up and give a speech, he was so nervous his hands were shaking.

example.zh: 二氧化碳是一种无色无味的气体。
example.en: Carbon dioxide is a colorless, odorless gas.

gloss: to hold in both hands; to carry in cupped hands; to flatter; measure word for handfuls
indonesian: menatang; memegang dengan kedua tangan; menyanjung; segenggam
meanings: to hold up with both hands

example.zh: 她双手捧着一束鲜花走了进来。
example.en: She came in holding a bunch of flowers in both hands.

example.zh: 这篇文章层次清楚，很容易理解。
example.en: This essay is clearly structured and easy to understand.

gloss: to obey; to comply with; to submit to

example.zh: 少数服从多数是我们讨论问题的原则。
example.en: The minority deferring to the majority is our principle for discussions.

gloss: to cross (a river or sea); to ferry; to get through (a hard time)

example.zh: 过去没有桥的时候，人们只能坐船渡河。
example.en: In the past, before there was a bridge, people could only cross the river by boat.

meanings: to force sb to do sth

example.zh: 如果你不愿意去，我也不勉强你。
example.en: If you don't want to go, I won't force you.

example.zh: 春天来了，大地一片绿色，到处充满生机。
example.en: Spring has arrived; the land is all green and full of life everywhere.

example.zh: 这面墙是用红砖砌成的。
example.en: This wall is built of red bricks.

meanings: case (of fraud, hepatitis, international cooperation etc); instance; example

example.zh: 老师用一个真实的案例来说明这个问题。
example.en: The teacher used a real case to illustrate this issue.

example.zh: 他看书很杂，历史、科学、小说什么都看。
example.en: He reads very widely: history, science, novels, anything at all.

gloss: to catch, to capture (e.g. an animal)

example.zh: 小时候，我们夏天常常在田里捉青蛙。
example.en: When we were kids, we often caught frogs in the fields in summer.

gloss: to convey; to pass on; to transmit

example.zh: 请把这个消息传达给每一位同事。
example.en: Please pass this message on to every colleague.

example.zh: 这块布上的图案非常漂亮。
example.en: The pattern on this cloth is very pretty.

example.zh: 每个员工都应该遵守公司的纪律。
example.en: Every employee should observe the company's rules and discipline.

gloss: to cancel; to revoke; to repeal

example.zh: 由于违反规定，他的比赛资格被撤销了。
example.en: Because he broke the rules, his eligibility for the competition was revoked.

example.zh: 天空中突然出现一道闪电，接着就下起了大雨。
example.en: A flash of lightning suddenly appeared in the sky, and then heavy rain began to fall.

gloss: to perform (on a musical instrument); to play
meanings: to perform on a musical instrument

example.zh: 她在音乐会上演奏了一首钢琴曲。
example.en: She performed a piano piece at the concert.

example.zh: 他每周都会买一张彩票，希望能中大奖。
example.en: He buys a lottery ticket every week, hoping to win the jackpot.

example.zh: 公司在经营过程中必须遵守国家的相关法规。
example.en: A company must comply with the relevant national laws and regulations in its operations.

example.zh: 小时候，奶奶每天晚上给我讲童话故事。
example.en: When I was little, Grandma told me a fairy tale every night.

example.zh: 人民币是中国的法定货币。
example.en: The renminbi is China's legal currency.

gloss: to hinder; to obstruct; to impede; obstacle

example.zh: 缺乏自信会阻碍你的进步。
example.en: A lack of confidence will hinder your progress.

gloss: to arouse; to stimulate; to inspire

example.zh: 好的老师能激发学生的学习兴趣。
example.en: A good teacher can arouse students' interest in learning.

example.zh: 近来天气变化很大，要注意身体。
example.en: The weather has been changeable lately, so take care of yourself.

example.zh: 收入提高了，生活水平也相应地提高了。
example.en: Incomes have risen, and living standards have risen accordingly.

example.zh: 下了一夜大雨，路边的沟里全是水。
example.en: After a whole night of heavy rain, the ditches by the road were full of water.

example.zh: 登山时千万不要离开同伴，一个人走很容易迷路。
example.en: Never leave your companions when mountain climbing; it's easy to get lost on your own.

gloss: endlessly, incessantly (after a verb of feeling)

example.zh: 听到儿子考上大学的消息，妈妈激动不已。
example.en: Hearing that her son had got into university, the mother was overcome with excitement.

example.zh: 这种饮料不含任何添加剂，用的都是天然原料。
example.en: This drink contains no additives; it uses only natural ingredients.

gloss: to break the rules, to violate regulations

example.zh: 他因为在高速公路上违规停车被罚了两百元。
example.en: He was fined 200 yuan for illegally stopping on the motorway.

example.zh: 付款之前，请再确认一下转账金额是否正确。
example.en: Before paying, please double-check that the transfer amount is correct.

meanings: enemy soldier captured for the purpose of extracting information

example.zh: 汤太烫了，把我的舌头烫了一下。
example.en: The soup was too hot and burned my tongue.

example.zh: 工地上的工人每天早上七点就开始干活了。
example.en: The workers on the construction site start work at seven every morning.

example.zh: 学校周边有很多小吃店。
example.en: There are lots of snack shops around the school.

meanings: sth uniquely enjoyed (or possessed etc) by a certain group of people

example.zh: 这项新技术已经申请了专利。
example.en: A patent has already been applied for on this new technology.

example.zh: 我特意为你做了这道菜。
example.en: I made this dish especially for you.

example.zh: 地震发生后，全国各地的人们纷纷为灾区捐款。
example.en: After the earthquake, people all over the country donated money to the disaster area.

gloss: to star in; leading actor or actress
meanings: to act the leading role (in a movie or a play)

example.zh: 这部电影由一位年轻演员主演，上映后好评不断。
example.en: This film stars a young actor and has received rave reviews since its release.

gloss: to synthesize; to compose; to combine; synthetic

example.zh: 这张照片是用电脑合成的。
example.en: This photo was put together on a computer.

gloss: to anticipate; to expect; to predict; expectation

example.zh: 比赛的结果完全出乎大家的预料。
example.en: The result of the match was completely beyond everyone's expectations.

gloss: to restrict; to bind; to constrain; restraint

example.zh: 每个人都应该用规则约束自己的行为。
example.en: Everyone should restrain their behaviour by the rules.

example.zh: 爷爷留着长长的白胡子，看起来很有精神。
example.en: Grandpa has a long white beard and looks full of energy.

example.zh: 现在首要的任务是找到问题的原因。
example.en: The main task now is to find the cause of the problem.

example.zh: 学校在网上发布了放假公告。
example.en: The school posted a holiday notice online.

example.zh: 由于天气恶劣，今天的航班都被取消了。
example.en: Due to severe weather, all of today's flights were canceled.

example.zh: 当时我没觉得什么，过后想想才觉得有点后怕。
example.en: I didn't think much of it at the time; only afterwards did I realize how scary it was.

example.zh: 公司会在三天之内给你答复。
example.en: The company will give you an answer within three days.

example.zh: 用这根数据线，手机里的照片很快就能传输到电脑上。
example.en: With this cable, the photos on your phone can be transferred to the computer quickly.

gloss: to be in the same line of work; person in the same profession
meanings: of the same trade, occupation or industry

example.zh: 我们俩是同行，都在做软件开发。
example.en: We're in the same line of work; we both do software development.

example.zh: 把钱存在银行里，每年可以得到一些利息。
example.en: If you deposit money in the bank, you earn some interest every year.

gloss: first aid, emergency treatment; to give emergency treatment

example.zh: 公司组织员工学习急救知识，以防万一。
example.en: The company organized first-aid training for its staff, just in case.

gloss: to advocate; to stand for; view

example.zh: 我主张大家先讨论一下，再做决定。
example.en: I suggest that we discuss it first before making a decision.

example.zh: 四川菜里经常放很多辣椒。
example.en: Sichuan dishes often contain a lot of chili peppers.

example.zh: 小狗一直跟随在主人身后。
example.en: The puppy kept following behind its owner.

example.zh: 今年冬天下了一场罕见的大雪。
example.en: There was a rare heavy snowfall this winter.

example.zh: 她总是紧跟时尚潮流。
example.en: She always keeps up with the latest fashion trends.

gloss: exactly, precisely (often contrary to what one expects)

example.zh: 你以为他不在乎，其实恰恰相反，他比谁都在意。
example.en: You think he doesn't care, but it's exactly the opposite; he cares more than anyone.

example.zh: 山脚下有一个小村庄，住着几十户人家。
example.en: At the foot of the mountain there is a small village of a few dozen families.

example.zh: 他真诚的态度打动了面试官，最后被录取了。
example.en: His sincerity moved the interviewer, and he was hired in the end.

example.zh: 为了一点小事，他们俩在饭桌上争吵起来。
example.en: The two of them started quarrelling at the dinner table over a trivial matter.

gloss: to market; to sell; to promote

example.zh: 他在一家公司负责推销新产品。
example.en: He is responsible for marketing new products at a company.

example.zh: 公司建立了新的奖励机制，员工的积极性明显提高了。
example.en: The company set up a new reward system, and staff motivation has clearly improved.

example.zh: 他经常工作到深夜，身体越来越差。
example.en: He often works late into the night, and his health keeps getting worse.

gloss: through (to see or pass through something)

example.zh: 阳光透过窗户照进房间，暖洋洋的。
example.en: Sunlight shone into the room through the window, nice and warm.

example.zh: 青少年正处在身体发育的关键时期。
example.en: Teenagers are at a crucial stage of physical development.

gloss: area, region, (the area) around a place

example.zh: 这一带以前是农田，现在已经盖满了高楼。
example.en: This area used to be farmland; now it's covered with high-rise buildings.

example.zh: 计算机是现在很热门的专业。
example.en: Computer science is a very popular major these days.

indonesian: titik akhir; tujuan akhir; garis finis

example.zh: 他第一个跑到了终点。
example.en: He was the first to reach the finish line.

example.zh: 这个实验需要非常精确的数据。
example.en: This experiment needs very precise data.

example.zh: 他摔倒时面部受了点伤，好在不严重。
example.en: He hurt his face a bit when he fell, but fortunately it wasn't serious.

example.zh: 写作文时要使用规范的汉字。
example.en: Use standard Chinese characters when writing compositions.

gloss: to interrupt; to break off; to suspend

example.zh: 因为下大雨，比赛中断了半个小时。
example.en: Because of the heavy rain, the match was suspended for half an hour.

gloss: to pay a visit; to call on
meanings: to pay a visit; to call on

example.zh: 周末我打算去拜访一位老朋友。
example.en: This weekend I plan to visit an old friend.

example.zh: 他大学学的是医药专业，毕业后进了一家药厂。
example.en: He studied medicine and pharmacy at university and joined a drug factory after graduating.

example.zh: 这种饮料的主要原料是新鲜水果。
example.en: The main raw material of this drink is fresh fruit.

example.zh: 他每天都关注股市的动态。
example.en: He follows developments in the stock market every day.

example.zh: 这个盒子是透明的，能看见里面的东西。
example.en: This box is transparent; you can see what's inside.

gloss: to adjust; to regulate; to moderate

example.zh: 运动可以帮助调节心情。
example.en: Exercise can help regulate your mood.

example.zh: 最近他频繁地出差，很少在家。
example.en: He has been travelling for work a lot lately and is rarely home.

example.zh: 城市的用水主要由这座水库供给。
example.en: The city's water is mainly supplied by this reservoir.

example.zh: 遇到突发情况时，一定要保持冷静。
example.en: When something unexpected happens, you must stay calm.

gloss: to listen to (opinions, reports), to hear

example.zh: 领导应该多听取群众的意见。
example.en: Leaders should listen more to the opinions of ordinary people.

example.zh: 请你把箱子里的东西数一数，看看数目对不对。
example.en: Please count the things in the box and see if the number is right.

gloss: to be elected; to be chosen

example.zh: 她当选为今年的优秀教师。
example.en: She was chosen as this year's outstanding teacher.

gloss: to give off; to emit; to distribute; to hand out

example.zh: 厨房里散发出一股诱人的香味。
example.en: A tempting smell was coming from the kitchen.

example.zh: 这位艺人经常参加公益活动，很受粉丝喜爱。
example.en: This entertainer often takes part in charity events and is much loved by fans.

meanings: to lend one's name (to an event, endeavor etc)

example.zh: 这家小饭馆的红烧肉特别出名，每天都排长队。
example.en: This little restaurant is famous for its braised pork; there's a long queue every day.

example.zh: 这条项链是妈妈送给我的生日礼物。
example.en: This necklace was a birthday present from my mom.

example.zh: 她是一位杰出的女科学家。
example.en: She is an outstanding female scientist.

gloss: to inspire; to encourage; to boost morale

example.zh: 这个好消息让大家深受鼓舞。
example.en: This good news greatly lifted everyone's spirits.

example.zh: 考试的时候抄别人的答案是不对的。
example.en: Copying other people's answers during an exam is wrong.

example.zh: 老人拄着一根木棍，慢慢地往山上走。
example.en: Leaning on a wooden stick, the old man slowly walked up the mountain.

example.zh: 他敢一个人去旅行，我非常佩服他的勇气。
example.en: He dared to travel alone; I really admire his courage.

gloss: to set up; to establish; to build (an image, example)

example.zh: 父母应该给孩子树立好的榜样。
example.en: Parents should set a good example for their children.

example.zh: 在图书馆大声说话会妨碍别人学习。
example.en: Talking loudly in the library disturbs other people's studying.

gloss: to consume; to use up; consumption

example.zh: 跑步能消耗大量的热量。
example.en: Running burns a lot of calories.

gloss: so as not to; in order to avoid; lest

example.zh: 出门前检查一下门窗，以免发生意外。
example.en: Check the doors and windows before going out to avoid accidents.

example.zh: 他在平凡的岗位上做出了不平凡的成绩。
example.en: He achieved extraordinary results in an ordinary job.

example.zh: 我对花生过敏，不能吃这道菜。
example.en: I'm allergic to peanuts, so I can't eat this dish.

meanings: to do what one is told

example.zh: 这孩子很听话，从来不让父母操心。
example.en: This child is very well-behaved and never gives his parents anything to worry about.

example.zh: 他的言语中透露出对未来的担忧。
example.en: His words revealed his worries about the future.

example.zh: 这个行业的发展前景非常好。
example.en: This industry has excellent prospects.

example.zh: 请把合同用传真发过来，我们确认后马上签字。
example.en: Please fax the contract over; we'll sign as soon as we've checked it.

gloss: a moment; an instant; a short while

example.zh: 请稍等片刻，经理马上就来。
example.en: Please wait a moment; the manager will be right here.

example.zh: 每个人都应该尊重别人的隐私。
example.en: Everyone should respect other people's privacy.

indonesian: sangat besar; raksasa; luar biasa besar

example.zh: 这个项目需要一笔庞大的资金。
example.en: This project requires an enormous amount of money.

example.zh: 这次会议极为重要，所有部门经理都必须参加。
example.en: This meeting is extremely important; all department managers must attend.

example.zh: 过年时，家里总会准备很多糖果招待客人。
example.en: At New Year, the family always gets lots of sweets ready for guests.

example.zh: 下棋可以帮助孩子开发智力。
example.en: Playing chess can help children develop their intelligence.

example.zh: 乘飞机时，随身行李里不能带太多液体。
example.en: When flying, you can't take too much liquid in your carry-on luggage.

example.zh: 年轻就是你最大的资本。
example.en: Being young is your greatest asset.

meanings: bond (esp. document split in two, with each party holding one half)

example.zh: 这张优惠券可以在全国所有分店使用。
example.en: This coupon can be used at all branches nationwide.

example.zh: 我不是这个意思，你误解我了。
example.en: That's not what I meant; you misunderstood me.

example.zh: 公司明天晚上要举行一个宴会。
example.en: The company is holding a banquet tomorrow evening.

gloss: written; in writing; in written form
indonesian: tertulis; secara tertulis; dalam bentuk tulisan

example.zh: 请把你的意见用书面形式交给我们。
example.en: Please submit your comments to us in writing.

example.zh: 晚饭以后，我们常常沿着河岸散步。
example.en: After dinner, we often take a walk along the riverbank.

example.zh: 这家超市专门卖有机蔬菜，价格比普通的贵一些。
example.en: This supermarket specializes in organic vegetables, which cost a bit more than ordinary ones.

example.zh: 这个月他迟到的次数太多，被经理批评了。
example.en: He was late too many times this month and got told off by the manager.

example.zh: 这家公司非常重视员工的综合素质。
example.en: This company puts great emphasis on employees' overall quality.

gloss: to associate; to connect in the mind; association
meanings: word prediction and auto-complete functions of input method editing programs

example.zh: 看到这张照片，我联想到了小时候。
example.en: Seeing this photo reminded me of my childhood.

example.zh: 两家公司因为合同问题发生了纠纷。
example.en: The two companies got into a dispute over the contract.

example.zh: 浴室的地很滑，洗澡时要小心。
example.en: The bathroom floor is slippery, so be careful when you shower.

example.zh: 运动员们已经站在起点上，准备出发。
example.en: The athletes are already standing at the starting line, ready to go.

example.zh: 父母是孩子最好的榜样。
example.en: Parents are their children's best role models.

gloss: to establish, to found, to create

example.zh: 这所大学创建于1898年，已有一百多年的历史。
example.en: This university was founded in 1898 and has more than a hundred years of history.

example.zh: 是继续读研还是马上工作？考虑了很久，他最后选择了后者。
example.en: Go on to grad school or start working right away? After thinking it over for a long time, he chose the latter.

gloss: regardless of; in spite of; to disregard

example.zh: 他不顾家人的反对，辞职去创业了。
example.en: Despite his family's objections, he quit his job to start a business.

gloss: remaining, surplus; to be left over

example.zh: 这个月的工资交完房租，剩余的钱已经不多了。
example.en: After paying this month's rent out of my salary, there isn't much money left.

example.zh: 南方和北方的饮食习惯存在很大的差异。
example.en: There are big differences between the eating habits of the south and the north.

example.zh: 厨房里飘出一股好闻的气味。
example.en: A pleasant smell drifted out of the kitchen.

gloss: to speculate; to conjecture; to infer; speculation

example.zh: 根据天气预报推测，明天可能会下雨。
example.en: Judging by the weather forecast, it may rain tomorrow.

example.zh: 他点燃了生日蛋糕上的蜡烛，大家一起唱起了生日歌。
example.en: He lit the candles on the birthday cake, and everyone sang 'Happy Birthday' together.

gloss: to miss; to long for; to think of

example.zh: 在国外留学的时候，我常常思念家人。
example.en: When I was studying abroad, I often missed my family.

gloss: to brake; brake; to stop (a machine)

example.zh: 前面突然出现一只狗，司机赶紧刹车。
example.en: A dog suddenly appeared ahead, and the driver quickly hit the brakes.

gloss: to rest; to take a break; to stop

example.zh: 走了这么久，我们坐下来歇一会儿吧。
example.en: We've walked for so long—let's sit down and rest for a while.

example.zh: 早饭我喜欢喝一碗热粥。
example.en: For breakfast I like a bowl of hot congee.

example.zh: 你知道冰箱的工作原理吗？
example.en: Do you know how a refrigerator works?

example.zh: 这个问题不能只从经济层面考虑，还要考虑社会影响。
example.en: This issue can't be considered only on the economic level; its social impact must be considered too.

example.zh: 请在正确答案后面画一个对号符号。
example.en: Please put a tick mark after the correct answer.

gloss: to fill (a bowl); to ladle out; flourishing; grand
meanings: to pick up with a utensil

example.zh: 妈妈给我盛了一碗米饭。
example.en: Mum served me a bowl of rice.

example.zh: 清晨的公园里有很多人在锻炼。
example.en: Early in the morning many people exercise in the park.

gloss: folk; popular; among the people; non-governmental
indonesian: rakyat; tradisional (cerita rakyat dll.); di kalangan rakyat; swasta

example.zh: 这是一个流传很广的民间故事。
example.en: This is a widely told folk tale.

gloss: to possess, to own; to occupy, to hold (a share or position)
meanings: to account for (a high proportion etc)

example.zh: 这家公司在国内市场上占有很大的份额。
example.en: This company holds a large share of the domestic market.

example.zh: 这个城市有很多外来人口，大多是来打工的年轻人。
example.en: This city has many people from elsewhere, mostly young people who came for work.

example.zh: 我的论文是在导师的指导下完成的。
example.en: I completed my thesis under the guidance of my supervisor.

example.zh: 这本小说的开头写得非常吸引人。
example.en: The beginning of this novel is really gripping.

example.zh: 好的老师会耐心倾听学生的想法。
example.en: A good teacher listens patiently to students' ideas.

example.zh: 医生用酒精给伤口消毒。
example.en: The doctor disinfected the wound with alcohol.

example.zh: 原先这里是一片农田，现在盖满了高楼。
example.en: This used to be farmland; now it is covered with tall buildings.

example.zh: 这个枕头太高了，我睡得不舒服。
example.en: This pillow is too high; I don't sleep comfortably.

gloss: to explore; to discuss; to inquire into

example.zh: 我们今天来探讨一下学习汉语的好方法。
example.en: Today let's discuss good ways to learn Chinese.

gloss: leading; dominant; to dominate; to lead

example.zh: 服务业已经成为这座城市的主导产业。
example.en: The service sector has become the city's leading industry.

example.zh: 我经常在网上论坛和别人交流学习经验。
example.en: I often share study tips with others on online forums.

example.zh: 政府加大了对环境污染的处罚力度。
example.en: The government has stepped up penalties for environmental pollution.

meanings: seven (used as a substitute for 七)

example.zh: 一直往前走，到第二个路口往左拐就到了。
example.en: Go straight ahead and turn left at the second intersection, and you're there.

gloss: spare, backup; to keep in reserve

example.zh: 出门旅行最好带一块备用电池。
example.en: When you travel, it's best to bring a spare battery.

meanings: model (particular version of a manufactured article)
type (product specification in terms of color, size etc)

example.zh: 这款手机有三种型号，价格各不相同。
example.en: This phone comes in three models, each at a different price.

gloss: to distribute, to issue, to hand out

example.zh: 每个月十号公司准时发放工资，从来没有拖欠过。
example.en: The company pays salaries on time on the 10th of every month and has never been late.

example.zh: 演员们正在为明天的演出排练。
example.en: The actors are rehearsing for tomorrow's performance.

example.zh: 每个人都有自己的弱点，关键是要正视它。
example.en: Everyone has weaknesses; the key is to face them squarely.

meanings: member of an institution of learning

example.zh: 这期培训班一共有三十名学员。
example.en: This training course has thirty trainees in total.

meanings: to focus; to concentrate; to give one's full attention

example.zh: 他做事非常专注，一工作起来就忘了时间。
example.en: He's very focused; once he starts working he loses track of time.

example.zh: 这套系统存在安全漏洞，黑客很容易攻击进来。
example.en: This system has a security flaw, so hackers can easily break in.

gloss: to damage; to break; to harm

example.zh: 快递公司不小心损坏了我的包裹。
example.en: The courier company accidentally damaged my parcel.

example.zh: 她很有才华，十几岁就出版了第一本小说。
example.en: She's very talented; she published her first novel as a teenager.

example.zh: 这个理论还需要通过实验来验证。
example.en: This theory still needs to be verified by experiment.

example.zh: 一阵风吹过，平静的水面上泛起了波纹。
example.en: A gust of wind blew across, and ripples spread over the calm water.

gloss: railing, fence; column (in a newspaper or form)
meanings: column or box (of text or other data)

example.zh: 请在表格的备注栏里写上您的联系方式。
example.en: Please write your contact details in the remarks column of the form.

example.zh: 感冒很容易传染，你最好戴上口罩。
example.en: Colds are very contagious; you'd better wear a mask.

gloss: to look up, to check, to inquire

example.zh: 你可以在网上查询航班的实时信息。
example.en: You can check real-time flight information online.

gloss: to sing; to sing the praises of

example.zh: 这首歌歌唱了祖国的大好河山。
example.en: This song sings the praises of the country's beautiful landscapes.

gloss: to ask for help, to seek help

example.zh: 遇到困难不要一个人扛着，要学会向别人求助。
example.en: Don't shoulder your difficulties alone; learn to ask others for help.

example.zh: 鸡蛋和牛奶里含有丰富的蛋白质。
example.en: Eggs and milk are rich in protein.

example.zh: 水果中含有丰富的维生素。
example.en: Fruit is rich in vitamins.

example.zh: 这个项目的进度比计划慢了两周。
example.en: This project is two weeks behind schedule.

example.zh: 这个盒子做得很精致，我舍不得扔。
example.en: This box is so finely made that I can't bear to throw it away.

example.zh: 这条毛巾非常柔软，用起来很舒服。
example.en: This towel is very soft and nice to use.

gloss: to be on duty; to work a shift

example.zh: 今天晚上轮到我在医院值班。
example.en: Tonight it's my turn to be on duty at the hospital.

gloss: to operate, to run (a business or service)
meanings: (of train, bus etc) to be in service

example.zh: 这条地铁线路将于明年正式运营。
example.en: This subway line will officially open for service next year.

example.zh: 他做事一贯很认真，从来不马虎。
example.en: He has always been conscientious and is never careless.

gloss: to keep; to take care of; certainly; custodian

example.zh: 出门前，我把钥匙交给邻居保管。
example.en: Before leaving, I gave the keys to my neighbour for safekeeping.

example.zh: 他把要记的单词写在卡片上，随时拿出来复习。
example.en: He writes the words he needs to memorize on cards and takes them out to review whenever he can.

example.zh: 长时间看手机会影响视力。
example.en: Looking at your phone for long periods can affect your eyesight.

gloss: mind, view (in someone's eyes, in someone's mind)

example.zh: 在我心目中，父亲是世界上最了不起的人。
example.en: In my eyes, my father is the most amazing person in the world.

example.zh: 冬天我们全家去东北滑雪，玩得特别开心。
example.en: In winter our whole family went skiing in the northeast and had a great time.

example.zh: 天气太热，我最近一点儿胃口都没有。
example.en: It's so hot that I've had no appetite at all lately.

example.zh: 帮助别人是一种高尚的行为。
example.en: Helping others is a noble act.

example.zh: 网上关于这家公司的负面新闻越来越多。
example.en: There's more and more negative news about this company online.

example.zh: 她戴着一条珍珠项链，非常优雅。
example.en: She's wearing a pearl necklace and looks very elegant.

example.zh: 科学家在山上采集了很多植物标本。
example.en: The scientists collected many plant specimens on the mountain.

example.zh: 老师用图片辅助讲解，学生更容易理解。
example.en: The teacher uses pictures to aid the explanation, so students understand more easily.

example.zh: 保护生态环境是每个人的责任。
example.en: Protecting the ecological environment is everyone's responsibility.

gloss: to extend; to stretch; to spread

example.zh: 这条公路一直延伸到海边。
example.en: This highway stretches all the way to the coast.

gloss: to apply, to give (an action to something, before a two-syllable verb); in addition, moreover
meanings: (used before a disyllabic verb to indicate that the action of the verb is applied to sth or sb previously mentioned)

example.zh: 对于学生提出的问题，老师应该及时加以解答。
example.en: Teachers should answer students' questions promptly.

example.zh: 被蚊子咬了以后，我的胳膊痒得很难受。
example.en: After being bitten by a mosquito, my arm itched terribly.

gloss: to imagine; to envisage; idea; tentative plan

example.zh: 这只是我的一个初步设想，还需要讨论。
example.en: This is just a preliminary idea of mine; it still needs discussion.

gloss: to regenerate, to grow again; to recycle (recycled)
meanings: to be a second so-and-so (famous dead person)

example.zh: 这种笔记本是用再生纸做的，很环保。
example.en: This notebook is made of recycled paper, so it's eco-friendly.

example.zh: 他穿着一双崭新的运动鞋去上学。
example.en: He went to school in a brand-new pair of trainers.

example.zh: 上下班高峰的时候，地铁里人特别多。
example.en: The subway is especially crowded during rush hour.

example.zh: 1969年，美国宇航员第一次登上了月球。
example.en: In 1969, American astronauts landed on the Moon for the first time.

example.zh: 公交车上，一个年轻人主动给一位老太太让了座。
example.en: On the bus, a young man offered his seat to an old lady.

gloss: to hide from, to avoid, to dodge

example.zh: 为了躲避记者，那位明星从后门离开了酒店。
example.en: To avoid the reporters, the star left the hotel by the back door.

example.zh: 连续工作了十个小时，他感到非常疲劳。
example.en: After working for ten hours straight, he felt extremely tired.

gloss: to pick up; to collect; ten (formal numeral used on cheques)
indonesian: memungut; mengambil (dari tanah); sepuluh (angka resmi pada cek)

example.zh: 他在路上拾到一个钱包，交给了警察。
example.en: He picked up a wallet in the street and handed it to the police.

example.zh: 这里气候温和，四季如春。
example.en: The climate here is mild; it is like spring all year round.

example.zh: 先看看书的目录，就能了解大概内容。
example.en: Look at the table of contents first, and you'll get a rough idea of what the book covers.

gloss: to delay; to hold up; to waste time

example.zh: 对不起，耽误了您这么多时间。
example.en: Sorry for taking up so much of your time.

example.zh: 秋天的田野里到处是一派丰收的景象。
example.en: In autumn, the fields everywhere present a scene of rich harvest.

gloss: to drench; to pour; to get wet (in the rain)

example.zh: 我忘了带伞，被雨淋湿了。
example.en: I forgot my umbrella and got soaked by the rain.

example.zh: 雨停了，天空中出现了一道彩虹。
example.en: The rain stopped, and a rainbow appeared in the sky.

gloss: to step back, to retreat; to fall back

example.zh: 看到那条大狗冲过来，他吓得连连后退。
example.en: Seeing the big dog charge at him, he backed away in fright.

gloss: branch; twig; measure word for long thin objects (pens, flowers)
indonesian: cabang; ranting; kata satuan untuk benda panjang (pena, bunga)
meanings: classifier for sticks, rods, pencils etc

example.zh: 他送了我一枝红玫瑰。
example.en: He gave me a red rose.

example.zh: 雷达可以发现远处飞行的物体。
example.en: Radar can detect objects flying far away.

example.zh: 他在一家银行当普通职员，工作很稳定。
example.en: He works as an ordinary clerk at a bank; the job is very stable.

example.zh: 这个商标已经注册了。
example.en: This trademark has already been registered.

gloss: journey, trip (the time on the road)

example.zh: 漫长的旅途中，他认识了很多有意思的人。
example.en: On the long journey, he met lots of interesting people.

example.zh: 看到危险时，人会本能地闭上眼睛。
example.en: When people see danger they instinctively close their eyes.

gloss: to shape; to mould; to portray (a character)
meanings: (fig.) to create (a character, a market, an image etc)

example.zh: 这部电影成功地塑造了一位好老师的形象。
example.en: This film successfully portrays a good teacher.

example.zh: 这份工作薪水不高，但是很稳定。
example.en: This job doesn't pay much, but it's very stable.

gloss: to measure, to judge; to weigh up

example.zh: 不能只用考试成绩来衡量一个学生的能力。
example.en: You can't judge a student's ability by exam results alone.

gloss: master (of a craft or martial art), teacher

example.zh: 他跟着师父学了三年手艺，终于能自己开店了。
example.en: He learned the craft from his master for three years and can finally open his own shop.

gloss: sound; perfect; complete; to improve (a system)

example.zh: 公司需要建立健全的管理制度。
example.en: The company needs to establish a sound management system.

example.zh: 这里比先前干净多了。
example.en: It's much cleaner here than it was before.

example.zh: 弟弟不小心把我心爱的杯子摔碎了。
example.en: My little brother accidentally smashed my favourite mug.

gloss: to transfer; to move; to mobilize; to arouse (enthusiasm)

example.zh: 老师想办法调动学生学习的积极性。
example.en: The teacher tries to motivate the students to learn.

example.zh: 她一直默默地支持着丈夫的事业。
example.en: She has always quietly supported her husband's career.

gloss: to tutor; to coach; to give guidance

example.zh: 姐姐每天晚上都辅导弟弟写作业。
example.en: Every evening, the older sister helps her little brother with his homework.

example.zh: 价格贵的东西未必就是好的。
example.en: Expensive things are not necessarily good.

example.zh: 这座建筑物已经有三百多年的历史了。
example.en: This building is more than three hundred years old.

gloss: to purchase (for an organisation); to procure; purchasing

example.zh: 她负责为公司采购办公用品。
example.en: She is in charge of buying office supplies for the company.

example.zh: 这次旅程从北京出发，经过西安，最后到达成都。
example.en: This trip starts in Beijing, passes through Xi'an and ends in Chengdu.

example.zh: 这家咖啡店是本土品牌，在全国已有上千家分店。
example.en: This café is a homegrown brand with over a thousand branches nationwide.

gloss: to block, to stop, to obstruct

example.zh: 什么困难也阻挡不了他前进的脚步。
example.en: No difficulty can stop him from moving forward.

example.zh: 这个词用在这里不太恰当。
example.en: This word isn't quite appropriate here.

gloss: doubt; puzzlement; to feel puzzled; uncertain

example.zh: 听了他的解释，我心里还是有些疑惑。
example.en: Even after hearing his explanation, I still had some doubts.

example.zh: 气象部门正在密切监测台风的路线。
example.en: The weather bureau is closely monitoring the typhoon's path.

example.zh: 她获得了“优秀员工”的称号。
example.en: She was given the title of Outstanding Employee.

gloss: fork; cross (mark); to stick with a fork, to cross
indonesian: garpu; tanda silang; menusuk dengan garpu, menyilangkan

example.zh: 吃西餐时，一般左手拿叉，右手拿刀。
example.en: When eating Western food, you usually hold the fork in your left hand and the knife in your right.

gloss: to look into; to investigate; to hold accountable

example.zh: 这次是小错误，就不追究你的责任了。
example.en: It's only a small mistake this time, so we won't hold you responsible.

gloss: to delay; to put off; to procrastinate

example.zh: 这件事不能再拖延了，必须今天完成。
example.en: This can't be put off any longer; it must be finished today.

example.zh: 博物馆里展出了很多珍贵的文物。
example.en: Many precious cultural relics are on display in the museum.

example.zh: 每个个体都有自己的特点，不能一概而论。
example.en: Every individual has their own traits; you can't generalise.

example.zh: 房间的墙壁刷成了淡蓝色，看起来很清爽。
example.en: The walls of the room were painted light blue and look fresh.

meanings: to open the city (or frontier) gate

example.zh: 电灯的开关在门的右边，进门一伸手就能摸到。
example.en: The light switch is to the right of the door; you can reach it as soon as you walk in.

example.zh: 这款手表的价格十分昂贵。
example.en: This watch is extremely expensive.

gloss: still; as before; to remain the same

example.zh: 虽然下着大雨，他仍旧去上班了。
example.en: Even though it was pouring with rain, he still went to work.

example.zh: 这次会议取得了圆满成功。
example.en: The conference was a complete success.

example.zh: 她特别喜欢听古典音乐，尤其是钢琴曲。
example.en: She especially likes listening to classical music, particularly piano pieces.

example.zh: 他很大方，经常请朋友们吃饭。
example.en: He is very generous and often treats his friends to meals.

example.zh: 老师的这番话给了我很大的启发。
example.en: The teacher's words were very enlightening to me.

gloss: pot; kettle; measure word for a pot of (tea, etc.)

example.zh: 桌子上的壶里还有热水，你自己倒吧。
example.en: There's still hot water in the pot on the table; help yourself.

example.zh: 请按照说明书上的步骤进行操作。
example.en: Please follow the steps in the instructions.

example.zh: 这家工厂接到了一大笔海外订单，工人们天天加班。
example.en: The factory received a big overseas order, and the workers are doing overtime every day.

example.zh: 疫情期间，很多公司让员工在家远程办公。
example.en: During the pandemic, many companies had staff work remotely from home.

gloss: to select; to choose (the best); selection

example.zh: 学校正在选拔参加比赛的学生。
example.en: The school is selecting students to take part in the competition.

example.zh: 招聘的事情，你可以去问人事部门。
example.en: For recruitment matters, you can ask the human resources department.

example.zh: 当今社会，几乎每个人都离不开手机。
example.en: In today's society, almost everyone depends on their phone.

example.zh: 我们需要找到一个可行的解决办法。
example.en: We need to find a workable solution.

gloss: as it happens, by chance; just right, exactly
meanings: (of number, time, size etc) just right

example.zh: 我到车站的时候，公交车恰好开过来。
example.en: Just as I got to the stop, the bus happened to pull up.

example.zh: 科学家认为人类是从古猿进化来的。
example.en: Scientists believe humans evolved from ancient apes.

gloss: to show (a ticket, ID, etc.); to present
meanings: to take out and show to others

example.zh: 上车前请出示您的车票和身份证。
example.en: Please show your ticket and ID before boarding.

example.zh: 这场洪水冲毁了很多农田。
example.en: The flood washed away a lot of farmland.

gloss: scenery; view; glorious; grand (of an occasion)

example.zh: 这里的风光非常美丽，吸引了很多游客。
example.en: The scenery here is beautiful and attracts many tourists.

gloss: to feel awkward; to make things difficult for; embarrassed
meanings: to find things difficult (to do or manage)

example.zh: 这件事让我很为难，不知道该怎么办。
example.en: This puts me in an awkward position; I don't know what to do.

gloss: to adapt (e.g. a novel into a film); to rearrange

example.zh: 这部电视剧是根据一本畅销小说改编的。
example.en: This TV series is adapted from a best-selling novel.

example.zh: 我们要从这次失败中吸取教训。
example.en: We must learn a lesson from this failure.

example.zh: 带父母出国旅游一次，是我多年的心愿。
example.en: Taking my parents on a trip abroad has been my wish for years.

example.zh: 最近股市大跌，很多人亏了不少钱。
example.en: The stock market has crashed recently, and many people have lost a lot of money.

example.zh: 对于一家新公司来说，第一年的发展至关重要。
example.en: For a new company, the first year of growth is crucial.

example.zh: 退休以后，她的生活过得很充实。
example.en: Since retiring, she has led a very full life.

gloss: to know, to recognize (e.g. to be able to read)

example.zh: 奶奶小时候没上过学，不识字。
example.en: Grandma never went to school as a child, so she can't read.

gloss: from now on, in the future, later on

example.zh: 往后的日子还长，别为了这点小事难过。
example.en: You have a long life ahead of you; don't be upset over something so small.

example.zh: 春天的公园里处处都是鲜花。
example.en: In spring there are flowers everywhere in the park.

gloss: not go so far as to, be unlikely to
meanings: unlikely to go so far as to; not as bad as

example.zh: 他虽然脾气不好，但还不至于为这点小事发火。
example.en: He has a bad temper, but he wouldn't go so far as to blow up over something this small.

gloss: of the same kind, similar; the same kind

example.zh: 和同类产品相比，这款手机的价格更低。
example.en: Compared with similar products, this phone is cheaper.

example.zh: 吃饺子的时候，我喜欢蘸一点儿醋。
example.en: When I eat dumplings, I like to dip them in a little vinegar.

indonesian: jiwa dan raga, fisik dan mental

example.zh: 经常运动有利于身心健康，还能让人心情变好。
example.en: Regular exercise is good for both body and mind, and it lifts your mood too.

gloss: to praise; to boast; to exaggerate

example.zh: 老师夸他作文写得好。
example.en: The teacher praised him for writing a good composition.

meanings: to dry (of weather, paint, cement etc)

example.zh: 北方的冬天很干燥，要多喝水。
example.en: Winters in the north are very dry, so you should drink plenty of water.

indonesian: tidak dapat menahan diri; mau tidak mau

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，她不禁笑了起来。
example.en: Hearing the good news, she couldn't help laughing.

example.zh: 昨天唱了一晚上歌，今天嗓子有点儿疼。
example.en: I sang all evening yesterday, and today my throat is a bit sore.

gloss: to exert all one's strength, to try hard; hard

example.zh: 瓶盖太紧了，我使劲拧了半天也没打开。
example.en: The bottle cap was too tight; I twisted it as hard as I could but still couldn't open it.

gloss: to spend; to pay out; expenditure; expenses

example.zh: 这个月的支出比上个月多了很多。
example.en: This month's expenses are much higher than last month's.

gloss: to win a prize (in a lottery or draw)
meanings: to win a prize (in a lottery etc)

example.zh: 听说他买彩票中奖了，一下子得了五百万。
example.en: I heard he won the lottery and suddenly got five million.

example.zh: 她从小就喜欢诗歌，大学时还出版了一本诗集。
example.en: She has loved poetry since childhood and even published a collection at university.

gloss: to solicit; to seek; to request (opinions, feedback etc)

example.zh: 这件事我想先征求一下你的意见。
example.en: I'd like to ask for your opinion on this matter first.

gloss: the whole journey or course, the entire process

example.zh: 这次马拉松全程四十二公里，他跑了不到三个小时。
example.en: This marathon is 42 kilometres in total, and he ran it in under three hours.

gloss: cognition, awareness; to recognize, to understand

example.zh: 小孩子对世界的认知是从模仿开始的。
example.en: Children's understanding of the world begins with imitation.

example.zh: 这种植物的生长周期大约是三个月。
example.en: This plant's growth cycle is about three months.

example.zh: 骑车下坡的时候要注意安全。
example.en: Be careful when cycling downhill.

example.zh: 这家咖啡馆的氛围很好，很适合看书。
example.en: This café has a nice atmosphere and is great for reading.

example.zh: 他在海边向女朋友求婚，她感动得哭了。
example.en: He proposed to his girlfriend by the sea, and she was moved to tears.

gloss: to trust; to have faith in; trust

example.zh: 他是一个值得信赖的朋友。
example.en: He's a friend worth trusting.

example.zh: 运动会上，同学们大声喊着班级的口号。
example.en: At the sports meet, the students loudly shouted their class slogan.

gloss: to demolish, to dismantle, to remove

example.zh: 这栋危楼下个月就要被拆除了。
example.en: This unsafe building will be demolished next month.

example.zh: 春天到了，蜜蜂在花间飞来飞去。
example.en: Spring has come, and bees are flying about among the flowers.

gloss: to taste; to sample; to savour

example.zh: 欢迎大家来品尝我们的新产品。
example.en: Everyone is welcome to sample our new products.

example.zh: 这对双胞胎长得一模一样，连他们的妈妈有时都会认错。
example.en: These twins look exactly alike; even their mother sometimes mixes them up.

example.zh: 以前北方冬天很多家庭都靠烧煤取暖。
example.en: In the past, many families in the north burned coal to keep warm in winter.

example.zh: 银行转账要收取一定的手续费。
example.en: Banks charge a certain fee for transfers.

gloss: to strengthen, to intensify, to reinforce

example.zh: 考试前，老师给我们安排了两周的强化训练。
example.en: Before the exam, the teacher arranged two weeks of intensive training for us.

gloss: to draw support from; with the help of; by means of

example.zh: 借助字典，他终于读懂了这篇文章。
example.en: With the help of a dictionary, he finally understood the article.

example.zh: 雪花的形态各不相同。
example.en: Every snowflake has a different shape.

gloss: to seize, to capture; to win (a title)

example.zh: 中国队在决赛中击败对手，夺取了冠军。
example.en: The Chinese team beat their opponents in the final and won the championship.

example.zh: 这么美的风景，我以前从不曾见过。
example.en: I've never seen such beautiful scenery before.

example.zh: 婚礼上，我们请了专业人员摄像和拍照。
example.en: For the wedding, we hired professionals to film and take photos.

example.zh: 我是间接从朋友那儿听说这件事的。
example.en: I heard about this secondhand from a friend.

gloss: to transport, to ship, to carry

example.zh: 这批救灾物资将由直升机运送到灾区。
example.en: This batch of relief supplies will be flown to the disaster area by helicopter.

gloss: to fight a battle; to go to war; to fight

example.zh: 他忙得像打仗一样，连饭都顾不上吃。
example.en: He's so busy it's like fighting a battle; he doesn't even have time to eat.

gloss: specially, on purpose, for a particular purpose

example.zh: 知道你喜欢吃饺子，妈妈特地给你包了一大盘。
example.en: Knowing you love dumplings, Mum made a big plate just for you.

example.zh: 他每天坚持锻炼，身体越来越强壮。
example.en: He exercises every day and is getting stronger and stronger.

meanings: to go out and come in

example.zh: 他说的和事实有很大出入，我们不能全信。
example.en: What he said differs greatly from the facts, so we can't believe all of it.

gloss: to distinguish; to differentiate; to tell apart

example.zh: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，很难区分。
example.en: These twins look so alike that it's hard to tell them apart.

example.zh: 她大学毕业后在一家报社当记者。
example.en: After graduating from university, she became a reporter at a newspaper.

gloss: to prepare; to make preparations; to arrange

example.zh: 我们正在筹备下个月的音乐节。
example.en: We are preparing for next month's music festival.

gloss: ending; to end, to wind up

example.zh: 这部电影的结尾让很多观众感到意外。
example.en: The ending of this film surprised many viewers.

example.zh: 这部电影的题材来自一个真实的故事。
example.en: The subject of this film comes from a true story.

meanings: to use anywhere, anytime (card, ticket etc)
to be used by everyone (language, textbook etc)

example.zh: 英语是国际上通用的语言之一。
example.en: English is one of the languages in general international use.

gloss: to fish (with a rod), to go fishing

example.zh: 周末爸爸常常带我去湖边钓鱼。
example.en: At weekends Dad often takes me fishing by the lake.

example.zh: 毕业以后，他迫切希望找到一份好工作。
example.en: After graduating, he was eager to find a good job.

gloss: to come into contact with; to have dealings

example.zh: 做销售工作，每天都要和各种各样的人打交道。
example.en: In sales, you have to deal with all kinds of people every day.

gloss: part-time job; side job; to hold a second job

example.zh: 很多大学生周末会去做兼职。
example.en: Many university students do part-time jobs on weekends.

gloss: roughly; approximately; more or less; general

example.zh: 我大致了解了一下情况。
example.en: I've got a rough idea of the situation.

example.zh: 她专门研究中国当代文学。
example.en: She specialises in contemporary Chinese literature.

gloss: to catch, to seize, to capture

example.zh: 渔民们一大早就出海捕鱼了。
example.en: The fishermen set out to sea early in the morning to catch fish.

example.zh: 第一次见面，他就对这个女孩产生了好感。
example.en: He took a liking to this girl the first time they met.

example.zh: 为了写这篇论文，他搜集了大量资料。
example.en: He gathered a great deal of material to write this paper.

example.zh: 皇帝召集大臣们商量国家大事。
example.en: The emperor summoned his ministers to discuss affairs of state.

example.zh: 每间教室都配备了电脑和投影仪。
example.en: Every classroom is equipped with a computer and projector.

gloss: hard to avoid; bound to happen

example.zh: 刚开始学外语，犯错是难免的。
example.en: When you first start learning a foreign language, mistakes are inevitable.

gloss: to splash; to spill; to throw (liquid); shrewish

example.zh: 他不小心把咖啡泼在了衬衫上。
example.en: He accidentally spilled coffee on his shirt.

meanings: to hold a reception; to offer hospitality; to entertain (guests); to serve (customers)

example.zh: 谢谢你们的热情招待，我们玩得很开心！
example.en: Thank you for your warm hospitality—we had a great time!

example.zh: 这款手机性能好，价格也不贵。
example.en: This phone performs well and isn't expensive.

example.zh: 从学生到职员，需要一个过渡阶段。
example.en: Going from student to employee takes a period of transition.

gloss: to care for; to show concern for; care; concern

example.zh: 感谢老师对我们的关怀和帮助。
example.en: Thank you, teacher, for your care and help.

gloss: to be selected, to be chosen
meanings: to be included among those selected for

example.zh: 她的作品入选了全国青年美术展。
example.en: Her work was selected for the national young artists' exhibition.

example.zh: 这座城市的人口密度非常高。
example.en: This city has a very high population density.

gloss: to shine, to glow, to give off light
meanings: to emit light; to shine; to glow; to glisten; to be luminous

example.zh: 萤火虫在夜里会发光，像一盏盏小灯。
example.en: Fireflies glow at night like little lamps.

example.zh: 打开窗户让空气流通一下。
example.en: Open the windows to let the air circulate.

gloss: from time to time; frequently; at any time

example.zh: 他一边听课，一边不时地记笔记。
example.en: He listened to the lecture, taking notes every now and then.

gloss: mainstream; main trend; main current (of a river)

example.zh: 网上购物已经成为消费的主流。
example.en: Online shopping has become the mainstream of consumption.

example.zh: 在校长的陪同下，客人参观了新建的图书馆。
example.en: Accompanied by the principal, the guests toured the new library.

gloss: to yearn for; to long for; to look forward to

example.zh: 我一直很向往海边的生活。
example.en: I have always longed for life by the sea.

gloss: the whole body, all over; a full outfit (of clothes)

example.zh: 跑完五公里，他出了一身汗，衣服全湿透了。
example.en: After running five kilometres he was sweating all over, his clothes soaked through.

example.zh: 他个子中等，戴着一副眼镜，看起来很斯文。
example.en: He's of medium height, wears glasses and looks quite refined.

example.zh: 上下班的时候，地铁里非常拥挤。
example.en: During rush hour, the subway is extremely crowded.

example.zh: 下班后我们一道去吃饭吧，我知道附近有家不错的面馆。
example.en: Let's go and eat together after work; I know a good noodle place nearby.

gloss: feedback; to give feedback; to report back

example.zh: 我们非常重视顾客的反馈意见。
example.en: We value customer feedback very highly.

example.zh: 这些瓷器做工精美，是博物馆的珍藏。
example.en: These porcelain pieces are exquisitely made and are treasures of the museum.

example.zh: 人生难免会遇到挫折，关键是不要放弃。
example.en: Setbacks are unavoidable in life; the key is not to give up.

example.zh: 这些水果可以在冰箱里储存一个星期。
example.en: These fruits can be kept in the fridge for a week.

example.zh: 看病应该去正规的医院。
example.en: You should see a doctor at a proper, licensed hospital.

example.zh: 他每个月都把工资的一部分用来储蓄。
example.en: Every month he puts part of his salary into savings.

example.zh: 他事后才知道，那天帮他的人就是新来的经理。
example.en: Only afterwards did he learn that the person who helped him that day was the new manager.

gloss: to value, to regard as important, to think highly of
meanings: to regard as important; to value

example.zh: 比起工资，我更看重工作的发展前景。
example.en: Rather than salary, I care more about a job's prospects.

gloss: to come and go; contact, dealings

example.zh: 大桥修好后，两岸居民往来方便多了。
example.en: Since the bridge was built, it's much easier for people on both banks to go back and forth.

example.zh: 我们要保护环境，为后代留下美丽的地球。
example.en: We must protect the environment and leave a beautiful planet for future generations.

gloss: products, goods (made of a given material)

example.zh: 这家工厂主要生产各种塑料制品。
example.en: This factory mainly produces all kinds of plastic goods.

gloss: to come and go; to have contact with, to associate with

example.zh: 路上来往的车辆很多，过马路要小心。
example.en: There's a lot of traffic coming and going, so be careful crossing the road.

example.zh: 商店不得向未成年人出售烟酒。
example.en: Shops must not sell cigarettes or alcohol to minors.

gloss: to care for, to show loving concern for
meanings: to show concern and care for

example.zh: 社会应该多关爱留守儿童，让他们健康成长。
example.en: Society should show more care for left-behind children so that they can grow up healthy.

example.zh: 这种材料具有耐高温的特性。
example.en: This material has the property of withstanding high temperatures.

example.zh: 夏天的内蒙古大草原上，到处是成群的牛羊。
example.en: In summer the great Inner Mongolian grasslands are full of herds of cattle and sheep.

indonesian: makna yang terkandung; isi; kedalaman batin

example.zh: 这首诗的内涵很丰富。
example.en: This poem is rich in meaning.

example.zh: 今年这个地区遭了旱灾，粮食大量减产。
example.en: This region was hit by drought this year, and grain output fell sharply.

example.zh: 凡是参加比赛的同学都能得到一份纪念品。
example.en: Every student who takes part in the contest gets a souvenir.

gloss: at first; originally; in the beginning

example.zh: 起初我不太习惯这里的生活，后来慢慢适应了。
example.en: At first I wasn't used to life here, but later I gradually adapted.

example.zh: 中国北方的农民主要种植小麦。
example.en: Farmers in northern China mainly grow wheat.

example.zh: 山顶上氧气比较少，走路容易累。
example.en: There is less oxygen at the summit, so walking tires you out easily.

example.zh: 很多老年人喜欢买保健品，可有些并没有什么效果。
example.en: Many elderly people like buying health supplements, but some don't do much.

example.zh: 我们公司实行弹性工作时间。
example.en: Our company has flexible working hours.

gloss: to turn, to rotate, to spin

example.zh: 他轻轻转动钥匙，门“咔”的一声开了。
example.en: He gently turned the key, and the door clicked open.

meanings: Fuyu county in Qiqihar 齐齐哈尔, Heilongjiang

example.zh: 这些年，村民们的生活越来越富裕了。
example.en: In recent years, the villagers have become more and more prosperous.

example.zh: 这种饼干又香又脆，孩子们都爱吃。
example.en: These biscuits are fragrant and crunchy; the kids all love them.

gloss: increasingly; day by day; more and more
meanings: more and more with each passing day

example.zh: 人们的生活水平日益提高。
example.en: People's living standards are rising day by day.

gloss: measure word for plants and trees; plant
indonesian: kata satuan untuk tanaman dan pohon; batang

example.zh: 院子里种了几株桃树。
example.en: Several peach trees are planted in the yard.

example.zh: 如果服药后出现身体不适，请立即停药。
example.en: If you feel unwell after taking the medicine, stop taking it immediately.

gloss: wild, growing or living in the wild

example.zh: 这片森林里生活着很多野生动物。
example.en: Lots of wild animals live in this forest.

example.zh: 抛硬币时，正面朝上的概率是百分之五十。
example.en: When you toss a coin, the probability of heads is fifty percent.

meanings: deformity on a person or animal

example.zh: 他虽然身体有残疾，但从来没有放弃过梦想。
example.en: Although he has a physical disability, he has never given up on his dreams.

example.zh: 公司每个月给员工发交通补贴。
example.en: The company gives employees a monthly transport allowance.

gloss: to land (of a plane); to fall to the ground; to be put into practice
meanings: to be set on the ground

example.zh: 飞机将在二十分钟后落地，请大家系好安全带。
example.en: The plane will land in twenty minutes; please fasten your seat belts.

example.zh: 她从五岁开始练体操，现在已经是国家队队员了。
example.en: She started doing gymnastics at five and is now on the national team.

example.zh: 经常吃快餐又不运动，很容易导致肥胖。
example.en: Eating fast food often without exercising can easily lead to obesity.

example.zh: 这种香水的味道很持久。
example.en: The scent of this perfume lasts a long time.

gloss: to be called, to be known as
meanings: to be called; to be known as

example.zh: 大熊猫性格温和、样子可爱，被称作中国的“国宝”。
example.en: Gentle and cute, the giant panda is called China's 'national treasure'.

indonesian: topan; angin taifun; penampilan di panggung

example.zh: 台风明天就要到了，大家注意安全。
example.en: The typhoon arrives tomorrow; everyone please stay safe.

gloss: to undertake; to host (an event); to take on

example.zh: 这次比赛由我们学校承办。
example.en: This competition is being hosted by our school.

gloss: to melt; to thaw; to dissolve

example.zh: 太阳出来后，屋顶上的雪慢慢融化了。
example.en: After the sun came out, the snow on the roof slowly melted.

example.zh: 这件衣服的款式很新颖。
example.en: This garment has a very fresh design.

example.zh: 办理签证的流程比以前简单多了。
example.en: The visa application process is much simpler than before.

example.zh: 他巧妙地回答了记者的问题。
example.en: He cleverly answered the reporter's question.

example.zh: 图书馆里有各种各样的书籍。
example.en: The library has all kinds of books.

example.zh: 如果您对上述内容有任何疑问，请随时联系我们。
example.en: If you have any questions about the above, please feel free to contact us.

example.zh: 两辆汽车在十字路口发生碰撞，幸好没有人受伤。
example.en: Two cars collided at the crossroads; luckily no one was hurt.

example.zh: 这档节目是提前录制好的，不是现场直播。
example.en: This show was pre-recorded, not broadcast live.

example.zh: 鲨鱼是海洋里最可怕的动物之一。
example.en: Sharks are among the most frightening animals in the ocean.

example.zh: 记者对这位作家进行了一次长时间的访谈。
example.en: The journalist conducted a long interview with the writer.

example.zh: 这里的土壤很肥沃，适合种水果。
example.en: The soil here is fertile and good for growing fruit.

example.zh: 这家工厂把污水直接排进河里，被罚了一大笔钱。
example.en: This factory discharged sewage straight into the river and was heavily fined.

example.zh: 他的眉毛又黑又浓，看起来很精神。
example.en: His eyebrows are dark and thick, and he looks very lively.

example.zh: 公司计划明年把业务扩展到东南亚市场。
example.en: The company plans to expand its business into Southeast Asian markets next year.

gloss: delighted; to one's heart's content; readily

example.zh: 考试终于结束了，大家玩得非常痛快。
example.en: The exams are finally over, and everyone had a wonderful time.

gloss: to breed; to reproduce; to propagate

example.zh: 春天是很多动物繁殖的季节。
example.en: Spring is the breeding season for many animals.

gloss: to make heavier; to aggravate, to worsen
meanings: (of an illness etc) to become more serious

example.zh: 感冒了还不按时吃药，只会加重病情。
example.en: If you have a cold and don't take your medicine on time, you'll only make it worse.

example.zh: 我们要主动学习，不能被动地等待。
example.en: We should learn actively, not wait passively.

gloss: to someone's face; in someone's presence; face to face
indonesian: di hadapan; secara langsung; berhadapan muka

example.zh: 有意见可以当面提，不要在背后说。
example.en: If you have objections, raise them face to face; don't talk behind people's backs.

gloss: soon, in a moment; to watch (something happen) helplessly
meanings: to look on as sth happens

example.zh: 眼看就要考试了，他却一点儿也不着急。
example.en: The exam is just around the corner, yet he's not worried at all.

gloss: research topic; project; problem to solve

example.zh: 他正在研究一个关于环境保护的课题。
example.en: He is working on a research project on environmental protection.

gloss: just like; as if; similar to

example.zh: 这里的风景犹如一幅美丽的画。
example.en: The scenery here is like a beautiful painting.

example.zh: 爬了一天的山，大家又累又饥饿。
example.en: After climbing all day, everyone was tired and hungry.

gloss: vertical; upright; to erect; vertical stroke

example.zh: 路边竖着一块很大的广告牌。
example.en: A huge billboard stands by the roadside.

example.zh: 我们要透过现象看实质。
example.en: We must look past the appearance to the essence.

example.zh: 这次火灾是人为造成的。
example.en: This fire was caused by people.

gloss: to describe; to depict; to portray

example.zh: 这本小说描写了一个普通家庭的生活。
example.en: This novel depicts the life of an ordinary family.

example.zh: 这种面包没有添加任何防腐剂。
example.en: This bread has no added preservatives.

example.zh: 请把会议的要点记下来。
example.en: Please write down the key points of the meeting.

meanings: to put a stop to sth

example.zh: 报名将于本月三十号截止。
example.en: Registration closes on the 30th of this month.

gloss: to fall ill; (of an illness) to strike, to flare up
meanings: (of a person) to get sick; to fall ill

example.zh: 这种病多在冬季发病，老人和孩子要特别注意。
example.en: This illness usually strikes in winter; the elderly and children should be especially careful.

example.zh: 他匆匆吃了几口饭，就赶去上班了。
example.en: He gulped down a few mouthfuls and rushed off to work.

example.zh: 越来越多的年轻人有机会接受高等教育。
example.en: More and more young people have the chance to receive higher education.

gloss: the present moment, now; right away, at once

example.zh: 与其担心未来，不如过好当下的每一天。
example.en: Rather than worry about the future, it's better to live each day well right now.

gloss: to depict; to describe; to portray

example.zh: 这幅画描绘了江南水乡的美丽风景。
example.en: This painting depicts the beautiful scenery of the southern water towns.

gloss: to go sightseeing; to tour; sightseeing

example.zh: 每年都有很多外国游客来这里观光。
example.en: Every year many foreign tourists come here to sightsee.

example.zh: 我舅舅是一名医生，他是我妈妈的哥哥。
example.en: My uncle is a doctor; he is my mother's older brother.

example.zh: 这列高铁的最高时速可以达到三百五十公里。
example.en: This high-speed train can reach a top speed of 350 kilometres per hour.

example.zh: 借的书请在两周内归还。
example.en: Please return borrowed books within two weeks.

gloss: to be linked, to be connected

example.zh: 这两座城市由一座跨海大桥相连。
example.en: These two cities are linked by a sea-crossing bridge.

gloss: to be limited to, to be confined to

example.zh: 本次优惠活动仅限于新会员，老会员不能参加。
example.en: This promotion is limited to new members; existing members can't take part.

meanings: public good; public welfare; public interest

example.zh: 她经常参加公益活动，去敬老院看望老人。
example.en: She often does charity work, visiting elderly people at the nursing home.

example.zh: 你会演奏什么乐器吗？
example.en: Can you play any musical instruments?

example.zh: 出国前要注意哪些事项？
example.en: What matters should you pay attention to before going abroad?

example.zh: 现在很多家庭都用天然气做饭。
example.en: Many households now cook with natural gas.

gloss: to admire, to appreciate, to praise

example.zh: 他认真负责的工作态度得到了领导的赞赏。
example.en: His conscientious attitude to work won his boss's praise.

example.zh: 专家在节目中解读了新出台的房地产政策。
example.en: On the programme, experts explained the newly issued property policy.

example.zh: 她穿了一件棕色的大衣。
example.en: She wore a brown coat.

meanings: to correspond (to); to be equivalent to; to be a counterpart to

example.zh: 每个汉字都对应一个音节。
example.en: Each Chinese character corresponds to one syllable.

example.zh: 新教室宽敞明亮，同学们都很喜欢。
example.en: The new classroom is spacious and bright, and all the students love it.

example.zh: 房间刚装修完，要多开窗通风。
example.en: The room has just been renovated, so open the windows often to air it out.

example.zh: 孩子们在操场上快乐地奔跑。
example.en: The children ran happily around the playground.

gloss: to weaken, to diminish, to die down

example.zh: 台风登陆后风力逐渐减弱，雨也慢慢停了。
example.en: After the typhoon made landfall, the wind gradually weakened and the rain slowly stopped.

gloss: to paint, to draw; painting, drawing

example.zh: 她从小就对绘画很感兴趣，常常一画就是一下午。
example.en: She has loved painting since she was little and often paints for a whole afternoon.

example.zh: 这部电影已经拍完了，现在正在做后期制作。
example.en: The filming is finished, and the movie is now in post-production.

example.zh: 棒球在美国和日本非常受欢迎。
example.en: Baseball is very popular in the United States and Japan.

gloss: to talk about; to discuss; comment

example.zh: 大家都在议论这次考试的结果。
example.en: Everyone is talking about the results of this exam.

example.zh: 在森林里迷路时，可以用太阳来判断方位。
example.en: If you get lost in a forest, you can use the sun to work out directions.

gloss: to age; to grow old; ageing; senile

example.zh: 适当的运动可以延缓衰老。
example.en: The right amount of exercise can slow down ageing.

gloss: to manage money, to manage one's finances
meanings: to manage wealth; to manage finances; money management

example.zh: 年轻人应该早点学会理财，不要每个月都把钱花光。
example.en: Young people should learn to manage their money early and not spend everything every month.

gloss: to be fooled; to be taken in

example.zh: 这种广告不能随便相信，小心上当。
example.en: Don't just believe ads like this; be careful not to get fooled.

gloss: to screen; to select; to filter

example.zh: 公司从一百多份简历中筛选出十个人参加面试。
example.en: From over a hundred CVs the company shortlisted ten people for interviews.

example.zh: 语言是沟通不同文化的桥梁。
example.en: Language is a bridge between different cultures.

example.zh: 她做了一个“OK”的手势，表示没问题。
example.en: She made an "OK" gesture to show there was no problem.

gloss: to view and enjoy, to admire (sights, flowers)
meanings: to look at sth with pleasure; to watch (sth marvelous)

example.zh: 每年春天，很多游客来这里观赏樱花。
example.en: Every spring, many tourists come here to admire the cherry blossoms.

example.zh: 今年工作的重心是开发新产品。
example.en: This year our work will focus on developing new products.

gloss: to start, to initiate, to pioneer

example.zh: 这位科学家开创了一个全新的研究领域。
example.en: This scientist pioneered an entirely new field of research.

example.zh: 她取得了这么好的成绩，却还是很谦虚。
example.en: Even with such excellent results, she is still very modest.

gloss: to originate from, to stem from

example.zh: 很多中国的节日都源于古代的传说。
example.en: Many Chinese festivals originate from ancient legends.

example.zh: 这个故事给了我很大的启示。
example.en: This story taught me a great lesson.

gloss: structure, construction; to construct, to build

example.zh: 这台机器的构造很复杂，一般人修不了。
example.en: This machine's structure is very complex; an ordinary person can't fix it.

example.zh: 每周一早上，学校都会举行升国旗仪式。
example.en: Every Monday morning, the school holds a flag-raising ceremony.

example.zh: 秋天到了，河面上漂着一片片金黄的落叶。
example.en: Autumn has come, and golden fallen leaves are floating on the river.

example.zh: 饭后不要马上做剧烈运动。
example.en: Don't do strenuous exercise right after a meal.

example.zh: 这座水库为全市提供了一半的饮用水。
example.en: This reservoir provides half the city's drinking water.

meanings: lit. by the thousands and tens of thousands (idiom); untold numbers

example.zh: 每年都有成千上万的游客来这里看日出。
example.en: Every year tens of thousands of tourists come here to watch the sunrise.

example.zh: 结账的时候，请帮我开一张发票。
example.en: When I pay, please issue me a receipt.

example.zh: 下课后要及时复习，巩固学过的知识。
example.en: Review promptly after class to consolidate what you've learned.

example.zh: 创业的道路十分艰辛，他吃了很多苦。
example.en: The road to starting a business is very hard, and he endured a lot.

example.zh: 这个行业有着广阔的发展前景。
example.en: This industry has broad prospects for development.

example.zh: 天气越来越冷了，出门一定要注意保暖。
example.en: It's getting colder and colder, so be sure to keep warm when you go out.

example.zh: 新年到了，祝愿您和家人身体健康，万事如意！
example.en: The New Year is here; wishing you and your family good health and every success!

gloss: to be greatly surprised, to be astonished
meanings: to have a surprise (idiom); shocked or startled

example.zh: 看到考试成绩，他大吃一惊，没想到自己考了满分。
example.en: He was astonished when he saw his exam result; he never expected a perfect score.

example.zh: 请你把事情的经过详细地叙述一遍。
example.en: Please describe in detail how it all happened.

example.zh: 我们凌晨四点出发，终于在日出前爬到了山顶。
example.en: We set off at four in the morning and finally reached the summit before sunrise.

gloss: outdated, out of fashion, obsolete; to go out of date
meanings: to be later than the time stipulated or agreed upon

example.zh: 这件衣服的款式早就过时了。
example.en: The style of this outfit went out of fashion long ago.

example.zh: 从我家到公司，开车大约半个小时的路程。
example.en: From my home to the office it's about a half-hour drive.

gloss: to introduce, to bring in (from outside)

example.zh: 这家医院引入了国外最先进的医疗设备。
example.en: This hospital has brought in the most advanced medical equipment from abroad.

example.zh: 经过一年的努力，我们的工作取得了明显的成效。
example.en: After a year's effort, our work has produced clear results.

gloss: as everyone knows; as is well known
indonesian: seperti diketahui semua orang; sudah umum diketahui

example.zh: 众所周知，吸烟对身体有害。
example.en: As everyone knows, smoking is bad for your health.

example.zh: 她以顽强的毅力战胜了疾病。
example.en: She beat the illness with tenacious willpower.

example.zh: 勤洗手可以有效预防很多传染病。
example.en: Washing your hands often can effectively prevent many infectious diseases.

example.zh: 他走得太匆忙，把手机忘在了家里。
example.en: He left in such a hurry that he forgot his phone at home.

example.zh: 时间、地点和人物是记叙文的基本要素。
example.en: Time, place and characters are the basic elements of a narrative.

gloss: to transfer (ownership); to make over; to sell (rights, shop)

example.zh: 这家小店因为老板要出国，准备转让。
example.en: The owner is moving abroad, so this little shop is up for transfer.

gloss: won't do, no good; (at the end of a rhetorical question) is it that...?
indonesian: tidak bisa, tidak boleh; (partikel pertanyaan retoris)
meanings: (at the end of a rhetorical question) can that be?

example.zh: 天都黑了，你难道要一个人走回去不成？
example.en: It's already dark; don't tell me you're going to walk back alone?

example.zh: 这里独特的沙漠景观每年吸引大量游客。
example.en: The unique desert landscape here attracts large numbers of tourists every year.

gloss: to submerge; to flood; to drown out

example.zh: 他的声音被热烈的掌声淹没了。
example.en: His voice was drowned out by the warm applause.

meanings: sleeveless garment (vest, waistcoat, singlet, tank top etc)

example.zh: 夏天太热了，他在家只穿一件背心。
example.en: Summer is so hot that he wears just a vest at home.

example.zh: 医生一再提醒他要少喝酒。
example.en: The doctor reminded him again and again to drink less.

example.zh: 我在门口白白等了他两个小时，他根本没来。
example.en: I waited for him at the door for two hours for nothing; he never came.

gloss: the outdoors, the wild, open country

example.zh: 周末我们去野外露营，晚上还看到了满天的星星。
example.en: At the weekend we went camping in the wild and saw a sky full of stars at night.

gloss: to cultivate; to breed; to nurture

example.zh: 科学家培育出了一种新的水稻品种。
example.en: Scientists have bred a new variety of rice.

example.zh: 一条弯曲的小路通向山上的寺庙。
example.en: A winding path leads up to the temple on the mountain.

example.zh: 医院规定，手术前必须由病人的亲属签字。
example.en: Hospital rules require a patient's relative to sign before surgery.

example.zh: 这里风很大，很适合建风力发电站。
example.en: It's very windy here, ideal for building a wind power station.

gloss: to found, to set up (a school, company, publication)

example.zh: 这所学校是由一位华侨在1920年创办的。
example.en: This school was founded in 1920 by an overseas Chinese.

example.zh: 这家超市的商品种类非常齐全。
example.en: This supermarket has a complete range of goods.

example.zh: 很多家庭在屋顶上安装了太阳能热水器。
example.en: Many families have installed solar water heaters on their roofs.

example.zh: 他站在海边，望着远方的轮船。
example.en: He stood by the sea, gazing at the ship in the distance.

meanings: place (in an institution, a group etc)

example.zh: 这次培训的名额有限，请尽快报名。
example.en: Places on this training course are limited, so please sign up soon.

example.zh: 老师耐心地解答了每一个学生的问题。
example.en: The teacher patiently answered every student's questions.

example.zh: 奶奶腿脚不方便，出门只能坐轮椅。
example.en: Grandma has trouble walking and can only go out in a wheelchair.
