meanings: to seek help (when in distress or having difficulties)

example.zh: 他被困在电梯里，赶紧打电话求救。
example.en: He was trapped in the lift and quickly phoned for help.

example.zh: 这间屋子很久没人住了，桌子上落满了灰尘。
example.en: Nobody has lived in this room for a long time, and the table is covered in dust.

gloss: to look forward to; to long for
meanings: to hope for; to look forward to

example.zh: 孩子们天天盼望着放寒假。
example.en: The children look forward to the winter holiday every day.

example.zh: 这台音箱的输出功率很大，适合在户外使用。
example.en: This speaker has a high output power and is good for outdoor use.

example.zh: 我们几个人轮流打扫宿舍。
example.en: The few of us take turns cleaning the dorm.

example.zh: 这幅画的颜色非常鲜明。
example.en: The colours of this painting are very bright.

gloss: many, numerous, a great deal of
meanings: (used for abstract things) a good deal, a lot of

example.zh: 新政策实施过程中遇到了诸多问题。
example.en: The new policy has run into many problems during implementation.

example.zh: 这些家具都是用上等木材做的。
example.en: All this furniture is made of top-quality timber.

example.zh: 景德镇自古以生产瓷器闻名，被人们叫作“瓷都”。
example.en: Since ancient times Jingdezhen has been famous for its porcelain, and people call it the 'Porcelain Capital'.

example.zh: 我们要采取切实可行的措施解决问题。
example.en: We must take practical, feasible measures to solve the problem.

example.zh: 这个箱子很结实，放再多东西也不会坏。
example.en: This box is very sturdy; it won't break no matter how much you put in it.

gloss: the ancients, people of ancient times
meanings: extinct human species such as Homo erectus or Homo neanderthalensis

example.zh: 古人没有手表，是怎么知道时间的呢？
example.en: People in ancient times didn't have watches, so how did they tell the time?

example.zh: 由于台风来临，港口里的船只都停止了出海。
example.en: With the typhoon coming, all the vessels in the harbour have stopped going out to sea.

gloss: to form a complete set; supporting; matching
indonesian: menjadi satu set; pelengkap; fasilitas pendukung

example.zh: 这个小区的配套设施非常完善。
example.en: The supporting facilities in this residential area are very complete.

example.zh: 项目的前期准备工作已经基本完成。
example.en: The preliminary preparations for the project are basically complete.

gloss: to restore (to original state); to recreate; to reduce (chemistry)
indonesian: mengembalikan ke keadaan semula; memulihkan; reduksi (kimia)
meanings: to restore to the original state

example.zh: 这部电影真实地还原了当时的生活。
example.en: This film faithfully recreates life at that time.

gloss: to postpone; to delay; to extend (a deadline)

example.zh: 因为下大雨，运动会延期举行。
example.en: Because of heavy rain, the sports day was postponed.

example.zh: 医生说，饭后不宜马上运动，最好先休息半小时。
example.en: The doctor says it isn't advisable to exercise right after a meal; it's best to rest for half an hour first.

example.zh: 图中这两条直线互相垂直。
example.en: The two straight lines in the diagram are perpendicular to each other.

gloss: to leave the country, to exit (a border)
meanings: to leave a country or region

example.zh: 出境旅游一定要带好护照和签证。
example.en: When travelling abroad, be sure to bring your passport and visa.

gloss: to govern; to administer; to bring under control; to tackle

example.zh: 这座城市花了很大力气治理空气污染。
example.en: The city has put great effort into tackling air pollution.

example.zh: 我姑姑是我爸爸的妹妹，她在上海工作。
example.en: My aunt is my dad's younger sister; she works in Shanghai.

example.zh: 今年房价上涨的幅度很大。
example.en: House prices have risen by a large margin this year.

example.zh: 北方冬天家家都有暖气，屋里一点儿也不冷。
example.en: In the north every home has heating in winter, so it's not cold indoors at all.

example.zh: 遇到困难时不要太悲观，办法总会有的。
example.en: Don't be too pessimistic when you run into difficulties; there's always a way.

gloss: to select (by appraisal or vote), to choose
meanings: to select on the basis of a vote or consensus

example.zh: 她被评选为今年的优秀教师。
example.en: She was chosen as this year's outstanding teacher.

gloss: to lead; to head; to command

example.zh: 校长率领代表团出国访问。
example.en: The principal led a delegation abroad on a visit.

gloss: to found; to establish; to create

example.zh: 这家公司是他二十年前创立的。
example.en: He founded this company twenty years ago.

example.zh: 这家酒店的早餐是自助的，种类很多。
example.en: This hotel's breakfast is a self-service buffet with lots of choice.

meanings: (biology) ancestral species; ancient species from which present-day species evolved

example.zh: 这些传统是我们的祖先留下来的。
example.en: These traditions were handed down by our ancestors.

gloss: to feel wronged; to be treated unfairly; grievance
indonesian: merasa diperlakukan tidak adil; sakit hati
meanings: to cause sb to feel wronged

example.zh: 明明不是她的错，却被批评了，她觉得很委屈。
example.en: It clearly wasn't her fault, yet she was criticised, so she felt very wronged.

meanings: one's special ability or strong points

example.zh: 你有什么特长？会唱歌还是会画画？
example.en: What are you good at? Singing or painting?

example.zh: 数学是我最薄弱的科目。
example.en: Maths is my weakest subject.

gloss: to host; to organize; to sponsor (an event)
meanings: to host (a conference or sports event)

example.zh: 这次国际会议由我们学校主办。
example.en: This international conference is hosted by our school.

indonesian: diakui secara umum; diakui semua orang

example.zh: 他是大家公认的最好的老师。
example.en: He is generally recognised as the best teacher.

gloss: to open, to set up (a course, branch, account)

example.zh: 学校今年新开设了一门人工智能课程。
example.en: The school has launched a new artificial intelligence course this year.

example.zh: 今年的失业率比去年下降了两个百分点。
example.en: This year's unemployment rate is two percentage points lower than last year's.

meanings: specific topic (addressed by a book, lecture, TV program etc)
article, report or program etc on a specific topic

example.zh: 电视台正在播放一个关于环保的专题节目。
example.en: The TV station is broadcasting a special programme on the environment.

gloss: to have a meal, to dine

example.zh: 本店用餐时间为中午十一点到下午两点。
example.en: Our dining hours are from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.

meanings: period of time (may be months, or mere seconds)

example.zh: 他花了很大工夫，才把这篇文章翻译好。
example.en: It took him a great deal of effort to translate this article.

gloss: to seem, to look as if, apparently

example.zh: 这道题看似简单，其实很多人都做错了。
example.en: This question looks simple, but in fact lots of people got it wrong.

gloss: to generate, to produce, to form
meanings: to generate; to produce; to form; to be formed; to come into being
to be born with; to be blessed with

example.zh: 输入几个关键词，这个软件就能自动生成一篇文章。
example.en: Type in a few keywords and this software can automatically generate an article.

example.zh: 这是全国最繁忙的机场之一。
example.en: This is one of the busiest airports in the country.

example.zh: 他们俩上个月订婚了，打算明年春天结婚。
example.en: The two of them got engaged last month and plan to marry next spring.

example.zh: 春节吃饺子是北方的习俗。
example.en: Eating dumplings at Spring Festival is a northern custom.

example.zh: 传说这座山里埋着很多金子，吸引了不少人来寻找。
example.en: Legend has it that lots of gold is buried in this mountain, which has drawn many people to search for it.

example.zh: 每天刷牙有助于保持口腔健康。
example.en: Brushing your teeth every day helps keep your mouth healthy.

gloss: life span; service life (of a machine)

example.zh: 随着生活水平的提高，人们的寿命越来越长。
example.en: As living standards rise, people's life expectancy keeps getting longer.

gloss: to divide; to partition; to differentiate

example.zh: 老师把全班划分成五个小组。
example.en: The teacher divided the class into five groups.

example.zh: 这台电脑体积小，携带方便。
example.en: This computer is small and easy to carry.

example.zh: 中国地域辽阔，各地的风俗习惯差别很大。
example.en: China covers a vast territory, and customs vary greatly from place to place.

gloss: hot spot; hot topic, focus of attention

example.zh: 房价一直是社会关注的热点问题。
example.en: Housing prices have always been a hot topic of public concern.

example.zh: 下雪后，环卫工人一大早就把人行道上的雪扫干净了。
example.en: After the snowfall, sanitation workers swept the snow off the pavement first thing in the morning.

example.zh: 这家酒店的服务非常周到。
example.en: The service at this hotel is very attentive.

gloss: to place, to put, to arrange (objects)
meanings: to set up; to arrange; to lay out

example.zh: 书架上的书摆放得整整齐齐。
example.en: The books on the shelf are neatly arranged.

gloss: to be proficient in; to master; to have a good command of

example.zh: 她精通三种语言，是一名优秀的翻译。
example.en: She is fluent in three languages and is an excellent translator.

gloss: to take a fancy to, to settle on (choose)

example.zh: 她在商场里一眼就看中了那双白色运动鞋。
example.en: She took a fancy to that pair of white trainers the moment she saw them in the mall.

example.zh: 这里的自来水不能直接喝，要烧开了才行。
example.en: The tap water here isn't safe to drink straight; it has to be boiled first.

example.zh: 这一带地形复杂，开车一定要小心。
example.en: The terrain around here is complicated, so drive carefully.

example.zh: 她做事非常细致，从来不出错。
example.en: She works very meticulously and never makes mistakes.

gloss: to sell well; best-selling; in great demand

example.zh: 这本小说一出版就十分畅销。
example.en: This novel sold extremely well as soon as it came out.

example.zh: 这位画家年轻时没什么名气，晚年作品才受到重视。
example.en: This painter wasn't well known when young; only in later life did his work get attention.

example.zh: 这里的气候很适宜种茶。
example.en: The climate here is well suited to growing tea.

gloss: to provide for the elderly; to live out one's old age, retirement
indonesian: merawat orang tua; menjalani masa tua
meanings: to provide for the elderly (family members)
to enjoy a life in retirement

example.zh: 很多人退休后选择回老家养老。
example.en: Many people choose to spend their retirement back in their hometown.

example.zh: 这家百货商场今天开始打折，人特别多。
example.en: This department store started its sale today and it's packed.

gloss: example; analogy; for example; to compare

example.zh: 老师打了一个比方，大家马上就明白了。
example.en: The teacher used an analogy and everyone understood immediately.

example.zh: 下雪后路面很滑，开车要慢一点。
example.en: After snow the road surface is slippery, so drive more slowly.

meanings: to restrict sth within set boundaries

example.zh: 我们的眼光不能只局限于眼前的利益。
example.en: Our view shouldn't be limited to immediate gains.

example.zh: 做这道菜的时候，最后加一点儿酱油。
example.en: When you make this dish, add a little soy sauce at the end.

example.zh: 孩子到了青春期，常常不愿意和父母说心里话。
example.en: When children reach adolescence, they're often unwilling to open up to their parents.

example.zh: 做面包需要面粉、鸡蛋、牛奶和黄油。
example.en: To make bread you need flour, eggs, milk and butter.

example.zh: 用手机支付既方便又快捷，现在很少有人带现金了。
example.en: Paying by phone is convenient and quick; few people carry cash any more.

example.zh: 楼前有一块空地，孩子们常在那里踢球。
example.en: There's an open space in front of the building where the kids often play football.

gloss: to compress; to reduce; to cut down

example.zh: 我们要压缩开支，节约用钱。
example.en: We need to cut spending and save money.

example.zh: 在火车站请保管好您的随身财物。
example.en: Please keep an eye on your belongings at the railway station.

example.zh: 他大学学的是考古专业。
example.en: He studied archaeology at university.

example.zh: 我的耐心是有限度的，你别太过分了。
example.en: My patience has its limits, so don't push it.

example.zh: 我妈妈有两个姐姐，我叫她们大姨和二姨。
example.en: My mother has two older sisters; I call them Big Auntie and Second Auntie.

meanings: to emit; to discharge (exhaust gas, waste water etc)
(of animals) to ovulate; to discharge semen

example.zh: 工厂不能把污水直接排放到河里。
example.en: Factories may not discharge waste water straight into rivers.

example.zh: 每天中午，写字楼附近的餐厅里坐满了白领。
example.en: Every day at noon, the restaurants near the office buildings are full of white-collar workers.

example.zh: 冬天湖面结了冰，很多人来这里滑冰。
example.en: In winter the lake freezes over and lots of people come here to skate.

example.zh: 这个地区人口密集，交通压力很大。
example.en: This area is densely populated, and traffic is under heavy strain.

example.zh: 他很善于交际，朋友特别多。
example.en: He is very good at socialising and has lots of friends.

gloss: to face upward, to look up, to tilt one's head back

example.zh: 他站在院子里，仰着头看天上的星星。
example.en: He stood in the yard, head tilted back, looking at the stars in the sky.

example.zh: 看外国电影的时候，我一般会打开中文字幕。
example.en: When I watch foreign films, I usually turn on Chinese subtitles.

example.zh: 她在这次全国比赛中获得了亚军。
example.en: She came second in this national competition.

example.zh: 这位老师傅一共带过二十多个徒弟。
example.en: This old master has trained more than twenty apprentices.

example.zh: 苹果和香蕉相比，我更喜欢前者。
example.en: Between apples and bananas, I prefer the former.

gloss: to call on; to appeal; call

example.zh: 学校号召学生节约用水。
example.en: The school is calling on students to save water.

gloss: interval; gap; to be separated by
meanings: to leave a gap of (two weeks, three meters etc)

example.zh: 两次服药之间要间隔四个小时。
example.en: There should be an interval of four hours between doses.

example.zh: 读完这本书，你有什么感想？
example.en: Now that you've finished this book, what are your thoughts on it?

example.zh: 外国游客入境时需要出示护照和签证。
example.en: Foreign visitors must show their passport and visa when entering the country.

example.zh: 这条街的照明设施太差，晚上走路很不安全。
example.en: The lighting on this street is so poor that it's unsafe to walk at night.

example.zh: 他是一名地质学家，经常去野外考察。
example.en: He is a geologist and often does fieldwork.

gloss: to differ; difference; to be apart

example.zh: 我和哥哥的年龄相差五岁。
example.en: My brother and I are five years apart in age.

example.zh: 每个月一号，信用卡账单就会发到我的手机上。
example.en: On the first of every month, my credit card statement is sent to my phone.

gloss: shortage; to be in short supply

example.zh: 由于连续干旱，这个地区出现了严重的水资源短缺。
example.en: Because of continuous drought, this region has a severe water shortage.

example.zh: 秋天公园里开满了各种颜色的菊花。
example.en: In autumn the park is full of chrysanthemums of every colour.

example.zh: 请用黑色钢笔在表格上书写姓名。
example.en: Please write your name on the form with a black pen.

meanings: Dadu, capital of China during the Yuan Dynasty (1280-1368), modern day Beijing

example.zh: 来这里旅游的大都是年轻人。
example.en: Most of the people who travel here are young.

example.zh: 写论文之前，要先查阅大量相关文献。
example.en: Before writing a thesis, you must first consult a lot of relevant literature.

example.zh: 老师夸奖他作业写得认真，让大家向他学习。
example.en: The teacher praised him for doing his homework carefully and told everyone to learn from him.

example.zh: 人行道上的盲道是专门为盲人设计的。
example.en: The tactile paving on the sidewalk is designed especially for blind people.

example.zh: 南方的春天很潮湿，衣服很难晒干。
example.en: Spring in the south is very damp, so clothes are hard to dry.

gloss: to explain, to give a guided commentary

example.zh: 导游一边走一边给我们讲解这座古城的历史。
example.en: As we walked, the guide explained the history of the ancient city to us.

example.zh: 这个冰箱的容量比较大，适合一家五口用。
example.en: This fridge has a fairly large capacity, suitable for a family of five.

example.zh: 这套教材是由几位资深老师共同编写的。
example.en: This set of textbooks was written jointly by several experienced teachers.

example.zh: 早饭我吃了两根香肠和一个鸡蛋。
example.en: For breakfast I had two sausages and an egg.

gloss: to draw a prize, to enter a lucky draw; lucky draw

example.zh: 年会上公司举办了抽奖活动，一等奖是一台电脑。
example.en: The company held a lucky draw at the annual party; the first prize was a computer.

gloss: to admit a mistake, to apologize

example.zh: 孩子做错了事，主动向妈妈认错。
example.en: The child did something wrong and owned up to his mother of his own accord.

gloss: to teach; to pass on (knowledge, skills); to impart
meanings: to impart; to pass on; to teach

example.zh: 老师傅把手艺传授给了年轻人。
example.en: The old master passed his craft on to the young people.

example.zh: 事故发生后，伤员被迅速送往附近的医院。
example.en: After the accident, the injured were rushed to a nearby hospital.

example.zh: 这个地区的降雨分布很不均匀。
example.en: Rainfall in this region is very unevenly distributed.

gloss: origin; to originate; to come from

example.zh: 你知道这个节日的起源吗？
example.en: Do you know the origin of this festival?

example.zh: 停电了，他用火柴点了一根蜡烛。
example.en: The power went out, so he lit a candle with a match.

gloss: to go bankrupt; to close down

example.zh: 由于经营不善，这家工厂倒闭了。
example.en: Due to poor management, the factory closed down.

example.zh: 这对耳环是妈妈送给我的生日礼物。
example.en: This pair of earrings was a birthday present from my mom.

example.zh: 这座桥非常坚固，已经用了一百年了。
example.en: This bridge is very sturdy; it has been in use for a hundred years.

gloss: to rise, to spring up, to become popular

example.zh: 最近几年，城市里兴起了一股露营热。
example.en: In recent years, a camping craze has sprung up in the cities.

gloss: to last (for a period); to be scheduled for

example.zh: 这次培训为期两周，下周一开始。
example.en: This training lasts two weeks and starts next Monday.

example.zh: 多亏你帮忙，我们才按时完成了工作。
example.en: Thanks to your help, we finished the work on time.

example.zh: 这些旧报纸还有用处，先别扔。
example.en: These old newspapers can still be used; don't throw them away yet.

example.zh: 这片海域风浪很大，渔船很少到这里来。
example.en: The waves in these waters are rough, and fishing boats seldom come here.

gloss: to convey, to transport, to deliver (via pipes etc.); to supply

example.zh: 这条管道每天向城市输送大量天然气。
example.en: This pipeline delivers large amounts of natural gas to the city every day.

example.zh: 这种茶有帮助消化的功效。
example.en: This tea has the effect of aiding digestion.

example.zh: 老师要求我们明天做一个口头报告。
example.en: The teacher asked us to give an oral report tomorrow.

gloss: to attend school, to study at (a school)

example.zh: 他目前在北京大学就读，学的是法律。
example.en: He is currently studying law at Peking University.

gloss: to have the courage to; to dare to

example.zh: 我们要勇于承认自己的错误。
example.en: We should have the courage to admit our mistakes.

gloss: day and night; around the clock

example.zh: 为了按时完成工程，工人们日夜不停地施工。
example.en: To finish the project on time, the workers kept working day and night.

gloss: to reflect on; to introspect; reflection

example.zh: 考试失败后，他认真反思了自己的学习方法。
example.en: After failing the exam, he seriously reflected on his study methods.

example.zh: 麦克风好像坏了，后面的人听不清楚。
example.en: The microphone seems to be broken; people at the back can't hear clearly.

example.zh: 这座寺庙建于公元七世纪。
example.en: This temple was built in the 7th century AD.

gloss: flow volume; traffic (of people or vehicles); mobile data
indonesian: volume aliran; arus (orang atau kendaraan); kuota data internet
meanings: flow rate; throughput of passengers; volume of traffic
data traffic; network traffic; website traffic; mobile data

example.zh: 这个月的手机流量快用完了，我只能连无线网看视频。
example.en: My phone data for this month is almost used up, so I can only watch videos on Wi-Fi.

gloss: manufacturer; firm, vendor (company making or selling goods)
indonesian: produsen; perusahaan pembuat atau penjual barang

example.zh: 多家手机厂商在展会上发布了最新产品。
example.en: Several phone makers launched their latest products at the trade show.

example.zh: 刚到高原的人容易出现头疼、呼吸困难等反应。
example.en: People who have just arrived on the plateau often get headaches and have trouble breathing.

gloss: set meal, combo; package (of services, e.g. a phone plan)
indonesian: paket makanan; paket (layanan, mis. paket ponsel)
meanings: (fig.) product or service package (e.g. for a cell phone subscription)

example.zh: 这家快餐店的午餐套餐包括一个汉堡、一份薯条和一杯饮料。
example.en: This fast-food restaurant's lunch combo includes a burger, fries and a drink.

example.zh: 从这张图表可以看出，今年的销售额明显上升了。
example.en: You can see from this chart that sales have clearly gone up this year.

gloss: to assess; to examine; to check (performance); appraisal

example.zh: 新员工要经过三个月的考核才能转正。
example.en: New employees have to pass a three-month assessment before becoming permanent.

example.zh: 天气太热了，我一点儿食欲也没有。
example.en: It's so hot that I have no appetite at all.

gloss: wind and rain; trials and hardships
indonesian: angin dan hujan; cobaan dan kesulitan hidup

example.zh: 外面风雨交加，我们还是改天再去吧。
example.en: It's windy and pouring outside; let's go another day.

example.zh: 景德镇的瓷器在世界上非常有名。
example.en: Porcelain from Jingdezhen is famous all over the world.

gloss: in the future, later on, some day

example.zh: 这些资料你先留着，日后说不定用得上。
example.en: Hold on to these materials for now; you may need them later.

example.zh: 加油站附近严禁吸烟。
example.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited near petrol stations.

example.zh: 随着人口老龄化，一些地区开始出现劳动力短缺。
example.en: As the population ages, some regions are starting to face labor shortages.

example.zh: 这个概念太抽象了，你能举个例子吗？
example.en: This concept is too abstract; could you give an example?

gloss: to adopt; to accept (a suggestion, plan)

example.zh: 经理采纳了我的建议。
example.en: The manager adopted my suggestion.

gloss: to divide up the work; division of labor

example.zh: 我们四个人分工合作，一个下午就把活儿干完了。
example.en: The four of us split up the work and got it all done in one afternoon.

gloss: to be the first to; to take the lead in (doing something)

example.zh: 这家公司率先推出了折叠屏手机。
example.en: This company was the first to launch a foldable-screen phone.

gloss: to go through, to undergo (over a long time)

example.zh: 这座古桥历经数百年风雨，至今依然坚固。
example.en: This ancient bridge has stood through centuries of wind and rain and is still solid today.

gloss: to oppose; to be opposed; opposite

example.zh: 他们的观点完全对立，谁也说服不了谁。
example.en: Their views are completely opposed; neither can convince the other.

example.zh: 他从小就喜欢看科幻小说，梦想有一天能飞向太空。
example.en: He has loved sci-fi novels since he was little and dreams of flying into space one day.

gloss: manufacturer; factory (as the maker of a product)
meanings: (coll.) a factory owner; the factory management

example.zh: 这批产品质量有问题，厂家已经决定全部召回。
example.en: This batch of products has quality problems, and the manufacturer has decided to recall all of it.

meanings: to commit suicide by jumping into water
(fig.) (of stock prices etc) to fall dramatically

example.zh: 中国跳水队在这次比赛中获得了好几枚金牌。
example.en: The Chinese diving team won several gold medals at this competition.

gloss: to carry out, to implement, to promote (a policy or practice)

example.zh: 学校推行垃圾分类以后，校园变得干净多了。
example.en: Since the school introduced garbage sorting, the campus has become much cleaner.

example.zh: 主持人拿起话筒，向大家问好。
example.en: The host picked up the microphone and greeted everyone.

example.zh: 我等了你一个多钟头，你怎么才来？
example.en: I've been waiting for you for over an hour. Why are you only getting here now?

example.zh: 周末他常和朋友去俱乐部打台球。
example.en: On weekends he often goes to the club to play pool with friends.

gloss: to help each other; mutual aid
meanings: Huzhu Tuzu autonomous county in Haidong prefecture 海东地区, Qinghai

example.zh: 这个小区的邻居们互助互爱，谁家有困难大家都会帮一把。
example.en: The neighbors in this community look out for each other; whenever a family has trouble, everyone lends a hand.

gloss: bumper harvest; to have a good harvest

example.zh: 今年雨水充足，粮食获得了丰收。
example.en: With plenty of rain this year, there was a bumper grain harvest.

example.zh: 他从小就喜欢田径运动，特别是短跑。
example.en: He has loved athletics since childhood, especially sprinting.

example.zh: 这本书写得很有趣味，孩子们都爱看。
example.en: This book is written in a fun way; the children all love it.

example.zh: 这本书的内容很枯燥，我看不下去。
example.en: This book is so dull that I can't keep reading it.

gloss: to explain orally, to narrate; to commentate
meanings: to explain (verbally); to give a running commentary

example.zh: 导游一边走一边为我们解说这座古城的历史。
example.en: As we walked, the guide explained the history of the old town to us.

gloss: in one breath; without a break, at one go
indonesian: dalam satu tarikan napas; tanpa berhenti, sekaligus

example.zh: 他一口气跑上了十楼，累得直喘气。
example.en: He ran up to the tenth floor without stopping and was left completely out of breath.

meanings: the first Chinese dialect dictionary, edited by Yang Xiong 扬雄 in 1st century, containing over 9000 characters

example.zh: 我听不懂这个地方的方言。
example.en: I can't understand the local dialect here.

gloss: to establish; to set up; to fix

example.zh: 上大学后，他确立了自己的人生目标。
example.en: After going to university, he established his goals in life.

example.zh: 每天都做同样的工作，生活太单调了。
example.en: Doing the same work every day makes life too monotonous.

gloss: to flood, to submerge; to drown

example.zh: 一场大雨过后，路边的农田都被淹了。
example.en: After a heavy rainstorm, the fields along the road were all flooded.

example.zh: 她以优异的成绩考上了名牌大学。
example.en: She got into a top university with outstanding results.

example.zh: 他们家的媳妇又能干又孝顺。
example.en: Their daughter-in-law is both capable and dutiful.

meanings: the North Pole; the Arctic Pole

example.zh: 北极熊生活在寒冷的北极地区。
example.en: Polar bears live in the cold Arctic region.

example.zh: 今年的国际博览会吸引了很多游客。
example.en: This year's international expo attracted many visitors.

example.zh: 孩子发烧了，我们赶紧带他去医院儿科看病。
example.en: Our child had a fever, so we hurried him to the hospital's pediatrics department.

gloss: to go bad; to deteriorate; to spoil
meanings: (of food) to go bad; to go off

example.zh: 天气太热，牛奶很容易变质。
example.en: When it's very hot, milk goes bad easily.

example.zh: 请不要把贵重物品放在车里。
example.en: Please don't leave valuables in the car.

gloss: pleasant to listen to, melodious; (of words) persuasive

example.zh: 她的歌声非常动听，让人百听不厌。
example.en: Her singing is so lovely that you never get tired of hearing it.

example.zh: 植物吸收二氧化碳，释放氧气。
example.en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.

example.zh: 她急切地想知道考试的结果。
example.en: She was anxious to know her exam results.

meanings: Changshou suburban district of Chongqing municipality, formerly in Sichuan

example.zh: 祝您老人家健康长寿，生日快乐！
example.en: Happy birthday! Wishing you good health and a long life.

example.zh: 雪地上留下了一串小狗的脚印。
example.en: A trail of puppy footprints was left in the snow.

gloss: to flow into; to pour into (of money, people)

example.zh: 这条河自西向东，最后流入大海。
example.en: This river runs from west to east and finally flows into the sea.

example.zh: 他太小气了，从来不请朋友吃饭。
example.en: He's so stingy that he never treats his friends to a meal.

gloss: one after another; in succession; in a row

example.zh: 他接连三天都没来上班。
example.en: He hasn't come to work for three days in a row.

gloss: and then; further; going a step further

example.zh: 先学好基础知识，进而提高实际能力。
example.en: First master the basics, and then improve your practical skills.

example.zh: 政府简化了办理签证的手续。
example.en: The government has simplified the visa application procedures.

example.zh: 做生意一定要讲诚信，不能欺骗顾客。
example.en: In business you must be honest and never cheat your customers.

example.zh: 妈妈做的饭菜非常可口。
example.en: The food Mum makes is very tasty.

example.zh: 经过再三考虑，他决定接受这份工作。
example.en: After thinking it over again and again, he decided to accept the job.

gloss: sea surface, surface of the sea

example.zh: 太阳慢慢从海面上升起来了。
example.en: The sun slowly rose from the surface of the sea.

example.zh: 等了一个多小时，他开始有点儿不耐烦了。
example.en: After waiting more than an hour, he began to get a bit impatient.

example.zh: 中国队在本届奥运会上一共获得了八十多枚奖牌。
example.en: The Chinese team won more than eighty medals in total at this Olympics.

meanings: square (as in square foot, square mile, square root)

example.zh: 这套房子的面积是九十平方米。
example.en: This flat has an area of ninety square metres.

example.zh: 工地的噪声太大了，晚上根本睡不着。
example.en: The noise from the construction site is so loud that I can't sleep at night.

example.zh: 你的话费余额不足，请及时充值。
example.en: Your phone credit balance is low; please top up soon.

gloss: altitude; elevation; height above sea level
indonesian: ketinggian di atas permukaan laut; elevasi

example.zh: 这座山海拔三千多米，山顶常年积雪。
example.en: This mountain is over 3,000 metres high, and its peak is snow-covered all year.

indonesian: di depan; di dekat; di sisi
meanings: (of children, parents etc) at one's side

example.zh: 孩子们都围在奶奶跟前听她讲故事。
example.en: The children gathered around Grandma to hear her stories.

example.zh: 他一边找钥匙，一边自言自语：“到底放哪儿了？”
example.en: While looking for his keys, he muttered to himself, "Where on earth did I put them?"

example.zh: 山坡上开满了五颜六色的野花。
example.en: The hillside is covered in colorful wildflowers.

gloss: to be absorbed only in; to care only about
meanings: to look after only one aspect

example.zh: 他只顾着玩手机，连饭都忘了吃。
example.en: He was so absorbed in his phone that he even forgot to eat.

example.zh: 这场自然灾害给当地造成了很大的损失。
example.en: This natural disaster caused heavy losses to the area.

example.zh: 暑假时，孩子们参加了一个英语夏令营。
example.en: During the summer holiday, the children went to an English summer camp.

example.zh: 今年这个地区发生了严重的干旱。
example.en: This region suffered a severe drought this year.

gloss: to set a price; fixed or list price

example.zh: 这本书定价五十元，网上买可以打八折。
example.en: This book is priced at fifty yuan, but you can get it 20% off online.

example.zh: 这种石头非常坚硬，很难切开。
example.en: This kind of stone is very hard and difficult to cut.

example.zh: 你发烧咳嗽，应该去看内科。
example.en: You have a fever and a cough, so you should see an internal medicine doctor.

example.zh: 这位老艺人的剪纸技艺是祖上传下来的，已经传了五代。
example.en: This old artist's paper-cutting craft was handed down from his ancestors and has passed through five generations.

gloss: specialized field (of study or medicine); specialty; junior college
indonesian: bidang spesialis; spesialisasi; sekolah tinggi diploma

example.zh: 她高中毕业后考上了一所医学专科学校。
example.en: After high school she got into a medical college.

gloss: literature and art; the arts; artsy
indonesian: sastra dan seni; kesenian; berjiwa seni

example.zh: 学校每年都会举办文艺晚会。
example.en: The school holds an arts evening every year.

example.zh: 本店所有商品一律打八折。
example.en: Every item in this store is 20% off, without exception.

example.zh: 这座建筑的设计左右对称，非常美观。
example.en: The building is symmetrical left and right and very attractive.

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，大家顿时欢呼起来。
example.en: On hearing the good news, everyone immediately cheered.

example.zh: 下班高峰过后，这条路就畅通了。
example.en: After the evening rush hour, this road is clear.

gloss: up to (a time); as of; by

example.zh: 截至昨天，报名人数已经超过五百人。
example.en: As of yesterday, the number of applicants had exceeded five hundred.

example.zh: 公安机关已经对这起案件立案调查。
example.en: The public security authorities have opened an investigation into the case.

example.zh: 在所有考试科目中，我最擅长数学。
example.en: Of all the exam subjects, I'm best at maths.

example.zh: 这位医生的医术十分高超。
example.en: This doctor's medical skill is superb.

gloss: to enroll new students, to recruit students

example.zh: 这所大学今年计划招生五千人。
example.en: This university plans to admit five thousand students this year.

gloss: to go on a trip, to go traveling

example.zh: 国庆长假期间，全国出游人数超过了四亿。
example.en: During the National Day holiday, more than 400 million people across the country went on trips.

gloss: to love dearly; to feel sorry for; to be distressed (by a loss)
indonesian: sayang; merasa kasihan; merasa sayang (atas kerugian)

example.zh: 看到孩子累成这样，妈妈很心疼。
example.en: Seeing her child so exhausted, the mother felt heartbroken.

gloss: to intensify; to aggravate; to exacerbate

example.zh: 行业之间的竞争正在不断加剧。
example.en: Competition within the industry is constantly intensifying.

example.zh: 适度运动对身体有好处，但不要过量。
example.en: Moderate exercise is good for you, but don't overdo it.

indonesian: orang yang lebih tua; generasi tua

example.zh: 过年的时候，我们要给长辈拜年。
example.en: At Chinese New Year, we pay New Year visits to our elders.

gloss: to set a time (for); at fixed times, regularly; timer
indonesian: mengatur waktu; pada waktu yang tetap, teratur; pengatur waktu

example.zh: 医生让他每天定时吃药，不能随便停。
example.en: The doctor told him to take his medicine at set times every day and not to stop on his own.

gloss: to reduce pressure; to relieve stress

example.zh: 听音乐是一种很好的减压方式。
example.en: Listening to music is a great way to relieve stress.

example.zh: 请查看邮件里的附件。
example.en: Please see the attachment in the email.

example.zh: 科学家在这里发现了恐龙化石。
example.en: Scientists found dinosaur fossils here.

gloss: to get started, to learn the basics; introduction, primer
indonesian: mulai belajar dasar-dasar; pengantar, tingkat pemula
meanings: to learn the basics of a subject

example.zh: 这本书是编程入门的好教材，很适合初学者。
example.en: This book is a good introduction to programming and well suited to beginners.

example.zh: 这个孩子很淘气，总是把玩具扔得到处都是。
example.en: This child is very naughty and always throws toys everywhere.

example.zh: 近年来，中国的高铁事业飞速发展。
example.en: In recent years, China's high-speed rail has developed at a tremendous pace.

gloss: to press close to; to be close to (life, reality); intimate

example.zh: 这部电视剧很贴近生活，所以受到观众喜欢。
example.en: This TV series is very true to life, which is why audiences like it.

gloss: steady and sure; down-to-earth; free from anxiety; at ease
indonesian: tekun dan sungguh-sungguh; membumi; tenang hati

example.zh: 他工作很踏实，领导很放心。
example.en: He works steadily and reliably, so the boss trusts him.

example.zh: 王教授很有学问，大家都很尊敬他。
example.en: Professor Wang is very learned, and everyone respects him.

example.zh: 大伙儿一起努力，一定能按时完成。
example.en: If everybody works together, we'll definitely finish on time.

gloss: to dry in the air or sun; to ignore (someone)

example.zh: 天气好的时候，她喜欢把被子拿出去晾一晾。
example.en: When the weather is good, she likes to air the quilts outside.

gloss: brief introduction, synopsis, profile; to introduce briefly
indonesian: pengantar singkat, ringkasan, profil; memperkenalkan secara singkat

example.zh: 请在报名表上写一段个人简介，不超过两百字。
example.en: Please write a short personal profile on the application form, no more than two hundred characters.

example.zh: 医生说他的喉咙有炎症，需要吃几天消炎药。
example.en: The doctor said his throat was inflamed and he needed to take anti-inflammatory medicine for a few days.

gloss: rather than (… it would be better to …)
meanings: 与其 A 如 B (rather than A, better to B)

example.zh: 与其在家里等消息，不如自己去问问。
example.en: Rather than waiting at home for news, you'd better go and ask yourself.

gloss: to learn from; to draw on (others' experience); reference
indonesian: mengambil pelajaran dari; mencontoh; meniru (pengalaman orang lain)
meanings: to learn from (how others do things)
lesson to be learned (by observing others)

example.zh: 我们可以借鉴其他国家的成功经验。
example.en: We can draw on the successful experience of other countries.

example.zh: 这家工厂已经连续三年亏损了。
example.en: This factory has been losing money for three years in a row.

example.zh: 夏天这里非常炎热，最高温度超过四十度。
example.en: Summers here are scorching, with highs over forty degrees.

example.zh: 这些古建筑是前人留给后人的宝贵财富。
example.en: These ancient buildings are a precious legacy left by our ancestors to later generations.

gloss: to pass on, to forward (to someone else)
meanings: to carry and give to sb else

example.zh: 麻烦你把这封信转交给王老师。
example.en: Could you please pass this letter on to Mr. Wang?

example.zh: 考古学家在这里发现了一处五千年前的村落遗址。
example.en: Archaeologists found the site of a 5,000-year-old village here.

gloss: in the meantime, during that period; among them
indonesian: selama itu, di sela-sela waktu itu; di antaranya

example.zh: 他在国外生活了十年，其间换过好几份工作。
example.en: He lived abroad for ten years and changed jobs several times during that period.

example.zh: 冰是水在低温下的固体形态。
example.en: Ice is the solid form of water at low temperatures.

example.zh: 这家店的新款连衣裙今天开始打折。
example.en: This store's new-season dresses go on sale starting today.

gloss: inside and outside; domestic and foreign
indonesian: dalam dan luar; dalam dan luar negeri

example.zh: 车站内外挤满了回家过年的人。
example.en: Inside and outside the station, it was packed with people going home for the New Year.

example.zh: 大城市的房价太高，很多年轻人买不起房子。
example.en: Housing prices in big cities are so high that many young people can't afford a home.

meanings: to plant (maize etc) by sowing seed

example.zh: 春天是农民播种的季节。
example.en: Spring is the season when farmers sow seeds.

example.zh: 她穿了一件颜色鲜艳的裙子。
example.en: She was wearing a brightly coloured dress.

indonesian: surat kabar dan majalah, media cetak

example.zh: 图书馆的阅览室里有各种各样的报刊。
example.en: The library reading room has all kinds of newspapers and magazines.

gloss: to look down on; to despise

example.zh: 不要看不起任何人，每个人都有自己的长处。
example.en: Don't look down on anyone; everyone has their own strengths.

example.zh: 这本词典已经修订过三次了。
example.en: This dictionary has been revised three times.

example.zh: 他在马路边招手，拦下了一辆出租车。
example.en: He waved from the roadside and flagged down a taxi.

gloss: to have no choice but to, can only
meanings: to have no alternative but to; to be obliged to

example.zh: 末班车已经开走了，我们只得打车回家。
example.en: The last bus had already left, so we had no choice but to take a taxi home.

example.zh: 这家公司优化了网站设计，用户体验好多了。
example.en: The company optimized its website design, and the user experience is much better.

example.zh: 今年雨水充足，庄稼长得特别好。
example.en: There was plenty of rain this year, so the crops grew very well.

example.zh: 这个广告的创意非常新颖。
example.en: The idea behind this advert is very original.

gloss: to pass on and carry forward (a tradition); heritage

example.zh: 传统手艺需要年轻人来传承。
example.en: Traditional crafts need young people to carry them on.

example.zh: 现在很多教室都安装了多媒体设备。
example.en: Many classrooms now have multimedia equipment installed.

example.zh: 这篇稿子明天就要交，我今晚得加班改完。
example.en: This piece is due tomorrow, so I have to work late tonight to finish revising it.

example.zh: 爷爷每天下午都和邻居下象棋。
example.en: Every afternoon, Grandpa plays Chinese chess with the neighbour.

example.zh: 妈妈每天早上给孩子冲一瓶奶粉。
example.en: Every morning, Mom makes the baby a bottle of formula.

example.zh: 今天天气晴朗，适合出去爬山。
example.en: It's sunny today, good for going hiking.

example.zh: 这个行李箱的一个轮子坏了，拉起来很费劲。
example.en: One of this suitcase's wheels is broken, so it's hard to pull.

example.zh: 空闲的时候，我喜欢在家看书。
example.en: In my free time, I like reading at home.

example.zh: 您老人家今年多大岁数了？身体还这么硬朗！
example.en: How old are you this year, sir? You're still in such good shape!

example.zh: 周末我们开车去郊外野餐吧。
example.en: Let's drive out to the countryside for a picnic this weekend.

example.zh: 南方的空气湿度大，衣服很难晾干。
example.en: The air in the south is so humid that clothes take forever to dry.

example.zh: 今年冬天比往年冷得多，河面都结冰了。
example.en: This winter is much colder than in previous years; even the river has frozen over.

example.zh: 这种节能灯比普通灯泡省电多了。
example.en: This energy-saving lamp uses much less electricity than an ordinary bulb.

example.zh: 地铁开通以后，市民出行变得更加便捷了。
example.en: Since the subway opened, getting around the city has become much more convenient.

example.zh: 中国人民一向勤劳勇敢。
example.en: The Chinese people have always been hardworking and brave.

example.zh: 我们计划在十月中旬出发去旅游。
example.en: We plan to set off on our trip in mid-October.

gloss: to employ people, to choose and use staff
indonesian: mempekerjakan orang, memilih dan menggunakan tenaga kerja
meanings: to employ sb for a job
to be in need of staff

example.zh: 这家公司用人只看能力，不看学历。
example.en: When hiring, this company looks only at ability, not at degrees.

example.zh: 这种面包口感很软，孩子们都爱吃。
example.en: This bread is soft to the bite, and kids love it.

example.zh: 他家里条件不好，十五岁就不念书了，出去打工。
example.en: His family was poor, so he left school at fifteen to go out and work.

gloss: to recruit; to take in; to enrol

example.zh: 这所大学今年计划招收三千名新生。
example.en: This university plans to admit 3,000 new students this year.

gloss: science (as a school track or subjects); the sciences
meanings: the sciences (as opposed to the humanities 科)

example.zh: 他理科成绩很好，尤其是数学和物理。
example.en: He does very well in the science subjects, especially math and physics.

example.zh: 把箱子用胶带封好，再写上地址。
example.en: Seal the box with tape and then write the address on it.

example.zh: 他们家的房子有一百二十平方米。
example.en: Their apartment is 120 square meters.

example.zh: 图书馆的书按类别摆放，找起来很方便。
example.en: The library's books are shelved by category, so they're easy to find.

gloss: to emerge in large numbers; to spring up; to come to the fore

example.zh: 近几年涌现出了许多优秀的年轻作家。
example.en: In recent years many outstanding young writers have emerged.

gloss: to connect to the internet or a network; to be online
indonesian: terhubung ke internet atau jaringan; daring
meanings: to connect (or be connected) to a network; to network

example.zh: 这款游戏必须联网才能玩，没有网络就打不开。
example.en: This game has to be online to play; without a connection it won't even open.

example.zh: 每天有十几班客车从县城开往省城。
example.en: More than a dozen buses run from the county town to the provincial capital every day.

example.zh: 中秋节是家人团圆的日子。
example.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for family reunion.

meanings: (fig.) a pawn (used by others for their own purposes)

example.zh: 下完棋后，请把棋子收回盒子里。
example.en: After the game, please put the pieces back in the box.

example.zh: 在中国人眼里，红色是吉祥的颜色。
example.en: In the eyes of Chinese people, red is an auspicious colour.

gloss: to look for a job, to apply for jobs

example.zh: 毕业季到了，很多大学生忙着求职。
example.en: Graduation season is here, and many college students are busy job hunting.

example.zh: 他正为找工作的事发愁呢。
example.en: He's worrying about finding a job.

example.zh: 我很喜欢读朱自清的散文。
example.en: I really like reading Zhu Ziqing's essays.

example.zh: 他最喜欢听相声，常常笑得停不下来。
example.en: He loves listening to crosstalk and often can't stop laughing.

example.zh: 她虽然很有钱，但穿着十分朴素。
example.en: Although she is rich, she dresses very plainly.

example.zh: 升国旗的时候，全体师生一起唱国歌。
example.en: During the flag-raising ceremony, all the teachers and students sang the national anthem together.

gloss: to reverse (a vehicle), to back up

example.zh: 倒车的时候要注意看后视镜。
example.en: Keep an eye on the mirrors when you're reversing.

gloss: to prevent and cure; prevention and treatment
indonesian: mencegah dan mengobati; pencegahan dan pengobatan

example.zh: 医院开展了感冒防治的宣传活动。
example.en: The hospital launched a campaign on preventing and treating colds.

gloss: wind force, wind strength; wind power

example.zh: 预计明天风力将达到六到七级。
example.en: Winds tomorrow are expected to reach force six to seven.

example.zh: 音乐会上，乐队演奏了几首著名的乐曲。
example.en: At the concert, the orchestra played several famous pieces.

example.zh: 你这样看问题太片面了。
example.en: Looking at the problem this way is too one-sided.

gloss: light (not greasy or salty); mild; bland
meanings: light (of food, not greasy or strongly flavored)

example.zh: 生病的时候最好吃点儿清淡的东西。
example.en: When you're ill, it's best to eat something light.

example.zh: 婚宴的酒水由我们自己准备。
example.en: We're providing the drinks for the wedding banquet ourselves.

meanings: Xinxing county in Yunfu 云浮, Guangdong
Xinxing or Hsinhsing district of Kaohsiung city 市, south Taiwan
(of markets, industries, infectious diseases etc) rising

example.zh: 人工智能是一个新兴产业，发展前景很好。
example.en: Artificial intelligence is an emerging industry with excellent prospects.

example.zh: 过年的时候，家家户户都挂起了红灯笼。
example.en: At New Year, every household hangs up red lanterns.

example.zh: 他的伤口发炎了，得马上去医院。
example.en: His wound got inflamed; he has to go to hospital right away.

example.zh: 地震发生后，灾区最缺的是食物和饮用水。
example.en: After the earthquake, what the disaster area needed most was food and drinking water.

example.zh: 公司年终给每位员工发了一笔奖金。
example.en: At the end of the year, the company gave every employee a bonus.

gloss: to remit money, to transfer money; remittance

example.zh: 他每个月都给老家的父母汇款。
example.en: Every month he sends money to his parents back home.

example.zh: 很多农民通过网络直播销售自家的农产品。
example.en: Many farmers sell their own produce through online livestreams.

gloss: good value; affordable; practical; material benefit

example.zh: 这家餐厅的菜又好吃又实惠。
example.en: The food at this restaurant is both tasty and good value.

example.zh: 我们坐轮船去了对面的岛上。
example.en: We took a steamer to the island across the water.

example.zh: 祝你在新的工作中一帆风顺！
example.en: I wish you smooth sailing in your new job!

gloss: to do business; to be in trade

example.zh: 他大学毕业后就开始经商了。
example.en: He went into business right after graduating from university.

meanings: to have a strong interest in

example.zh: 他对中国历史有浓厚的兴趣。
example.en: He has a strong interest in Chinese history.

example.zh: 这支钢笔是爷爷送给我的生日礼物。
example.en: This fountain pen was a birthday present from my grandpa.

example.zh: 现在国产手机的质量越来越好了。
example.en: Domestically made phones keep getting better.

example.zh: 热水器坏了，今天只能洗冷水澡了。
example.en: The water heater is broken, so I'll have to take a cold shower today.

gloss: all year round; for many years

example.zh: 这座山的山顶常年积雪，盛夏也不融化。
example.en: The summit of this mountain is snow-capped all year round; the snow doesn't melt even in midsummer.

example.zh: 远处的山峰被白云遮住了，只露出一个尖顶。
example.en: The distant peak was hidden by white clouds, with only its tip showing.

example.zh: 这次改革涉及社会的方方面面。
example.en: This reform touches every aspect of society.

example.zh: 每天坚持散步对健康大有益处。
example.en: Walking every day is very good for your health.

gloss: to put in effort, to work hard at

example.zh: 要想学好汉语，就得在听说上多下功夫。
example.en: If you want to learn Chinese well, you need to put a lot of effort into listening and speaking.

example.zh: 这首民歌在当地流传了几百年。
example.en: This folk song has been passed down locally for hundreds of years.

example.zh: 他从小就对天文非常感兴趣。
example.en: He has been very interested in astronomy since childhood.

example.zh: 这位科学家经常在网上做科普，深受年轻人喜欢。
example.en: This scientist often explains science online and is very popular with young people.

example.zh: 老师让我们大声朗读课文。
example.en: The teacher had us read the text aloud.

example.zh: 秋天到了，公园里落叶遍地，踩上去沙沙响。
example.en: Autumn has come; fallen leaves cover the park and rustle underfoot.

example.zh: 这家电视台有一个专门的少儿频道。
example.en: This TV station has a dedicated children's channel.

meanings: road condition(s) (e.g. surface, traffic flow etc)

example.zh: 出发前最好先在手机上查一下路况。
example.en: It's best to check traffic conditions on your phone before setting off.

example.zh: 这条路禁止机动车通行，只能步行或骑自行车。
example.en: Motor vehicles are banned on this road; you can only walk or cycle.

meanings: the seven cervical vertebrae in the neck of humans and most mammals

example.zh: 长时间低头看手机对颈椎不好。
example.en: Looking down at your phone for a long time is bad for your neck.

example.zh: 由于原材料涨价，这家工厂的产品也跟着涨价了。
example.en: Because raw materials went up in price, this factory's products got more expensive too.

example.zh: 用胶水把这两张纸粘在一起。
example.en: Stick these two sheets of paper together with glue.

gloss: to work in (a profession or trade)

example.zh: 他在金融行业从业二十多年，经验非常丰富。
example.en: He has worked in finance for over twenty years and is very experienced.

example.zh: 他学习非常用功，每天都学到很晚。
example.en: He studies very hard and stays up late studying every day.

gloss: aesthetic; aesthetic sense; appreciation of beauty

example.zh: 每个人的审美标准都不一样。
example.en: Everyone's aesthetic standards are different.

gloss: to total, to add up to; in total

example.zh: 这次活动总计有三千多人参加。
example.en: In total, more than three thousand people took part in the event.

example.zh: 这座体育场规模宏大，可以容纳十万名观众。
example.en: This stadium is enormous and can seat a hundred thousand spectators.

gloss: to total; to add up to; in total

example.zh: 这次活动共计花费两万元。
example.en: This event cost a total of twenty thousand yuan.

example.zh: 梅花在寒冷的冬天开放，象征着坚强。
example.en: Plum blossoms bloom in the cold of winter and symbolize resilience.

example.zh: 苏州的园林在世界上很有名。
example.en: The gardens of Suzhou are world-famous.

example.zh: 他从小就近视，一直戴着眼镜。
example.en: He has been nearsighted since childhood and has always worn glasses.

gloss: attractive; pleasing to the eye; good-looking

example.zh: 这款家具既美观又实用。
example.en: This furniture is both attractive and practical.

example.zh: 地震发生后，全国各地的救援物资源源不断地运往灾区。
example.en: After the earthquake, relief supplies poured into the disaster area from all over the country.

gloss: notice; announcement (posted or in a newspaper)
meanings: announcement (written, on billboard, letter, newspaper or website)

example.zh: 他在报纸上登了一则寻物启事。
example.en: He placed a lost-property notice in the newspaper.

example.zh: 他做事太马虎，作业里总有错别字。
example.en: He's so careless that his homework is always full of wrong characters.

example.zh: 汉语里一个汉字一般代表一个音节。
example.en: In Chinese, one character usually stands for one syllable.

example.zh: 车门打开后，乘客们排着队有序地上了车。
example.en: When the doors opened, the passengers lined up and boarded in an orderly way.

gloss: equal; to be equal to; equivalent

example.zh: 这两个房间的面积大致相等。
example.en: The two rooms are roughly equal in area.

example.zh: 服务业在经济中所占的比重越来越大。
example.en: The service sector accounts for an ever larger share of the economy.

gloss: to be hit by a disaster
meanings: to be hit by a natural calamity

example.zh: 这次洪水使十几个县受灾，上万人无家可归。
example.en: The flood hit more than a dozen counties and left tens of thousands of people homeless.

example.zh: 一次失败不算什么，千万别灰心。
example.en: One failure is nothing; whatever you do, don't lose heart.

example.zh: 这家餐厅人均消费大约一百元。
example.en: This restaurant costs about a hundred yuan per person.

gloss: to turn (a corner); to make a turn

example.zh: 到了前面的路口往右拐弯，就是邮局。
example.en: Turn right at the next junction and you'll find the post office.

example.zh: 她在女子一百米比赛中获得了银牌。
example.en: She won the silver medal in the women's 100 meters.

gloss: nursing home, home for the elderly

example.zh: 周末，志愿者们到养老院陪老人聊天。
example.en: On weekends, volunteers go to the nursing home to chat with the elderly residents.

indonesian: sangat dingin; dingin yang menggigit; musim dingin yang parah

example.zh: 冬天这里非常严寒，气温常常在零下二十度。
example.en: Winters here are bitterly cold, often twenty degrees below zero.

gloss: historic site, place of historic interest

example.zh: 西安有很多名胜古迹，每年吸引大量游客。
example.en: Xi'an has many famous historic sites that attract huge numbers of tourists every year.

gloss: to check in (luggage); to consign for shipment

example.zh: 这个箱子太大，必须托运。
example.en: This suitcase is too big; it has to be checked in.

example.zh: 这节课的难点是如何区分这两个语法点。
example.en: The hard part of this lesson is telling these two grammar points apart.

example.zh: 买水果的时候，我会注意看一下产地。
example.en: When I buy fruit, I check where it was grown.

gloss: to take extra lessons, to have tutoring (outside regular school)
meanings: to take extra lessons in a cram school or with a private tutor

example.zh: 他数学成绩不好，周末要去补习班补习。
example.en: His math grades are poor, so he goes to a cram school for extra lessons on weekends.

example.zh: 大熊猫是中国的国宝，深受世界各地人们的喜爱。
example.en: The giant panda is China's national treasure and is loved by people all over the world.

gloss: to discuss and study, to deliberate (in depth)

example.zh: 来自各国的专家聚在一起研讨环境保护问题。
example.en: Experts from many countries gathered to discuss environmental protection.

gloss: both banks (of a river); both sides (of a strait)

example.zh: 河的两岸种满了柳树，春天的时候特别美。
example.en: Willows line both banks of the river, and it's especially beautiful in spring.

gloss: to make up a missed lesson; to give or take make-up classes
indonesian: mengganti pelajaran yang tertinggal; kelas tambahan

example.zh: 他生病请了一周假，老师抽时间给他补课。
example.en: He was off sick for a week, so the teacher found time to help him catch up on the lessons.

gloss: to guarantee free repair; to be under warranty
meanings: to promise to keep sth in good repair

example.zh: 这台电脑保修三年，坏了可以免费修。
example.en: This computer has a three-year warranty, so it can be repaired for free if it breaks.

example.zh: 我姐姐下个月结婚，家里要办喜事了。
example.en: My older sister is getting married next month, so there's a happy celebration coming up in our family.

example.zh: 我一坐长途汽车就晕车，所以每次都提前吃药。
example.en: I get carsick whenever I take a long-distance bus, so I always take medicine beforehand.

indonesian: beberapa hari yang lalu, baru-baru ini

example.zh: 日前，市政府公布了新的交通管理办法。
example.en: A few days ago, the city government announced new traffic management rules.

gloss: according to legend; to hand down (from one to another)

example.zh: 相传这座桥是一位神仙一夜之间造好的。
example.en: Legend has it that this bridge was built overnight by an immortal.

example.zh: 你知道端午节吃粽子这个习俗的由来吗？
example.en: Do you know the origin of the custom of eating zongzi at the Dragon Boat Festival?

example.zh: 他的母语是印尼语，但汉语说得也很好。
example.en: His mother tongue is Indonesian, but he speaks Chinese very well too.

example.zh: 楼道里的灯坏了，晚上上楼要小心。
example.en: The light in the stairwell is broken, so be careful going upstairs at night.

gloss: to make green (by planting trees and grass); greening

example.zh: 这几年城市绿化做得很好，到处都是绿树和草地。
example.en: The city's greening efforts have gone well these past few years; there are trees and lawns everywhere.

meanings: right and wrong; good and bad; merits and demerits

example.zh: 这条裤子长短正合适，就是腰有点儿肥。
example.en: These trousers are just the right length, but they're a bit loose at the waist.

meanings: piece of writing submitted for publication

example.zh: 编辑部每天都会收到大量稿件。
example.en: The editorial office receives a large number of manuscripts every day.

gloss: tone (of a Chinese syllable); tone of voice

example.zh: 很多外国人觉得汉语的声调特别难。
example.en: Many foreigners find Chinese tones especially difficult.

gloss: to take part in an exhibition
meanings: to exhibit at or take part in a trade show etc

example.zh: 今年有三百多家企业参展，比去年多了一倍。
example.en: More than three hundred companies are exhibiting this year, twice as many as last year.

example.zh: 这张纸的厚度大约是零点一毫米。
example.en: This sheet of paper is about 0.1 millimetres thick.

gloss: daily family life; home-style (food); small talk about home
indonesian: kehidupan sehari-hari keluarga; masakan rumahan; obrolan santai
meanings: the daily life of a family

example.zh: 这家小饭馆的家常菜做得很地道。
example.en: This little restaurant's home-style dishes are very authentic.

example.zh: 人工智能正在改变我们的生活方式。
example.en: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we live.

gloss: national conditions, the situation of a country
meanings: the characteristics and circumstances particular to a country

example.zh: 每个国家都应该根据自己的国情选择发展道路。
example.en: Every country should choose its path of development based on its own national conditions.

meanings: item of stationery (pen, pencil, eraser, pencil sharpener etc)

example.zh: 开学前，妈妈给我买了很多新文具。
example.en: Before school started, Mum bought me lots of new stationery.

meanings: bronze plaque bearing a business name or logo etc

example.zh: 她在世界锦标赛上获得了一枚铜牌。
example.en: She won a bronze medal at the world championships.

example.zh: 春节期间，各地都会举行丰富多彩的民俗活动。
example.en: During the Spring Festival, all kinds of colorful folk events are held around the country.

meanings: Chinese set expression, typically of 4 characters, often alluding to a story or historical quotation

example.zh: 汉语里有很多成语都来自古代的故事。
example.en: Many Chinese idioms come from ancient stories.

example.zh: 政府出台了一系列措施来鼓励创业。
example.en: The government has introduced a series of measures to encourage entrepreneurship.

gloss: liberal arts, humanities (as a school track)

example.zh: 她对历史和文学很感兴趣，所以选了文科。
example.en: She's very interested in history and literature, so she chose the humanities track.

example.zh: 本想出去散步，不料下起了大雨。
example.en: I meant to go out for a walk, but unexpectedly it started pouring.

example.zh: 部队官兵连夜赶往灾区抗洪救灾。
example.en: Soldiers rushed overnight to the disaster area to fight the floods and help victims.

gloss: coastal; along the coast; coastal area

example.zh: 沿海城市的经济发展得比较快。
example.en: The economy of coastal cities has developed relatively quickly.

gloss: to go on to a higher school
indonesian: melanjutkan ke jenjang sekolah yang lebih tinggi
meanings: to enter the next grade school

example.zh: 现在的中学生升学压力很大。
example.en: Secondary school students today are under great pressure to get into the next level of school.

gloss: last ten days of a month, late in the month
indonesian: sepuluh hari terakhir bulan, akhir bulan

example.zh: 这次会议定在本月下旬召开。
example.en: The meeting is scheduled for the latter part of this month.

example.zh: 春天的西湖边游人如织，到处都是拍照的人。
example.en: In spring the shores of West Lake are thronged with visitors, with people taking photos everywhere.

gloss: to stick; to paste; to glue

example.zh: 请把照片粘贴在表格的右上角。
example.en: Please stick the photo in the top right corner of the form.

gloss: to trade stocks, to speculate in stocks

example.zh: 他炒股赔了不少钱，现在再也不敢碰股票了。
example.en: He lost a lot of money trading stocks and doesn't dare touch them anymore.

meanings: glutinous rice and choice of filling wrapped in leaves and steamed or boiled

example.zh: 端午节的时候，中国人有吃粽子的习俗。
example.en: At the Dragon Boat Festival, Chinese people traditionally eat zongzi.

gloss: to take as an elective; elective (course)
indonesian: mengambil mata kuliah pilihan; pilihan (mata kuliah)
meanings: (at a school) to take as an elective

example.zh: 这学期我选修了一门日语课。
example.en: This semester I took a Japanese class as an elective.

example.zh: 这瓶矿泉水是五百五十毫升的。
example.en: This bottle of mineral water holds 550 milliliters.

gloss: third place; second runner-up; bronze medallist

example.zh: 我们队在这次比赛中获得了季军。
example.en: Our team came third in this competition.

example.zh: 为了举办奥运会，这座城市新建了很多体育场馆。
example.en: To host the Olympics, the city built many new sports venues.

example.zh: 这里土地肥沃，适合种植水稻。
example.en: The land here is fertile and suitable for growing rice.

example.zh: 外面打雷了，快把窗户关上，要下大雨了。
example.en: It's thundering outside; shut the windows, quick, a downpour is coming.

indonesian: ramah kepada tamu; suka menjamu tamu

example.zh: 这里的人非常热情好客。
example.en: The people here are very warm and hospitable.

example.zh: 看到老人上车，他赶忙站起来让座。
example.en: When he saw an elderly person get on, he quickly stood up to offer his seat.

example.zh: 这个网页打不开，你换个浏览器试试。
example.en: This page won't open; try a different browser.

gloss: to pay a New Year call; to wish someone a happy New Year
indonesian: berkunjung saat Tahun Baru; mengucapkan selamat Tahun Baru
meanings: to pay a New Year call
to wish sb a Happy New Year

example.zh: 大年初一，我们去亲戚家拜年。
example.en: On the first day of the New Year, we visit relatives to wish them a happy New Year.

example.zh: 南方的很多地区适合种植水稻。
example.en: Many areas in the south are well suited to growing rice.

example.zh: 她身材高挑，大学时就开始当模特儿了。
example.en: She's tall and slender and started modeling while in college.

gloss: famous scenic spot, place of interest
meanings: a place famous for its scenery or historical relics

example.zh: 杭州有很多名胜，最有名的是西湖。
example.en: Hangzhou has many famous sights, the best known being West Lake.

gloss: with great difficulty; (finally) after much effort
indonesian: dengan susah payah; akhirnya (setelah berusaha keras)
meanings: to have a hard time (convincing sb, relinquishing sth etc)

example.zh: 我好容易才买到两张票，你可千万别迟到。
example.en: It was a real struggle to get two tickets, so whatever you do, don't be late.

gloss: working procedure, step in a production process

example.zh: 做一双手工皮鞋需要经过几十道工序。
example.en: Making a pair of handmade leather shoes takes dozens of steps.

example.zh: 今年夏天发生了严重的旱灾，庄稼几乎没有收成。
example.en: There was a severe drought this summer, and the crops yielded almost nothing.

indonesian: ribuan keluarga, rumah-rumah yang tak terhitung

example.zh: 如今，智能手机已经走进了千家万户。
example.en: Today, smartphones have made their way into countless homes.

example.zh: 这种牛奶在常温下可以保存六个月。
example.en: This milk keeps for six months at room temperature.

example.zh: 唐朝是中国历史上最繁荣的朝代之一。
example.en: The Tang was one of the most prosperous dynasties in Chinese history.

gloss: every household, each and every family

example.zh: 过年的时候，家家户户都贴春联、挂灯笼。
example.en: At New Year, every household puts up couplets and hangs lanterns.

indonesian: teknologi tinggi dan baru, teknologi canggih

example.zh: 这个开发区吸引了一大批高新技术企业。
example.en: This development zone has attracted a large number of high-tech companies.

example.zh: 北方冬天很冷，一定要带件羽绒服。
example.en: Winters in the north are cold, so be sure to bring a down jacket.

gloss: clothing, food, housing and transport; the basic necessities of life
indonesian: sandang, pangan, papan, dan transportasi; kebutuhan pokok hidup
meanings: clothing, food, housing and transport (idiom); people's basic needs

example.zh: 网络已经深入到人们衣食住行的各个方面。
example.en: The internet now reaches into every part of daily life: what people wear, eat, where they live and how they get around.

example.zh: 英语是大学一年级的必修课。
example.en: English is a required course in the first year of university.

gloss: first ten days of a month, early in the month
indonesian: sepuluh hari pertama bulan, awal bulan

example.zh: 新学期将于九月上旬开学，请同学们做好准备。
example.en: The new semester starts in early September; students, please get ready.

gloss: to think highly of, to respect

example.zh: 只要你努力工作，别人自然会看得起你。
example.en: As long as you work hard, people will naturally respect you.

example.zh: 京剧是中国最有代表性的戏曲之一。
example.en: Peking opera is one of the most representative forms of traditional Chinese opera.

example.zh: 这位作家的作品在海内外都很受欢迎。
example.en: This writer's works are popular both at home and abroad.

example.zh: 这座城市文化多元，生活着来自世界各地的人。
example.en: This city is culturally diverse, home to people from all over the world.

example.zh: 他勤奋好学，每天都是最后一个离开图书馆的。
example.en: He's hardworking and eager to learn, and he's the last to leave the library every day.

gloss: tangyuan (glutinous rice balls served in soup)
meanings: boiled or deep-fried balls of glutinous rice flour, usually eaten during Lantern Festival

example.zh: 元宵节的时候，南方人习惯吃汤圆。
example.en: At the Lantern Festival, people in the south usually eat tangyuan.

example.zh: 这个国家已经普及了初等教育。
example.en: This country has achieved universal primary education.

example.zh: 把米洗好放进电饭锅，半个小时饭就熟了。
example.en: Wash the rice and put it in the rice cooker; it'll be done in half an hour.

example.zh: 在拥挤的公交车上要小心小偷儿。
example.en: Watch out for pickpockets on crowded buses.

example.zh: 骑自行车上班是一种低碳的生活方式。
example.en: Cycling to work is a low-carbon way of living.

example.zh: 看电影的时候，他喜欢一边吃薯片一边喝可乐。
example.en: When watching movies, he likes to eat potato chips and drink cola.

indonesian: rasio harga dan kualitas, sepadan dengan harganya

example.zh: 这款手机价格不贵，性能也不错，性价比很高。
example.en: This phone isn't expensive and performs well; it's great value for money.

example.zh: 美国和加拿大都位于北美洲。
example.en: The United States and Canada are both in North America.

gloss: to double; to multiply, to increase greatly

example.zh: 这项新技术让工厂的产量倍增。
example.en: This new technology has doubled the factory's output.

example.zh: 考试期间，考场内不得使用手机等电子设备。
example.en: During the exam, phones and other electronic devices may not be used in the exam room.

gloss: material (an object is made of), texture

example.zh: 这件衬衫的材质是纯棉的，穿着很舒服。
example.en: This shirt is made of pure cotton and is very comfortable to wear.

example.zh: 床边有一个插座，可以给手机充电。
example.en: There's a socket by the bed for charging your phone.

example.zh: 这块地每年能产出两千斤粮食。
example.en: This plot of land can produce two thousand jin of grain a year.

gloss: number of shows or sessions; a screening or performance (time slot)
indonesian: jumlah pertunjukan; jadwal tayang atau sesi

example.zh: 这部电影很火，影院增加了放映场次。
example.en: This film is a big hit, so the cinema has added more screenings.

gloss: to withdraw, to retract; to recall (a message)

example.zh: 他发现消息发错了人，赶紧撤回了。
example.en: He realized he'd sent the message to the wrong person and quickly unsent it.

gloss: to exert oneself, to contribute effort

example.zh: 大家有钱的出钱，有力的出力，很快就把路修好了。
example.en: Those with money gave money and those with strength gave labor, and the road was soon repaired.

example.zh: 这个硬盘可以存储上万张照片。
example.en: This hard drive can store tens of thousands of photos.

gloss: to clock in; to check in (at a place, on social media)
indonesian: absen masuk (kerja); check-in (di suatu tempat, media sosial)

example.zh: 公司规定每天早上九点前必须打卡。
example.en: Company rules say you must clock in before nine every morning.

example.zh: 今年公司的利润大幅增长，员工们都拿到了奖金。
example.en: The company's profits rose sharply this year, and all the employees got a bonus.

example.zh: 澳大利亚是大洋洲面积最大的国家。
example.en: Australia is the largest country in Oceania.

gloss: to click; clicks, hits (on a website)

example.zh: 点击这个按钮，就可以下载文件了。
example.en: Click this button and you can download the file.

example.zh: 这条街上的店铺大多卖手工艺品。
example.en: Most of the shops on this street sell handicrafts.

example.zh: 这套西服是我在裁缝店定制的，特别合身。
example.en: I had this suit made to measure at a tailor's, and it fits perfectly.

example.zh: 很多年轻人是日本动漫的忠实粉丝。
example.en: Many young people are devoted fans of Japanese anime.

gloss: to dock; to link up, to coordinate (with)
indonesian: berlabuh (pesawat antariksa); menjalin kerja sama, menghubungkan

example.zh: 两艘飞船在太空中成功对接。
example.en: The two spacecraft successfully docked in space.

indonesian: serba bisa, berbakat di banyak bidang

example.zh: 她多才多艺，既会弹钢琴，又会画画。
example.en: She's multi-talented: she plays the piano and paints as well.

example.zh: 春节是中国的法定节假日，一般放假七天。
example.en: The Spring Festival is a statutory holiday in China, usually with seven days off.

gloss: to release (a bird, kite) into the air; to set free

example.zh: 春天到了，孩子们在广场上放飞风筝。
example.en: Spring is here, and children are flying kites in the square.

example.zh: 他感冒一直没好，后来发展成了肺炎。
example.en: His cold never got better and later turned into pneumonia.

gloss: to classify, to grade, to divide into levels

example.zh: 这家超市把鸡蛋按大小分级出售。
example.en: This supermarket sorts eggs into grades by size before selling them.

gloss: by stages; to pay in installments

example.zh: 这台电脑可以分期付款，每月只要三百元。
example.en: You can pay for this computer in installments, just three hundred yuan a month.

indonesian: kelas atas, tingkat tinggi; produk premium

example.zh: 这家商场主要销售高端品牌的服装。
example.en: This mall mainly sells clothes from high-end brands.

gloss: severe winter, the depths of winter

example.zh: 在寒冬腊月里，河面结了厚厚的一层冰。
example.en: In the depths of winter, the river is covered with a thick layer of ice.

gloss: how very, so (exclamatory, before an adjective)

example.zh: 节日的广场上张灯结彩，好不热闹。
example.en: The square is decked out with lanterns and streamers for the festival; how lively it is!

example.zh: 春天来了，公园里的花朵竞相开放。
example.en: Spring has come, and the flowers in the park are all bursting into bloom.

gloss: to slide, to glide; (of a plane) to taxi

example.zh: 飞机在跑道上滑行了一段距离后起飞了。
example.en: The plane rolled down the runway for a while and then took off.

gloss: bosom, arms (embrace); to keep in mind, to cherish
meanings: chest, bosom; to hold in mind

example.zh: 孩子扑进妈妈的怀里哭了起来。
example.en: The child threw himself into his mother's arms and started to cry.

example.zh: 中国女排三比一击败对手，获得了冠军。
example.en: The Chinese women's volleyball team beat their opponents 3–1 and won the title.

gloss: to double; doubly, all the more

example.zh: 如果不按时还款，罚款将会加倍。
example.en: If you don't repay on time, the fine will be doubled.

indonesian: rumah tangga; perabot dan dekorasi rumah

example.zh: 这个家居商场的家具款式很多，价格也不贵。
example.en: This home furnishings store has lots of furniture styles, and the prices aren't high.

example.zh: 今天的考试题目较为简单，大部分同学都答完了。
example.en: Today's exam questions were fairly easy, and most students finished them.

example.zh: 现在的天气预报越来越精准，连几点下雨都能预测。
example.en: Weather forecasts are increasingly precise these days; they can even predict what time it will rain.

gloss: sum of money, fund; measure word for styles or models (of products)
indonesian: sejumlah uang, dana; kata penggolong untuk model atau jenis produk
meanings: sum of money; measure word for items

example.zh: 这两款手机外观差不多，但价格差了一千块。
example.en: These two phone models look about the same, but their prices differ by a thousand yuan.

example.zh: 爷爷在阳台上养了好几盆兰花。
example.en: Grandpa grows several pots of orchids on the balcony.

gloss: to be happy to, to take pleasure in
meanings: to be happy to, to be willing to

example.zh: 他乐于助人，邻居们都很喜欢他。
example.en: He's always happy to help others, and all the neighbors like him.

indonesian: tahun-tahun sebelumnya, dari tahun ke tahun

example.zh: 复习时多做做历年的考试真题很有帮助。
example.en: When reviewing, it really helps to work through past years' exam papers.

example.zh: 我把文章的链接发给你了，你点开看看。
example.en: I've sent you the link to the article; open it and take a look.

gloss: the two poles (of the earth); two extremes

example.zh: 地球的两极常年被冰雪覆盖。
example.en: The Earth's two poles are covered with ice and snow all year round.

gloss: to hire, to take on (an applicant)

example.zh: 经过三轮面试，他终于被这家公司录用了。
example.en: After three rounds of interviews, he was finally hired by the company.

example.zh: 一群蚂蚁正在搬运地上的面包屑。
example.en: A group of ants is carrying away the breadcrumbs on the ground.

gloss: tax-free, duty-free; to exempt from tax

example.zh: 在机场的免税店买化妆品比较便宜。
example.en: Cosmetics are cheaper at the airport duty-free shop.

example.zh: 我们在古镇住了一家民宿，老板特别热情。
example.en: We stayed at a guesthouse in the old town, and the owner was really friendly.

example.zh: 南极洲是世界上最冷的大陆。
example.en: Antarctica is the coldest continent in the world.

example.zh: 巴西是南美洲面积最大的国家。
example.en: Brazil is the largest country in South America.

example.zh: 大片的农田被改建成了工厂和住宅。
example.en: Large stretches of farmland have been turned into factories and housing.

gloss: to put out, to extinguish; to stamp out

example.zh: 消防员花了两个小时才把大火扑灭。
example.en: It took firefighters two hours to put out the blaze.

example.zh: 下雪后，环卫工人一大早就开始清扫街道。
example.en: After the snowfall, sanitation workers started clearing the streets first thing in the morning.

gloss: degree of heat; popularity, (level of) public interest
indonesian: tingkat panas; popularitas, tingkat perhatian publik

example.zh: 这个话题在网上的热度一直很高。
example.en: This topic has been getting a lot of attention online.

gloss: to hotly discuss; heated public discussion

example.zh: 这条新闻一发布，就引发了网友的热议。
example.en: As soon as the news came out, it set off heated discussion among netizens.

gloss: huge crowds of people, a sea of people

example.zh: 国庆期间，各大景点都是人山人海。
example.en: During the National Day holiday, all the major tourist spots are packed with people.

example.zh: 这个周末电视台将直播多场足球赛事。
example.en: This weekend the TV station will broadcast several football matches live.

gloss: to strive to improve; to make progress; ambitious

example.zh: 她是个很上进的年轻人，下班后还去学英语。
example.en: She's a very motivated young person who studies English after work.

example.zh: 路口装了摄像头，闯红灯会被拍下来。
example.en: There's a camera at the intersection, so running a red light will get you photographed.

example.zh: 这棵小树从石头缝里长出来，生命力真顽强。
example.en: This little tree grew out of a crack in the rock; it's incredibly resilient.

example.zh: 她从小就喜欢背古代诗词，能背好几百首。
example.en: She has loved memorizing classical poetry since she was little and can recite several hundred poems.

example.zh: 这个软件可以实时显示公交车的位置。
example.en: This app shows the location of buses in real time.

example.zh: 这次书画展展出了一百多幅作品。
example.en: Over a hundred works are on display at this calligraphy and painting exhibition.

example.zh: 图书馆正在把古籍数字化，方便读者在网上查阅。
example.en: The library is digitizing its ancient books so readers can consult them online.

example.zh: 这段河道水流很急，禁止游泳。
example.en: The current in this stretch of the river is very swift; swimming is prohibited.

gloss: to extract; to withdraw, to retrieve

example.zh: 科学家从这种植物中提取出了一种新药。
example.en: Scientists extracted a new drug from this plant.

example.zh: 狗的听觉比人灵敏得多，很远的声音都能听见。
example.en: Dogs' hearing is much sharper than ours; they can hear sounds from far away.

example.zh: 外国游客在这家商场购物可以办理退税。
example.en: Foreign tourists who shop at this mall can claim a tax refund.

example.zh: 我外甥今年上小学一年级了。
example.en: My nephew started first grade this year.

gloss: all things, everything in the universe

example.zh: 春天来了，万物复苏，到处都是一片生机。
example.en: Spring has come; all of nature is reviving, and everything is full of life.

example.zh: 这种细菌非常微小，只能用显微镜才能看到。
example.en: These bacteria are so tiny that you can only see them with a microscope.

example.zh: 他从五岁开始学下围棋，十岁就拿了全国冠军。
example.en: He started learning Go at five and won the national championship at ten.

example.zh: 感冒的时候，人的味觉会变得迟钝。
example.en: When you have a cold, your sense of taste becomes dull.

example.zh: 请把会议记录整理成文档发到群里。
example.en: Please put the meeting notes into a document and post it in the group chat.

example.zh: 乌龟爬得很慢，但能活很长时间。
example.en: Tortoises crawl slowly but can live a very long time.

gloss: to wash up (wash face and brush teeth)

example.zh: 他每天早上六点起床，洗漱完就去跑步。
example.en: He gets up at six every morning, washes up and goes for a run.

example.zh: 我昨晚在网上下单，今天上午就收到货了。
example.en: I placed the order online last night and got the package this morning.

gloss: to go offline, to log off; to be taken offline (of a service)

example.zh: 我有点儿事，先下线了，咱们明天再聊吧。
example.en: I've got something to do, so I'm logging off; let's talk tomorrow.

gloss: extant, still in existence, currently existing
indonesian: yang masih ada, yang tersisa sekarang

example.zh: 这是我国现存最古老的木结构建筑。
example.en: This is the oldest surviving wooden building in our country.

example.zh: 这款沙发有现货，今天下单明天就能送到。
example.en: This sofa is in stock; order today and it can be delivered tomorrow.

example.zh: 我从心底里感谢你这些年对我的帮助。
example.en: I thank you from the bottom of my heart for all your help over the years.

example.zh: 很多年轻人通过新媒体获取新闻。
example.en: Many young people get their news through new media.

example.zh: 现在路上的新能源汽车越来越多了。
example.en: There are more and more new-energy vehicles on the road these days.

example.zh: 天太热了，他把袖子卷了起来。
example.en: It was so hot that he rolled up his sleeves.

example.zh: 输血之前，医生要先检查病人的血型。
example.en: Before a transfusion, the doctor must first check the patient's blood type.

example.zh: 这种材料轻便耐用，而且易于清洗。
example.en: This material is light, durable and easy to clean.

example.zh: 这小伙子真有劲，一个人就把冰箱搬上了楼。
example.en: That young guy is really strong; he carried the fridge upstairs all by himself.

gloss: yuanxiao (sweet rice-flour dumplings); Lantern Festival food
indonesian: yuanxiao (bola tepung ketan manis); makanan Festival Lampion

example.zh: 正月十五，北方人有吃元宵的习俗。
example.en: On the fifteenth day of the first lunar month, people in the north traditionally eat yuanxiao.

example.zh: 月光照在平静的湖面上，像撒了一层碎银子。
example.en: The moonlight on the calm lake looked like a scattering of silver.

example.zh: 老年人在这个城市人口中的占比越来越高。
example.en: The share of elderly people in this city's population keeps rising.

example.zh: 天气预报说今天下午有阵雨，出门记得带伞。
example.en: The forecast says there will be showers this afternoon, so remember your umbrella.

example.zh: 我侄子今年刚上小学一年级。
example.en: My nephew just started first grade this year.

gloss: to farm, to till the land

example.zh: 他年轻的时候在老家种地，后来到城里开了家饭馆。
example.en: When he was young he farmed back home, and later he opened a restaurant in the city.

example.zh: 天气太热，有好几个工人中暑了。
example.en: It was so hot that several workers got heatstroke.

gloss: (live-stream) host, news anchor; to host a broadcast
indonesian: pembawa acara siaran langsung, penyiar berita; menyiarkan
meanings: to host a live stream; live streamer

example.zh: 她是一名带货主播，每天晚上直播卖东西。
example.en: She's a sales streamer who sells products on live broadcasts every night.

example.zh: 他非常自律，每天坚持早起读书、锻炼。
example.en: He's very self-disciplined, getting up early every day to read and exercise.
